articleTitle: Reaching maximum conversion efficiency for terahertz generation in reversely stacked GaP plates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz output peak power as high as 2.7 kW is achieved by difference-frequency generation. Conversion efficiency reaching maximum value of 40% is obtained by reversely stacking four GaP plates.

articleTitle: Self-referenced frequency comb from a Tm-fiber amplifier via PPLN waveguide supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a coherent 2-μm Tm fiber laser frequency comb with a self referenced carrier envelope offset frequency by performing octave-spanning supercontinuum generation in a periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide.

articleTitle: High-Q polymeric microcavity for biosensing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a new type of high-Q microresonator made of poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) with a conical shape. First results on biosensing with proteins are presented.

articleTitle: Multi-photon autocorrelation in gold nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We performed interferometric autocorrelation of ultrashort laser pulses using the multiphoton photoluminescence of gold nanostructures. We observe an incoherent contribution with a decay constant related to electron cooling in the conduction band.

articleTitle: Zero phase accumulation in negative-index photonic crystal superlattices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate zero phase delay and deterministically tunable zero-n bandgaps in path-averaged zero-index photonic crystal superlattices. Phase differences are measured with integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometers and all measurements agree well with theoretical analysis and simulations.

articleTitle: Modal instability and beam steering in quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-resolved far-field measurements of Quantum Cascade lasers show beam steering on the few nano-second scale. Spatially resolved spectra show that the beam steering is accompanied with frequency locking between transverse modes.

articleTitle: Distributed sensing inside long-length FBG at region beyond laser coherence length based on synthesis of optical coherence function
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Measurement of Bragg-wavelength distribution inside a long-length FBG at region beyond laser coherence length is demonstrated based on synthesis of optical coherence function for a multi-point distributed sensor system with wide measurement range.

articleTitle: Retarded-interaction magnetization waves in planar split-ring-resonator arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The resonance damping in split-ring-resonator square arrays operating at around 200-THz frequency depends on both lattice constant and observation angle. This behavior is interpreted in terms of magnetization waves with retarded nearest-neighbor interaction.

articleTitle: Characterizing ultrashort pulses one photon at a time
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A linear self-referenced technique for temporal characterization of ultraweak pulse trains is presented. Shot-noise limited time-resolved single photon detection enables temporal resolution down to 10fs for pulse trains with ~ 1 photon per pulse.

articleTitle: Time- and frequency-domain imaging of dynamics in terahertz meta-atoms
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Visualization of the dynamics of the electromagnetic resonators used to build metamaterial is presented. Observed data provides detailed information on the interaction between free space radiation and the resonator.

articleTitle: Combination of diffractive shaper and splitter for multiple beam laser processing system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transforming Gaussian laser beam into top-hat profile is accomplished by a four-level kinoform diffractive element. A binary diffractive grating was further integrated for generating multiple top-hat laser spots to improve the efficiency of a laser processing system.

articleTitle: Enlargement of measurement range by double frequency modulations in one-laser Brillouin correlation-domain distributed discrimination system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new scheme based on double frequency modulations is proposed to enlarge the measurement range in Brillouin correlation-domain distributed discrimination system with one laser source. The measurement range is increased from ~5 m to ~34 m with the spatial resolution maintained to be 10 cm.

articleTitle: Organic materials for Zeno-based optical switching
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Compounds showing strong non-degenerate two-photon absorption hold potential for Zeno-based optical switching schemes. We report on organic compounds including polymethines and squaraines with large non-degenerate two photon cross sections.

articleTitle: Assessment of rotator cuff tendon integrity with single detector polarization sensitive optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this study, we perform PS-OCT imaging of discarded human rotator cuff tendon. Imaging at the surgical cut and torn end were preformed and compared with histopathology.

articleTitle: Magnetic properties of asymmetric double-wire structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using the multipole approach we considered the dynamics of plasmonic oscillations in asymmetric double-wire metamaterials. Magnetization of materials is defined by the position of the largest wire with respect to the exciting electric field.

articleTitle: Digital planar holograms fabricated by step and repeat UV nanoimprint lithography: From spectrometer chip to higher power laser diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The fabrication of digital planar holograms by Step and Repeat UV nanoimprint lithography is reported. It opens a route for commercial development of new nanophotonic devices based on digital planar holography. Two first applications to be demonstrated are the high resolution spectrometer chips and the enhancement of brightness and power of laser diodes.

articleTitle: Rapid, wideband, wavelength tunable narrow linewidth source by spectral compression of ultrashort soliton pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Rapid, wideband, wavelength tunable narrow linewidth source was demonstrated by spectrum compression of Raman shifted ultrashort soliton pulses with comb profile fiber. High-speed near infrared absorption spectroscopy was demonstrated with it.

articleTitle: Manipulation of coupling between individual nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the emission dynamics of a single semiconductor quantum dot near a single Au nanoparticle. Due to coupling between the nanoparticles, the quantum dot exhibits a strong polarization dependence and reduced blinking.

articleTitle: Improved performance of SS-OCT by calibration with logarithmic amplified frequency clock
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The presented work demonstrates that using a true logarithmic amplifier to precondition the frequency clock signal in swept source OCT can obtain optimal calibration hence improve the imaging performance such as axial resolution and SNR.

articleTitle: Fractional frequency multiplication by using optically injection locked optoelectronics oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fractional frequency multiplication is demonstrated based on an optoelectronics oscillator. A multiplication ratio of 4/3 is realized by injecting an optical signal modulated by 7.5 GHz RF clock into an optoelectronics oscillator to obtain 10-GHz clock.

articleTitle: Octave wide mid-infrared frequency comb rigorously derived from commercial near-IR mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent results using a degenerate OPO pumped by a 1560nm ultrafast laser to generate a broadband mid-infrared comb. Dispersion management and FTIR detection techniques access an octave-wide output spectrum extending from 2.0 to 4.0 um.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation in a sapphire fiber and comparison with a compact PCF based light source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A single crystal sapphire fiber pumped with ultrashort laser pulses was used to generate supercontinuum light. Its emission was next compared with this of the PCF based source in terms of the applicability to Multiwavelength-CRD-Spectrography.

articleTitle: Single-photon detection at 1550 nm via upconversion using a tunable long-wavelength pump source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 37% single-photon detection efficiency at 1550 nm via sum-frequency generation in a periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide, by pumping with a monolithic optical parametric oscillator tunable near 1800 nm.

articleTitle: Fast quantum dot single photon source triggered at telecommunications wavelength
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 300 MHz quantum dot single photon source at 900 nm triggered by a telecommunications wavelength laser. The quantum dot is excited by on-chip-generated second harmonic radiation, resonantly enhanced by a photonic nanocavity.

articleTitle: Efficient gigahertz femtosecond Yb:KGW laser with 2.2-W average power generates octave-spanning supercontinuum
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a 1-GHz Yb:KGW laser with 2.2-W average power and 38% optical-to-optical efficiency. The 290-fs pulses with 6.7-kW peak power generate an octave-spanning supercontinuum in a photonic-crystal-fiber.

articleTitle: Optical antennas for enhanced light absorption and emission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The introduction of the antenna concept into the optical, infrared and terahertz frequency regime holds promise for a wide range of novel technological applications. Optical antennas can be employed to enhance the efficiency of photovoltaics, to release energy from nanoscale light-emitting devices, and to boost the efficiency of photochemical or photophysical detectors. In this presentation, I will outline the physical properties of optical antennas, review relevant history and recent work.

articleTitle: Quantum optics of spontaneous four-wave mixing in a silicon nitride microring resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By varying the width of an exciting pump pulse, very efficient generation of photon pairs, ranging from anti-correlated to nearly unentangled, is possible in existing silicon nitride microring resonators.

articleTitle: Optical parametric regeneration for phase-modulated signals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: All-optical signal regeneration using four-wave mixing in fibers is discussed. An experiment of nonlinear phase noise reduction of DQPSK signals by a phase-preserving amplitude limiter using saturated fiber-optic parametric amplifier is described.

articleTitle: Canonical quantization of macroscopic electromagnetism and the Casimir-Lifshitz effect
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: General macroscopic electromagnetism is canonically quantized, providing a rigorous quantum theory of light in dispersive, absorptive media. The theory illuminates the issue of electromagnetic energy density and stress in the Casimir-Lifshitz effect.

articleTitle: Plasmonic organic solar cell and its absorption enhancement analysis using cylindrical Ag nano-particle model based on finite difference time domain (FDTD)
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the plasmon-assisted photocurrent enhancement in Ag nanoparticles (NPs) embedded PEDOT:PSS/P3HT:PCBM organic solar cells, and theoretically investigate the causes of the improved optical absorption based on a cylindrical Ag-NPs model which is simulated with a finite difference time domain (FDTD) method. The proposed cylindrical Ag-NPs model is able to explain the optical absorption enhancement by the localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) modes, and to provide a further understanding of Ag-NPs shape parameters which play an important role to determine the broadband absorption phenomena in plasmonic organic solar cells.

articleTitle: Thermoelectric vs. photoelectric response of graphene-metal photodetectors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the photocurrent in graphene-metal photodetectors. Our results show that the thermoelectric current dominates the photocurrent response.

articleTitle: Intracavity high harmonic generation driven by Yb-fiber based MOPA system at 80MHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coherent deep-UV radiation is produced by Yb-fiber-laser based cavity-enhanced high-harmonic generation at 80-MHz repetition rate. The intracavity-power exceeds 3kW and up to 17<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonics are outcoupled by thin Brewster's plate made by MgO crystal.

articleTitle: The ultrafast nonlinear optical properties of induced transmission filters
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the nonlinear optical properties of induced transmission filters with 30× enhancement compared with a 30 nm Ag film and with a peak transmittance of 63% in the visible.

articleTitle: High-saturation current uni-traveling-carrier waveguide photodiodes with variable optical confinement
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes with variable optical confinement waveguides are proposed and demonstrated. Two different photodiode designs are compared, both demonstrating state of the art saturation current for a waveguide photodiode.

articleTitle: Ultracold molecules: Production techniques and scientific applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Cooling and trapping of diatomic molecules is now possible. Their vibrational and rotational degrees of freedom provide new tools to address problems in fields ranging from quantum computing and simulation, to particle physics.

articleTitle: Laser immobilization of photosynthetic material on screen printed electrodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This work presents the direct laser printing of thylakoid membranes for the fabrication of photosynthetic-based amperometric biosensors. Laser printing is an excellent tool for direct immobilization of the transferred photosynthetic material onto non-functionalized electrodes due to the high impact pressure of the transferred droplets. The use of this laser transfer technique enabled complete wetting of the rough electrodes' surface, which could not be achieved with conventional printing/spotting methods. Both immobilization and activity of the photosynthetic material were confirmed by high photocurrent signals combined with a high signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Ultralow-power all-optical memory using photonic crystal nanocavities with novel buried heterostructure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical memory based on photonic crystal nanocavities with novel buried heterostructure, which solves the heating problem and enhances the carrier confinement, enabling long memory-time operation with sub-μW power consumption.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal dumbbell cavity for low-power optomechanical actuation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic crystal slot cavities are designed with Q up to 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>. Strong field confinement allows for significant gradient optical force actuation. Measured devices show high extinction ratio and mechanical resonance at low optical driving power.

articleTitle: Integration of polymeric microstructures by silica nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use two-photon polymerization to fabricate microstructures containing fluorescent dyes, which were integrated and excited through silica nanowires. Such results open up new opportunities for micro-optical devices integration.

articleTitle: Fabrication and optical properties of aligned silicon nanowire arrays realized with thin silver film
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon nanowire arrays realized by depositing thin silver film before etching are demonstrated to have good material and optical properties. They can provide <;0.4% antireflection over >;1400-nm wavelength range for large-area silicon samples.

articleTitle: Multiply resonant photonic crystal nanocavities with broadband tunability
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal cavity allowing at least two separately tunable resonances is designed. Both frequency degenerate structures and structures with frequency separations of up to 500 nm are experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Dependence of the periodic structure interspaces on laser fluence for metals irradiated with femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Periodic structures self-formed on the surface of several metals by femtosecond laser pulses are investigated. The laser fluence dependence can be explained by the induction of a surface plasma wave through parametric decay of laser.

articleTitle: Active wavelength control for external cavity quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an active wavelength control method which ensures that all wavelength-selective elements of an external cavity semiconductor laser are spectrally aligned and the diffraction grating equation accurately predicts the laser operating frequency.

articleTitle: 650MHz-prf-femtosecond Cr4+:Forsterite laser with dispersion-compensating GaInNAs SESAM
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the use of a near-resonant GalnNAs SESAM in a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:forsterite laser to generate transform-limited 150fs pulses around 1300nm at a repetition-rate of 0.65GHz with average powers up to 270mW.

articleTitle: Passive synchronization of repetition and offset frequency between two mode-locked Yb-doped fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated an injection locking of mode-locked Yb-fiber oscillator seeded by another mode-locked pulse train. As well as the repetition rate, the offset frequency of the slave laser was locked passively.

articleTitle: Buried-heterostructure phase-locked arrays of mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Realization of buried-heterostructure phase-locked arrays quantum cascade lasers emitting at 8.5μm is presented. Narrowing of the farfield emission for the multi-elements array compared to single-element laser is shown.

articleTitle: Multiple-input multiple-output with predistortion and signal processing for multimode fiber links
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a multiple-input multiple-input multimode fiber optical link, where signal processing for dispersion compensation achieves a rate of 11.38 Gb/s over a 3 km fiber, exceeding the rated fiber bandwidth-length product by 15 times.

articleTitle: A short dual-wavelength DBR phosphate fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 5cm-long monolithic distributed Bragg reflector fiber laser is fabricated by directly writing Bragg gratings on Er/Yb co-doped phosphate fiber. Stable narrow-linewidth dual wavelength emission with 38 pm wavelength spacing is achieved.

articleTitle: Strong interaction between quantum dot exciton spin states and a photonic crystal cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We apply a magnetic field to photonic crystal cavity devices with embedded Indium Arsenide (InAs) quantum dots (QDs), and demonstrate strong coupling between individual QD exciton spin states and a photonic crystal cavity.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s direct modulation of optical injection-locked photonic crystal laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a three-terminal device based on an optical injection-locked photonic crystal laser to achieve high-speed off-chip interconnection to meet future network-on-chip needs. 40 Gb/s large-signal direct modulation and more than three times bandwidth enhancement are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Mode-locked Tm-Ho fiber laser with a Sb-based SESAM
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A mode-locked Tm-Ho-codoped silicate fiber laser with a Sb-based SESAM is reported. The fiber laser generates mode-locked solitons at 2.06 μm with pulse energy of 0.41 nJ and pulse duration of 1.1 ps.

articleTitle: Tellurite suspended core nanofiber with extremely large holey region
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tellurite suspended core nanofiber with extremely large holey region is demonstrated for the first time. A single-mode third harmonic generation is observed under the 1557 nm pump by a femtosecond fiber laser.

articleTitle: Dual functional optical amplifier with electrooptic gain medium of Er3+ doped PLZT ceramics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel dual functional device combining optical filtering and amplification by taking advantage of excellent electrooptic property in the gain medium was designed and demonstrated in covering both C- and L-bands.

articleTitle: Attosecond time-resolved autoionization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Autoionization in argon atoms was studied by transient absorption spectroscopy with isolated attosecond XUV pulses. The peak position, line shape and population of the resonant states were modified by intense near infrared laser pulses.

articleTitle: Ce3+, Sm3+:YAG double-clad crystal fiber broadband light source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nine millwatts of broadband emission were generated from a Ce,Sm:YAG double-clad crystal fiber. This direct diode-laser pumped visible light had a 3-dB bandwidth of 100 nm and an optical-to-optical conversion efficiency of 2.4%.

articleTitle: High-speed electrical control of a solid-state photonic quantum interface
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate high-fidelity transfer of the polarisation of a photon into the spin-state of an electron-hole pair. Spins are then electrically manipulated on sub-nanosecond timescales and near-unity phase-shift and spin-flip gate operations are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pulse compression and fiber delivery of Sub-30 fs nanojoule pulses at 830 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Powerful Sub-30 fs pulses (830 nm) are delivered by 2 meters long standard and LMA fibers despite nonlinearity and dispersion. A "GRISMs" line, accurately compensated second and third orders of dispersion.

articleTitle: Selective tuning of silicon photonic crystal cavities via laser-assisted local oxidation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultra-high-Q nanocavity resonance tuning by laser-assisted thermal oxidation of silicon is demonstrated by using a 532 nm continuous wave laser. The resonance is blue-shifted by >;2nm. The quality factor remains >;200,000.

articleTitle: Experimental characterization of simultaneous gain pumping and depletion in a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally characterize gain-pumping in a semiconductor optical amplifier and combine gain-pumping and gain-depletion effects that can enable complex all-optical signal processing functions.

articleTitle: Optomechanically induced transparency
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In analogy to electromagnetically induced transparency observed in atomic systems, we demonstrate that the transmission of a probe laser beam through an optomechanical device can be modulated ail-optically using a second, "control" laser beam.

articleTitle: Cell-based assays using photonic crystal biosensors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photonic crystal (PC) biosensors are used for quantifying cell attachment to surfaces for applications such as pharmaceutical screening and life science research. PC biosensors and imaging detection instruments measure the aggregate behavior of large cell populations, individual cells, variation within cells.

articleTitle: Full characterization of tightly focused vector fields through far field third harmonic signals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A non-iterative algorithm applied on nanosphere induced far field third harmonic signals capable of retrieving the full vector third order polarization densities and fundamental field at the focal plane is presented.

articleTitle: Cascaded traveling-wave phase-sensitive optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a two-stage system of cascaded traveling-wave phase-sensitive optical parametric amplifiers, achieving 10dB second-stage amplification (5 dB deamplification) on top of the amplification (deamplification) provided by the first stage.

articleTitle: Single-shot time-frequency imaging of phonon-polariton dispersion in ferroelectric LiNbO3
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-shot observation of phonon-polariton dispersion in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> is demonstrated using optical Kerr-gate method with an echelon mirror. Forward- and backward- propagating phonon-polaritons are observed in the time-frequency two-dimensional image.

articleTitle: Circularly-polarized resonances at the photonic band-edge of chiral liquid crystal microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Narrow, circularly-polarized microcavity resonances were observed for the first time in the fluorescence at the photonic band-edge of glassy chiral liquid crystal microcavities both undoped and doped with quantum dots irradiated by a cw-laser beam.

articleTitle: High power single-cycle and tunable multi-cycle terahertz generation by phase-matched optical rectification
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High power single- and multi-cycle terahertz (THz) pulses have been generated with the tilted intensity front scheme in lithium niobate crystal, with more than 50 μJ and 10 μJ pulse energy respectively.

articleTitle: Spectral line-by-line pulse shaping of an on-chip microresonator frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report spectral phase characterization and optical arbitrary waveform generation of on-chip microresonator combs. Random relative frequency shifts due to uncorrelated variations of frequency dependent phase are at or below the 100 μHz level.

articleTitle: Silicon based Ultrafast active plasmonics near 1.5 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Light plasmon coupling resonances near 1.5 μm are optically shifted by nearly 50 nm on a gold-coated silicon grating for 800 fs, 775 nm excitation; recovery occurs in ~70 ps.

articleTitle: Quantum-light-enhanced optical magnetometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a light-shot-noise-limited magnetometer based on the Faraday effect in a hot unpolarized ensemble of rubidium atoms. By using off-resonant, polarization-squeezed probe light, we improve the sensitivity of the magnetometer by 3.2 dB.

articleTitle: Increased optical intensity near high order Degenerate Photonic Band Edges for nonlinear applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show theoretically that Degenerate Band Edges (DBEs) lead to high optical intensities. A method is proposed to create arbitrary DBE, (ω - ω<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>) = k<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2n</sup>, for any integer n, by coupling n optical modes by multiple superimposed periodic structures.

articleTitle: First demonstration of noise figure below 3 dB in CW pumped phase sensitive amplifier using PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A noise figure below 3 dB was obtained for the first time in a CW pumped PSA based on a PPLN waveguide. The 40 Gbit/s-DPSK receiver sensitivity was improved by using the PSA as a preamplifier.

articleTitle: Broadband quantum cascade lasers based on strongly-coupled transitions with an external cavity tuning range over 340 cm−1
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum Cascade lasers based on continuum-to-continuum design enable external cavity tuning over 340 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> in pulsed mode operation at 15°C. Strong gain suppression over 320 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is attributed to strong coupling between the laser transitions.

articleTitle: Chirped and tilted fiber Bragg grating edge filter for in-fiber sensor interrogation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Power-referenced in-fiber edge filter based on a linearly chirped and weakly tilted fiber Bragg grating is proposed. It provides a smooth transfer function with 0.7 dB/nm of discrimination over C-band for the temperature-self-compensated FBG interrogation.

articleTitle: Quantum Zeno effect and quantum Zeno dynamics in cavity quantum electrodynamics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a cavity QED experiment on quantum Zeno effect with Rydberg atoms and a microwave superconducting cavity. We propose an implementation of quantum Zeno dynamics leading to promising methods for tailoring nonclassical field states.

articleTitle: Self-referenced spectral interferometry in the UV domain
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Self-referenced spectral interferometry based on Cross-polarized wave generation is experimentally demonstrated on UV pulses at 400 and 266nm. Specific problems are discussed including multiple pulse measurement, dynamic limitation, temporal range.

articleTitle: Extremely high refractive index terahertz metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate extremely high indices of refraction from large-area, freestanding, flexible terahertz metamaterials. The highest index of refraction of 33.22 is obtained from a multilayer metamaterial at a frequency of 0.851 THz.

articleTitle: Automatic testing of unmounted quantum cascade laser chips in an external cavity configuration
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An automatic external-cavity laser system for efficient testing of unmounted quantum cascade laser (QCL) bars has been developed. QCLs emitting at 3.45μm and broadband gain media with ~344 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> tunability at 4.4μm have been studied.

articleTitle: Detection of single nanoparticles using a nano fiber-taper
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a sensitive single nanoparticle detection scheme using a nano tapered fiber. Experiments of detecting R = 120 nm and 175 nm polystyrene (PS) nanoparticles at 1550 nm wavelength band are demonstrated.

articleTitle: The role of kinetic inductance in metal optics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple LC circuit model recovers the surface plasmon dispersion relation. The model clearly reveals the role of kinetic inductance in shaping the dispersion and other key properties of surface plasmons.

articleTitle: High-power BCB encapsulated VCSELs based on InP
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The high temperature behavior of short cavity InP based VCSEL devices with 5.5 μm apertures is presented. They show record optical output powers and SMSRs beyond 50 dB over the whole temperature range.

articleTitle: Real-time numerical dispersion compensation for standard/full-range complex Fourier-domain optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We implemented numerical dispersion compensation for both standard and full-range complex Fourier-domain optical coherence tomography on a graphics processing unit architecture, and demonstrated real-time ultrahigh-resolution imaging at 70k line/s.

articleTitle: An integrated plasmonic polarimeter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a plasmonic device that can determine the state of polarization of an incident light beam over a narrow wavelength band. The measurement results show 25 and 1.13 contrast ratio for linear and circular polarizations at 830nm.

articleTitle: Optical coherence tomography forward-imaging needle for real-time deep brain surgery guidance
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a real-time (16 frames/second), narrowest to-date (21 gauge, 700 μm-diam) optical coherence tomography (OCT) forward-imaging needle device and demonstrated its feasibility for guiding deep brain surgery based on both structural and Doppler imaging.

articleTitle: THz quantum cascade sources based on intra-cavity frequency mixing in passive nonlinear sections
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report terahertz quantum cascade laser sources based on intra-cavity difference frequency generation in passive nonlinear sections. Current devices provide terahertz output up to a heat sink temperature of 210 K.

articleTitle: The study of apoptotic morphological changes by dual-wavelength digital holographic microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the study of cellular morphology changes during apoptosis by digital holographic microscopy. The population of cells undergoing staurosporine induced apoptosis was monitored in-situ for several hours and 35% overall volume decrease was observed.

articleTitle: Metal-metal THz quantum cascade laser gain and loss investigated by THz time domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: THz time-domain studies on metal-metal THz quantum cascade lasers are presented. A coupled cavity method allows to probe the laser via modulation of coherent broadband THz pulses. Observed laser gain and loss processes are discussed.

articleTitle: Photon antibunching from diamond nitrogen-vacancy centers inside a dielectric micropillar cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Diamond nanocrystals with single nitrogen-vacancy color centers are incorporated into dielectric micropillar resonators. We observe three-dimensional light confinement and antibunching in the photon emission.

articleTitle: Applications of robust, radiation hard AlGaN optoelectronic devices in space exploration and high energy density physics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report demonstration of radiation hardness and environmental robustness of AlGaN deep UV Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs) and deep UV Photodiodes, and their applications in space science instruments for AC charge management, and in High Energy Density Physics diagnostics.

articleTitle: Phase seeding of a terahertz quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The QCL carrier phase is set by coherent injection seeding with a THz pulse. This enables the phase-resolved laser emission to be measured in the time-domain and the QCL to be used directly for time-domain-spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Electro-optic microwave-lightwave converter using patch antenna embedded with a narrow gap for optical modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New electro-optic microwave-lightwave converters using a patch antenna embedded with a narrow gap are proposed. Basic operations for the conversion from wireless to optical signals were demonstrated at 18 GHz with no external power supply.

articleTitle: Vertical sub-wavelength mode confinement in THz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We exploit the modal confinement properties of metal-metal ridge waveguides to reduce the thickness of the active laser cores in both terahertz and mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers. Devices with active regions over 60 times thinner than the free-space emission wavelength are demonstrated. The devices surprisingly show only a modest increase in threshold current density compared with conventional-thickness devices.

articleTitle: Quantum optomechanical measurement of the phonon number dynamics of a mesoscopic mechanical resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyse the generic case of an optomechanical system with coupling quadratic in the mechanical displacement. Using the stochastic master equation formalism, we establish constraints necessary to observe quantum jumps in the phonon number.

articleTitle: On-chip single crystal diamond resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a fabrication method for diamond based resonators. Optical characterization of a diamond ring resonator on quartz substrate reveals cavity modes both in the telecom and the visible wavelength regime having with Q-factors ∼8000.

articleTitle: High efficiency quasi-non-critical phase-matched KTiOPO4 optical parametric oscillation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quasi-non-critical phase-matched optical parametric oscillation has been achieved in periodically bonded KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> stack with a 1.064-μm pump laser. A slope efficiency of 65% has been measured for the total output power of signal and idler.

articleTitle: Time-bin entanglement distribution on a wavelength-division-multiplexed network
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a scheme for distributing time-bin entangled photons to multiple pairs of clients. With clients linked through the strong spectral correlations between the photons, a single down-conversion source can serve many clients simultaneously.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10–40-Gbaud baud-rate-tunable optical generation of 16-QAM from a QPSK signal using a variable DGD element
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a tunable optical generation of up to 40-Gbaud 16- QAM from a QPSK signal using a variable DGD element based on vector addition between two polarization states. We also show the baud rate tunability and investigate the tolerance of 16-QAM generation to the DGD offset.

articleTitle: Laser control of self-organization process in microscopic region
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a controlling technique of microporous structure by laser irradiation during self-organization process. This method is expected that application for photonic crystals, biological cell culturing, and electronics fields, etc.

articleTitle: Optical bonding and antibonding forces in asymmetric geometries for Casimir force detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optical bonding (attractive) and antibonding (repulsive) forces between a suspended, holey Silicon membrane and a Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI) substrate are shown to offer a sensitive new method for plane-plane geometry Casimir force detection.

articleTitle: Enhancing solar cells with localized plasmons in nanovoids
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Localized plasmons in silver nanovoids enhance organic solar cell efficiencies experimentally by a factor of four and similarly in a-Si cells, accounted for by theoretical and computational analysis of absorption at the plasmonic interface.

articleTitle: A proposed scheme for the electron and nuclear spin initialization in general localized electron systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An efficient scheme is proposed to initialize both the electron and nuclear spins in general localized electron systems via the hyperfine interaction-induced crossing between the singlet and triplet electronic states.

articleTitle: Gold nanoshells for nonlinear plasmonic at telecom wavelengths
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The nonlinear response of silica-gold-nanoshells (SGNS) in chloroform was studied at 1560nm, and an analytical approach that allowed extraction of the third- and the fifth- nonlinear susceptibility of a SGNS from the data is presented.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral infrared microscopy of explosives particles using an external cavity quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hyperspectral infrared microscope using external cavity quantum cascade laser illumination and a microbolometer focal plane array is used to characterize nanogram-scale particles of the explosives RDX, tetryl, and PETN at fast acquisition rates.

articleTitle: Systematic frequency shifts in spectroscopy of 1s–2s transition in atomic hydrogen
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze and review several systematic effects which lead to shifts of the observed 1s–2s transition frequency in atomic hydrogen. The results open the possibility to improve the accuracy of the 1s–2s frequency measurement.

articleTitle: Mechanical tuning of surface plasmon in flexible gold nanograting
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present design, fabrication and characterization of mechanically tunable gold nanograting structure. As the period of the flexible gold grating was tuned mechanically, shift in surface plasmon coupling condition led to tuning of resonant wavelength.

articleTitle: Surface plasmonic lens on a single-mode optical fiber for far-field superfocusing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate sub-diffraction-limit focuses achieved by surface plasmonic (SP) lenses directly fabricated on the endfaces of regular single-mode optical fibers. The fiber-based SP lens provides a solution to bridge nanophotonics and conventional optics.

articleTitle: Plane-projection multi-photon microscopy for high-frame-rate Live Tissue Imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a wide-field multi-photon microscopy that provides optical sectioning at high frame rate under biocompatible laser dosage. Axial resolution comparable to confocal microscopy and 5-frame-per-second live tissue imaging are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Chirped laser dispersion spectroscopy with baseline-free 2nd harmonic detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A phase sensitive signal detection scheme for molecular spectroscopy based on chirped laser dispersion spectroscopy (CLaDS) is presented. We demonstrate application to sensitive remote sensing of trace gases using a 5.2 μm quantum cascade laser.

articleTitle: Sub-1mJ over-two-octave white-light continuum generated by induced phase modulation in argon-filled hollow fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generated 0.9-mJ pulses spanning from 270 to 1200 nm by utilizing the induced phase modulation in pressure gradient hollow fiber. This enables 1.5-fs, 0.65-cycles, 0.6-TW, 1-kHz transform-limited pulses for attosecond science and technology.

articleTitle: Organic/inorganic hybrid optical amplifier with wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an organic/inorganic hybrid optical amplifier with a function of converting infrared light to visible light. This device integrates an InGaAs/InP heterojunction photo transistor (HPT) and an organic light emitting device.

articleTitle: Interlayer electronic coupling observed by polarization dependent coherently controlled photocurrent generation in multilayer epitaxial graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured the third order nonlinear tensor in epitaxial graphene by studying coherently controlled photocurrent direction as function of the pump light polarization. The measured tensor element indicates the presence of interlayer electronic coupling in epitaxial graphene.

articleTitle: Electro-optical modulator based on the p+-n+-n+ transistor structure integrated on SOI substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> transistor-based electro-optical modulator fabricated on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) substrate. With 100% modulation depth achieved, the rise and fall times were respectively measured to be 60 and 56 ns. The 3 dB bandwidth in the excess of 10.5 MHz was determined from the corresponding device.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of gas-detection sensitivity of InGaAsSb/AlGaAsSb DFB lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The detection sensitivity of <;0.50 ppb-m of HF gas is achieved with CW GaSb-based DFB lasers at 2396 nm. Sensitivity was characterized over laser operating temperature and output power.

articleTitle: Semiconductor core optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Progress in the fabrication and performance of glass-clad crystalline semiconductor core optical fibers is reviewed. This new class of optical fibers may significantly advance applications in nonlinear optics and infrared power delivery.

articleTitle: Wood's anomaly in arrays of highly anisotropic plasmonic antennas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We examine the Wood's anomaly in arrays of nanorod pairs and find an apparent strong coupling between longitudinal plasmon modes and an oscillating dipole moment perpendicular to the plane of the substrate.

articleTitle: Catastrophic optical damage at front and rear facets of 975 nm emitting diode lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Catastrophic facet degradation at highest power levels is analyzed for different diode laser waveguide architectures. Degradation events at front and rear facet are analyzed and predominant damage at the rear is elucidated for Al-free waveguides.

articleTitle: Frequency comb generation in crystalline MgF2 whispering-gallery mode resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate frequency comb generation via four-wave-mixing in crystalline MgF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> whispering-gallery mode resonators. More than 800 comb lines spaced by 43 GHz are observed. Second order autocorrelation is performed for time-domain characterization.

articleTitle: Scalable multi-photon coincidence-counting electronics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a multi-channel coincidence-counting module for use in quantum optics experiments. The module counts up to 4-fold coincidences at up to 84 MHz. Combined multiple modules can count M-order coincidences among N inputs.

articleTitle: Suspended core polymer fibers with isolated mode for terahertz guiding
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The fabrication and characterization of polymer suspended core fibers (porous and non porous cores) for terahertz guiding is demonstrated for the first time. These novel fibers enable strong mode isolation from perturbations in the surrounding environment.

articleTitle: Wideband supercontinuum generation in tapered tellurite microstructured fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Enhanced soliton trapping of dispersive waves in a tapered tellurite microstructured fiber pumped by a 1557 nm femtosecond laser is demonstrated. The short wavelength edge of supercontinuum light is extended from 960 to 600 nm.

articleTitle: Explosive sensing using multiple-excitation-wavelength resonance-Raman scattering
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a new technique that uses Raman spectra obtained from multiple DUV excitation wavelengths for explosive detection. The strong dependence on excitation wavelength of the Raman signal provides a unique signature, improving specificity.

articleTitle: Effect of carrier-envelope phase on bound-state atomic excitation by multi-cycle pulse
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an experimental and theoretical study of Carrier-Envelope Phase effects on bound state atomic excitation. We investigated the influence of CEP on multiphoton transitions between the Zeeman sublevels of the ground state of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb.

articleTitle: Three dimensional finite element modeling of laser cladding of nickel alloy with 1.5wt.% and 3wt.% nano CeO2 on the low carbon steel 1015
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multilayer laser cladding process for the material properties of low carbon steel 1015 for workpiece and nickel alloy with 1.5 wt.% and 3 wt.% nano CeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> as the powder particles is modeled. Finite Element Method (FEM) solutions of transient heat transfer and mass transfer equations in laser cladding process are presented. Geometry of the deposited material as well as temperature and thermal stress fields across the process area are calculated.

articleTitle: Terahertz imaging and spectroscopy of large-area single-layer graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: THz imaging and spectroscopy using broadband THz pulses map out the THz carrier dynamics of a large-area graphene-on-Si sample, showing that the local sheet-conductivity varies across the sample from σ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub> = 1.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> to 2.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> Ω<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Broad band unidirectional invisibility using PT-symmetry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that parity-time symmetric Bragg grating structures, at the spontaneous PT-symmetry point, can act as unidirectional transparent media where the reflection from one side is suppressed while it is enhanced from the other.

articleTitle: Type-0 Spontaneous Parametric Down Conversion in AlGaAs Bragg Reflection Waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By analyzing the time correlation between two single photon detector events, we demonstrate Spontaneous Parametric Down Conversion of a picosecond pulsed laser in an AlGaAs ridge Bragg Reflection Waveguide.

articleTitle: Mono-Energetic Gamma-rays (MEGa-rays) and the dawn of nuclear photonics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mono-Energetic Gamma-rays (MEGa-rays) of unprecedented peak brilliance can be created via the optimized interaction of laser light with relativistic electrons. Development of MEGa-ray technology and related "nuclear" photonics applications are reviewed.

articleTitle: Compensation of signal distortion by optimized digital backward propagation in DQPSK transmission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We optimize digital backward-propagation (DBP) to compensate signal distortions for various launch powers and bit rates. By optimizing transmission parameters and nonlinear phase calculating point, multi-span DBP gives significant improvement.

articleTitle: Transmission coefficient enhancement in undoped Indium Arsenide by high THz field
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate enhancement of transmission coefficient in InAs due to THz field induced competition where intervalley scattering overcomes impact ionization. The controllable delay of THz pulse due to sample's increased refractive index is observed.

articleTitle: UV light emitter on bulk semipolar (11–22) GaN
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 392 nm GalnN-based UV light emitter has been demonstrated by homoepitaxial growth technique aiming to improve quantum efficiency by crystalline perfection of the heterostructures on naturally stable semipolar (11-22) bulk GaN.

articleTitle: An analysis of single-photon detectors in an environmentally robust gigahertz clock rate quantum key distribution system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a robust, BB84, 850 nm wavelength, gigahertz clock, phase encoding quantum key distribution system. This has been analyzed using a number of single-photon detectors and tested against predictions from our theoretical model.

articleTitle: Raman antenna formed by molecule/plasmonic nanostructure hybrid system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A nano-antenna composed of a particle and a polarizable surface provides control of the spatial distribution and high enhancement of Raman scattering. This structure may serve as a stable platform for single molecule detection.

articleTitle: Amplification to the period-doubling limit in an all-fiber regenerative amplifier for high-intensity laser systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical pulses at 1053 nm are amplified to 240 nJ in a Yb-doped all-fiber regenerative amplifier (AFRA) at the period-doubling limit. To the best of our knowledge, this is the highest AFRA output energy.

articleTitle: Motional narrowing of Dysonian lineshape in electron spin resonance of single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We performed temperature and power dependent electron spin resonance measurements on single-walled carbon nanotubes. Motional narrowing of the Dysonian lineshape was observed. Saturation behavior was seen at low temperatures and high powers.

articleTitle: Time-resolved x-ray diffraction with polycapillary x-ray optics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Picosecond X-ray diffraction using a quasi-collimating polycapillary optic and a laser plasma based X-ray source is demonstrated, significantly reducing data acquisition time for time-resolved studies.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal slot waveguide spectroscopy for the detection of chemical warfare simulants
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal slot waveguide based infrared absorption spectroscopy device is demonstrated for the on-chip spectroscopic determination of chemical warfare simulant triethylphosphate.

articleTitle: Fundamental quantum limit to waveform estimation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a quantum Cramer-Rao bound to the error of waveform estimation in quantum sensing. For optomechanical force sensing, we show that the bound can be achieved using quantum estimation and control techniques.

articleTitle: Effect of phase-transforming medium on coherent electron dynamics in gold nanoantennas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We probed the coherent plasmon dephasing time (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) in gold nanostructures while thermally modulating the surrounding VO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Our findings indicate three distinct lifetimes corresponding to the insulating, metallic and one at the phase-transformation onset.

articleTitle: Extreme ultraviolet free electron laser seeded by high-order harmonic
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We first generated seeded FEL radiation in the EUV region at 6L2 nm with the 13th harmonic of a Ti:sapphire laser. We observed single-peak spectra with drastic enhancements of intensity by nearly three-orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Design of a novel, cost-effective wide field-of-view surface-normal optical phased array
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel surface-normal slow-light photonic crystal waveguide optical phased array that can provide high speed (-MHz), wide angle (>;45degreex45degree) beam scanning capability, with a reduced fabrication effort.

articleTitle: Optical “tractor beams” with nonconservative forces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that, for an entire class of optical beams, nonconservative forces can point in a direction opposite to propagation wavevector. The properties of these forces are examined in the Rayleigh and geometrical optics limits.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of Fano resonance in a single whispering-gallery microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe Fano resonance in a single microresonator, in which two modes are excited simultaneously through a fiber taper. Our analysis reveals that the Fano resonance originates from an indirect-coupling of two originally orthogonal modes.

articleTitle: Explosions of xenon doped methane clusters in intense X-ray FEL pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interaction of ultrashort -X-rays laser with xenon doped methane clusters have been studied in the first experiments at LCLS with time-of-flight technique. Xe doping affects the explosion of the CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> clusters.

articleTitle: High-power mid-infrared optical parametric chirped-pulse amplifier based on aperiodically poled Mg:LiNbO3
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a 3.3-μm ultrabroadband, low-noise optical parametric amplification system based on aperiodically poled Mg:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> yielding 1.4 W average power at 100-kHz repetition rate. The output spectrum supports 56-fs transform-limited pulses.

articleTitle: High power short pulse generation at high repetition rate from InGaN violet laser diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The generation of 22 ps pulses with peak powers of 0.74 W by a gain-switched InGaN violet laser diode is reported. Significant pulse width dependence on repetition rate is observed.

articleTitle: Direct estimation of Purcell factor from scatterer-induced mode splitting spectra of an optical microcavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Scattering process in a microcavity coupled to subwavelength scatterers is investigated using synthetic nanoparticles, Erbium ions and Influenza A virions. Direct and single-shot estimation of Purcell factor is demonstrated using the scatterer-induced mode-splitting spectra.

articleTitle: Optical mode structure of a harmonically mode-locked Yb femtosecond fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that in the optical spectrum of a passive harmonically mode-locked Yb fiber laser all fundamental modes oscillate with equal intensity. This is possible when the spectral phase follows a quadratic distribution and it is favored over suppression of modes, which we attribute to the inhomogeneously broadened gain.

articleTitle: Generation of intense femtosecond laser pulse by compression of an idler pulse with an identical positive disversive media as signal pulse stretcher
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Idler pulses generated in ultrafast optical-parametric chirped-pulse amplification were compressed to sub-100 fs with an identical positive dispersive media as signal pulse stretcher, which is suitable for industrial applications.

articleTitle: New physics of subwavelength high contrast gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a simple yet precise theory, which explains the two main extraordinary features of optical gratings in the near-subwavelength regime: namely broadband high (>99%) reflectivity and ultra-high quality factor (Q∼2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) resonances.

articleTitle: Compact, narrow linewidth, continuous-wave, intracavity optical parametric oscillator pumped by a semiconductor disk laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the narrow linewidth (<;0.2nm) operation of a continuous-wave, intracavity optical parametric oscillator pumped by an InGaAs quantum-well semiconductor disk laser, delivering up to 300 mW of continuous-wave idler output power at 3.3 μm.

articleTitle: High power carrier-envelop phase stabilized 1030 nm pulses amplified from a Ti:Sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High power carrier-envelop phase stabilized 1030 nm pulses was generated by amplifying the fractional output spectrum of a passive mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser, exhibited 4.89 mHz long-term frequency fluctuation and 1.9 mHz beat signal line width.

articleTitle: Novel metal-cavity nanolasers at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and implement room-temperature substrate-free metal-cavity surface-emitting nanolasers, which are platform-insensitive, with microwatt CW output, of circular beam shape, better in thermal management, and capable of dense integration due to metal shielding.

articleTitle: Low-threshold whispering-gallery dye lasers by planar and 3D lithography on silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the planar and three-dimensional (3D) lithographic fabrication and optical characterization of microcavity lasers made of polymers doped with dyes with laser thresholds as low as 3 nJ per pulse at visible wavelengths.

articleTitle: Compact, diode-pumped Yb:YAG laser with combination acousto-optic and passive Q-switch for LIDAR applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a Yb:YAG laser equipped with both an acousto-optic and passive Q-switches. With this setup, we obtained 1 mJ/pulse energy and a pulse width of ~7 ns, at a repetition rate of 2 kHz.

articleTitle: Novel three-dimensional hollow-core waveguide using high-contrast sub-wavelength grating
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel hollow-core waveguide using high-contrast sub-wavelength grating (HCG) is experimentally demonstrated for the first time. The waveguide is formed by two HCG planar structures and shows both transverse and lateral light confinement.

articleTitle: Observation of gain due to Four-Wave-Mixing in photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate Four-Wave-Mixing in dispersion-engineered Photonic Crystal Waveguide. For 100ps pulses, the instantaneous conversion efficiency is -24 dB and for single ps pulses we demonstrate a 3dB parametric gain for Watt level pump powers.

articleTitle: Combined OCT and fluorescence imaging for cancer detection and therapeutic monitoring
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a co-registered optical coherence tomography (OCT) and fluorescence molecular imaging (FMI) system for simultaneous morphological and molecular imaging. This system enables real-time imaging of fluorescence-labeled gold nanoparticles and monitoring photothermal therapy.

articleTitle: Robustness of coherent SPE-OCDMA to combined dispersion impairments
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The sensitivity of spectrally phase encoded OCDMA performance in an environment of chromatic dispersion plus polarization mode dispersion with several signature sequence families is investigated.

articleTitle: Ultrafast laser processing of semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: SiOnyx is developing ultrafast laser processing techniques that improve the performance of semiconductor based photodetectors, solar cells, and image sensors. Ultrafast laser processing offers the unique ability to locally engineer the structural and doping characteristics of semiconductor devices and avoid adverse side effects. Ultrafast laser processing is incorporated into a variety of devices to increase the collection of longer wavelength light and improve quantum efficiency while maintaining scalability and CMOS compatibility.

articleTitle: Femtosecond fiber oscillator at 976 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a passively mode-locked fiber laser emitting around 976 nm. The laser emits chirped pulses with a duration of 1.02 ps and 12 nJ at 40,7 MHz. External compression leads to pulses as short as 286 fs.

articleTitle: New mid-IR gain media based on transition metal doped II-VI ternary — Quaternary compounds and glassy composites
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on crystal-field engineering of solid-state laser gain materials based on new transition metals (Iron and Chromium) doped II-VI Ternary (Quaternary) and Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> glassy composite materials for mid-IR tunable laser applications.

articleTitle: Broadband, spectrally flat frequency combs and short pulse sources from phase modulated CW: Bandwidth scaling and flatness enhancement using cascaded FWM
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a scheme to scale the bandwidth by several times while enhancing spectral flatness of frequency combs generated by intensity and phase modulation of CW lasers using cascaded four-wave mixing in highly nonlinear fiber.

articleTitle: Exploring 5th dimension of optical recording with ultrashort light pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> dimensional optical recording is demonstrated by means of ultrafast laser writing. The three spatial dimensions are supplemented by retardance and slow axis orientation of self-assembled form-birefringence in glass.

articleTitle: White emission from InGaN multi-quantum wells on c-planes and nano-pyramids hybrid structure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a white emission from InGaN multi-quantum wells (MQWs) on micro size c-planes and nano size hexagonal pyramids hybrid structure. Despite simultaneous growth, we achieve two different emission peaks of 461 nm and 568 from the MQWs on the c-planes and on the nano-pyramids, respectively. Using the structure, we achieve a white emission spectrum which is close to that of a phosphor-converted white light emitting diode (LED).

articleTitle: Plasmonic Aharonov-Bohm effect
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A wave-front phase dislocation due to the scattering of surface plasmons from a topological defect is directly measured in the near field by means of interference. The analogy to the Aharonov-Bohm effect is presented.

articleTitle: Er3+-doped diode-pumped ceramic laser delivers 14 W CW at 2.7-μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report diode-pumped Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>: Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ceramic laser with 14 W CW output at 2.7 μm and ~26% slope efficiency. This is believed to be the highest power ever reported from Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped ceramic laser at this wavelength.

articleTitle: Raman spectroscopy without spectrometer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using frequency-time transformation and time-correlated photon counting system we achieved highly sensitive Raman signal acquisition, which utilizes convenient optical fiber delivery system, shot-noise limited detection and provides discrimination against the fluorescence background.

articleTitle: Amplifier similaritons in a fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Parabolic self-similar pulses in an amplifier are realized theoretically and experimentally within a fiber oscillator. In addition to its fundamental importance, this new mode-locking regime offers ultrashort pulse durations from normal-dispersion sources.

articleTitle: Single-photon-level memory at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an efficient broadband optical single-photon-level room-temperature memory, capable of operating with a low unconditional noise floor in the quantum regime, with memory efficiencies exceeding 30% and storage times of up to 4 μs.

articleTitle: Hitless low-power all-optical absorption based switching with organics on silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical switching of a silicon ring-resonator using two photon absorption of engineered organic materials. We show hitless switching of 7dB change in extinction with power dissipation of 400 fJ/op.

articleTitle: Observation of image states in graphene on Ir(111) by two-photon photoemission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report observation of image states of graphene on Ir(111) using two-photon photoemission (2PPE). We also investigate the 2PPE dependence on graphene coverage, photon energy, and electron scattering angle to study the graphene-substrate interaction.

articleTitle: Second and third-order nonlinear optical effects in ZnO channel waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous self-phase modulation and second harmonic generation in ZnO channel waveguides. We estimate a value of γ = 13.9 ± 3.0 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, indicating that ZnO offers promise as a platform for nonlinear devices.

articleTitle: A one-dimensional hybrid photonic crystal microcavity in the strong coupling regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new hybrid photonic crystal cavity structure for one-dimensional polaritons by integrating a planar high-index-contrast grating into a vertical microcavity. It can be readily scaled up to coupled quasi one-dimensional arrays.

articleTitle: Passive mode-locking of a Tm:YLF laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Stable and self-starting mode-locking of a Tm:LiYF4 laser using a single-walled carbon nanotubes based saturable absorber is demonstrated. Pulses as short as 19 ps are generated at a wavelength of ~1888 nm.

articleTitle: Connecting two single molecules via single photons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the first direct excitation and spectroscopy of a single emitter using a stream of narrow-band single photons generated by a second emitter.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a scalable multi-photon entanglement source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel multiphoton entangling system that in principle can entangle any number of photons. Spatial degrees of freedom are replaced by temporal degrees of freedom. Four and six photon states are presented.

articleTitle: Triple photons and triple slits, a new frontier in quantum mechanics tests
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will present our recent results in the generation of triple photons as well as triple slits, both providing interesting perspectives on the foundations of quantum mechanics and quantum optics. The creation of correlated triple photons [1] is a highly desirable process for research on quantum optics, novel states of three-photon entanglement, and applications in quantum information processing. It was proposed over 20 years ago, but considered impossible to perform given the low conversion efficiencies in non-linear optics. We recently managed to solve the technical challenges, and demonstrate a source for correlated photon triplets. Strikingly, the interferences of single photons passing through a triple slit can be useful for experimental verification of Bora's rule, which is at the heart of the formalism of quantum mechanics. We will illustrate the background of the argumentation, and show the elegant experimental setup, which allows this direct test of Born's rule[2].

articleTitle: Photoacoustic imaging in biomedicine
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This tutorial will outline some of the fundamental physical principles of photoacoustic imaging, will describe key technological embodiments, and will finally describe exciting new applications in biomedicine.

articleTitle: Analysis of resonant cavity geometries in a THz TE1-mode parallel-plate waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe an experimental and computational study of the dependence of narrow resonances on geometry for rectangular resonant cavities in THz TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-mode parallel-plate waveguides. Increased Q-values can be obtained by modifying the cavity geometry.

articleTitle: Liquid crystals nonlinear optics — CW to femtoseconds all-optical signal processing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
