articleTitle: Temporal pulse compression in a Xe-filled Kagome-type hollow-core photonic crystal fiber at high average power
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We spectrally broaden 1-ps pulses from a 14.3-W, 10.6-MHz thin-disk laser in a 30.5-cm long Xe-filled HC-PCF. After compression, we achieve 9.1-W in 470-fs pulses (63% overall efficiency). No depolarization or damage is observed.

articleTitle: Measurement of laser-induced alignment of jet-cooled molecules using femtosecond degenerate four wave mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A degenerate four wave mixing setup for characterizing the alignment of jet-cooled molecules is described. This scheme allows characterization of asymmetric top alignment using arbitrary pump pulses, and is easily incorporated into an optimization loop.

articleTitle: A terahertz streak camera for the characterization of ultrashort laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a technique for the characterization of ultrabroadband and low-intensity laser pulses using spectrally resolved THz polarization streaking. Our method yields the spectral amplitude and phase without resorting to complex algorithms.

articleTitle: Optically controlled ultrafast enhanced transmission from a sub-wavelength aperture in a planar metal film
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically propose an ultrafast optical technique to control light emerging from a sub-wavelength aperture in a planar metal film through surface plasmon excitation by a transient-thermal grating.

articleTitle: Optical direct comparison of two 87Sr lattice clocks using a >50km fiber link
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: >;50km optical fiber link connecting NICT and Univ. of Tokyo has enabled direct comparison of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Sr lattice clocks locating in each site. Transmission instability 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup>@1s unveils sub-10Hz fluctuations of recently developed NICT clock.

articleTitle: Remote instantaneous frequency measurement system using optical mixing in highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel instantaneous frequency measurement using all optical mixing is demonstrated. This system can provide RF frequency measurement while requiring no high speed electronic components and remoting all components of the measurement system to the receiver.

articleTitle: Thermal effects in high-power fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effect of temperature gradients in Yb-doped fiber amplifiers is studied numerically. We investigate the dependence of the mode area on the signal power, and compare forward and backward pumping schemes.

articleTitle: Neutral dissociation of simple molecules in strong laser field
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report neutral dissociation of simple molecules in strong laser field, experimentally. Moreover, theoretical calculations of potential energy curves justify neutral dissociation through super excited states in all of the investigated gases.

articleTitle: High-energy temporally-shaped nanosecond-pulse MOPA based on Ytterbium-doped single-mode microstructured flexible fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a versatile MOPA system at 1053nm in the few nanoseconds regime. Thanks to temporal shaping, more than 1.5 mJ pulse energy at 1 kHz is obtained in a single-mode 40 μm core flexible fiber.

articleTitle: Cylindrical vector beam generation from a multi elliptical core optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A method for the generation of a cylindrical vector beam generation that is based on the design of a multi elliptical core optical fiber is demonstrated. Experimental and numerical results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: A fluid metamaterial with tunable anisotropy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a fluid metamaterial consisting of gold nanorods coated with an organic molecular corona, whose anisotropy can be controlled by applied mechanical shear force.

articleTitle: A strategy to experimentally find bound states of dispersion managed solitons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An experimental method to find bound states of dispersion managed solitons is presented. The pulse parameters are optimized with a genetic algorithm in a closed loop. Numerical tests of the method have already been successful.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of the transparency current density in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze the temperature dependence of the transparency current density in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers and assess its contribution to measured threshold current density for a laser with low voltage defect.

articleTitle: Optical forces in scanning probe microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that the mechanical action of light can be detected by a scanning probe microscope. The conservative and nonconservative electromagnetic forces can be directly measured and they affect the perceived topography.

articleTitle: Transversely stable soliton trains in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that transverse instability of soliton trains can be completely eliminated by photonic lattices if the soliton trains bifurcate from X points of Bloch bands with saddle shaped diffraction.

articleTitle: Varying-density hole-array grating fabrication for plasmonic waveguide sensors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Varying-density hole-array-embedded trapezoidal SPP waveguides are designed to halve the resonant spectral width and to reduce the EBL machine time by 20 fold. Experimental observations are shown.

articleTitle: 1-GW-peak-power, Cr:ZnSe laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first, to our knowledge, femtosecond, oscillator, chirped-pulse, regenerative-amplifier system based Cr:ZnSe. To date, we have generated, at a 1-kHz rate, 0.3-mJ, 300-fs pulses (1 GW peak power) centered at 2475 nm.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal enhanced fluorescence using a quartz substrate to reduce limits of detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Photonic Crystal surface fabricated upon a quartz substrate using nanoimprint lithography has been demonstrated with a signal enhancement factor as high as 7500x for the detection of LD-700 dye spin-coated upon the PC. The detection of spotted Alexa-647 labeled polypeptide on the PC exhibits a 330x SNR improvement. Using dose-response characterization of deposited fluorophore-tagged protein spots, the PCEF surface demonstrated a 140x lower limit of detection compared to a conventional glass substrate.

articleTitle: Zeno all-optical switching in a silicon ring resonator using inverse Raman scattering
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate all-optical control of a single resonance in a silicon micro-ring resonator using Raman-induced loss. Simulations indicate the potential for signal routing with >97% throughput using picojoule control pulses.

articleTitle: Advanced and delayed optical images through single and coupled image resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propagated transverse two-dimensional images encoded on optical pulses through a frequency window of coupled-image-resonator-induced transparency. The optical images are stored and delayed by 10.6 ns.

articleTitle: Nanoplasmonics for guiding, focusing and detection applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this talk we demonstrate configurations and devices that allow plasmonic assisted guiding and confinement of electromagnetic energy at the nanoscale. We also demonstrate silicon plasmonic Schottky detector for telecom wavelengths.

articleTitle: Coupled-resonator optical waveguide sensors using multi-channel spatial detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a proof-of-concept experiment of coupled-resonator optical waveguide sensors using multi-channel out-of-plane light scattering spatial detection. The sensor comprises 11 microdisks, which enables a sensitivity of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> RIU.

articleTitle: All-optical switching via inverse Raman scattering in an optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the observation of inverse Raman scattering (IRS) in optical fiber. The achieved level of attenuation via IRS in an optical fiber is >;20dB at a time scale <;5ps. We found good agreement between experimental data and theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: Spin symmetry breaking in thermal emission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a spin-symmetry breaking in thermal radiation from a coupled thermal antenna array, supporting localized phonon-polaritons, whose local anisotropy axis is rotated in space.

articleTitle: Plasmonic metamaterials coupled to single InGaAs-Quantum-well gain
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present low-temperature femtosecond-pump-probe measurements on arrays of split ring resonators above a single InGaAs-quantum well in which we study the coupling mechanism between the metamaterial and gain medium upon variation of their separation.

articleTitle: High efficient laser action by Nd3+ complex
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We obtained the slope efficiency of 20% and the maximum output energy of 5.3 mJ by Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> complex laser. To the best of knowledge, this is the highest slope efficiency in bulky lasers using Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> complex.

articleTitle: Molecular spectroscopy with laser frequency combs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The millions of precisely controlled laser comb lines produced with a train of ultrashort laser pulses can harnessed for highly-multiplexed molecular spectroscopy. Multi-heterodyne spectroscopy with frequency combs is emerging as a powerful new tool.

articleTitle: Highly confined hybrid spoof surface plasmons in ultra-thin metal/dielectric heterostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Highly confined "spoof" surface plasmons (SSPs) are predicted and observed in a perforated metal film coated with a thin dielectric layer. They are better confined than conventional guided modes and conventional SSPs and are controllable by the perforations geometry.

articleTitle: Diffractive coupling engineered sharp LC resonance in terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the fundamental LC resonance has its highest quality (Q) factor for a period matching the resonance wavelength in the substrate material. This occurs due to the simultaneous excitation of the lowest order diffraction mode.

articleTitle: Dual adaptive optics system for laser processing of diamond
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser fabrication depth in diamond is limited by refractive index mismatch induced aberrations that can be corrected by using adaptive optics; we demonstrate a dual active element system that considerably extends practical fabrication depth.

articleTitle: Ultrathin optomechanical SiNx nanomembranes with photonic crystal fano resonances for enhanced radiation pressure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate 50-nm-thick SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> photonic crystal nanomembranes for cavity quantum optomechanics, supported by complete ab-initio numerical simulations. Broadband normal incidence transmission measurements demonstrate Fano-type guided resonances near 1064-nm for enhanced reflectivity and radiation pressure effects.

articleTitle: Emergence of rogue waves from optical turbulence
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show the emergence of rogue wave events from optical turbulence by analyzing the long term evolution of the field. In particular, we identify three turbulent regimes depending on the incoherence in the system.

articleTitle: Physiologically relevant image reconstruction for small animals using optical diffusion tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental results for reconstructing physiologically relevant optical properties of a small animal using optical diffusion tomography.

articleTitle: Micro-pixellated blue/brown color changing surface using magnetically actuated nanocomposite actuators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new magnetically tunable color changing material and its operation method which enable both color generation and change within a single material. To achieve this, we fabricated micro-sized magnetic nanocomposite actuators for a single color changing unit and assembled them on the substrate. This method offers very simple fabrication and operation of color changing surface with high resolution.

articleTitle: Room-temperature operation of λ≈2.95μm In0.67Ga0.33As/ Al0.57In0.43As quantum cascade laser source based on intra-cavity second harmonic generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report λ≈2.95μm strain-compensated quantum cascade laser source based on intra-cavity second harmonic generation. The laser operates in pulsed mode at 298K with J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>=2.7kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and provides 30μW of second-harmonic radiation with 0.1mW/W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Rapidly tunable, wavelength agile, visible fiber based light source exploiting Raman scattering of multi-step pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a rapidly-tunable, wavelength-agile fiber laser exploiting stimulated Raman scattering of multi-step pump pulses which generates complex sequences of pulses of different wavelength.

articleTitle: Plasmonic apertures: A scalable plasmonic architecture for enhanced diamond single photon sources
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate that plasmonic apertures provide a scalable architecture for diamond NV center applications. Our results show that emission rates can be enhanced up to 60 times with collection efficiencies up to %40.

articleTitle: Dual-comb based measurement of frequency agile lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Properly stabilized, frequency combs form high accuracy references across much of the optical spectrum. Here we employ dual frequency combs to harness this accuracy for fast and high resolution measurements of frequency agile CW lasers.

articleTitle: Generation of continuous-wave Raman sidebands through degenerate and nondegenerate intracavity four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The phase-matched intracavity four-wave mixing is controlled by the total dispersion of the optical cavity. Continuous-wave Raman sidebands are generated through three different pathways depending on the phase-matching conditions.

articleTitle: Non-linear optical switch in liquid crystal polymer coated microspheres
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Kerr effect in a liquid crystal coated microsphere is used to switch reversibly and instantaneously a probe beam by a femtosecond pump. Shift magnitudes (2 GHz versus 250 MHz in CW) ruled out thermooptical effects.

articleTitle: High sensitivity plasmonic index sensor using slab-like gold nanoring array
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the index sensing characteristics of plasmonic arrays based on square lattice slab-like gold nanorings with different ring widths. High sensitivity of 691 nm per RIU is obtained for nanorings with 199 nm width.

articleTitle: High power, 60MHz, cryogenically cooled, mode-locked, Yb:YAG oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 60MHz, cryogenically cooled, mode-locked Yb:YAG oscillator with up to 12W average output power. Mode-locking is achieved via a SESAM, an intracavity SHG crystal, and an iris near focus for spatial mode filtering.

articleTitle: Plasmonic oligomers: The role of individual particles in collective behavior
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the transition from isolated to collective optical modes in plasmonic oligomers. Specifically, we investigate the resonant behavior of planar plasmonic hexamers and heptamers with gradually decreasing the inter-particle gap separation.

articleTitle: Frequency domain PMD monitoring and compensation in high-speed coherent systems with digital signal processing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed a PMD monitoring/compensation method in frequency domain for coherent system. With 15 ps of average DGD, the PMD induced penalty for 100-Gbit/s QPSK system is reduced by 9 dB at symbol-error-ratio of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>.

articleTitle: Tomographic imaging with lateral frequency modulation projections using a single-element detector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A lateral tomographic imaging technique that forms object projections with a single photodetector is demonstrated. A spatially-varying modulation applied to the illumination beam encodes object projections in the photodiode signal spectrum.

articleTitle: Photonic Zitterbewegung: Relativistic physics in waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the observation of relativistic wave evolution in a waveguide array. The high frequency trembling motion, known as Zitterbewegung is observed in specially designed waveguide arrays.

articleTitle: Enhancement on surface-emitting second-harmonic generation by counter-propagating fundamental beams in LiNbO3 channel waveguide by seven orders of magnitude
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By coupling two counter-propagating fundamental beams into a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> channel waveguide, we have generated a strong surface-emitting second-harmonic beam, with normalized conversion efficiency being enhanced by seven orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Quantum correlations using strong optical pulses in rare earth ion doped crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use photon echo based protocols with cryogenic rare earth ion dopants to create photon streams with time separated correlations. Theoretically, these streams are non-classically correlated. We present progress toward realizing this correlation.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation of Ti:S fs pulses using a passive cavity toward state detection of single indium ion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: VUV pulses at 159nm were generated as the 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> high harmonic of passively enhanced Ti:S fs pulses. The average output of 1.5μW might be sufficient to realize direct state detection of an indium ion clock.

articleTitle: Nanoantenna-enhanced ultrafast nonlinear spectroscopy of a single plasmonic nanodisc
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical nanoantenna increases the nonlinear transient absorption signal of a single 40 nm gold nanodisc by an order of magnitude. In agreement with our calculations the signal is spectrally shifted to the antenna resonance.

articleTitle: Type II parametric downconversion in a poled fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report photon-pair generation at the 1.5-μm telecom band via continuous-wave type-II parametric downconversion in a birefringent periodically-poled silica fiber. The time- and polarization-correlations of the downconverted light are examined.

articleTitle: Double-filament waveguides written in Nd:YAG ceramic with 2-ps UV laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on femtosecond laser writing of channel waveguides in Nd ion doped YAG ceramics by inscription of damage filaments using near-UV ultrafast laser source at two different pulse duration regimes.

articleTitle: Investigation of blueshift of photoluminescence emission peak in InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed peculiar behaviors on the dependence of photoluminescence emission peak on excitation fluence in InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells.

articleTitle: Morphology of femtosecond laser modification of bulk dielectrics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using 3D FDTD simulations, we study the morphology of the laser-created plasma inside fused silica. The most important effect responsible for plasma morphology is the electromagnetic pulse refraction by the generated plasma.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics in Al0.72Ga0.18N multiple quantum wells exhibiting varying internal quantum efficiencies
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-resolved photoluminescence studies of Mid-UV AlGaN multiple quantum wells grown by plasma-assisted molecular beam epitaxy reveal improved internal quantum efficiencies with increased carrier localization related to chemical ordering.

articleTitle: Anti-mirror effect
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a perfect lens can be utilized to make multiple objects appear like one. This anti-mirror effect may lead to applications in enhancing the illumination brightness of both incoherent and coherent systems.

articleTitle: Extracting the radiative, nonradiative and spin-flip rate of single self-assembled quantum dots in photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a practical method to extract the decay dynamics of neutral excitons in single self-assembled quantum dots and verified it experimentally.

articleTitle: Impurities and conductivity control in Al-rich AlGaN alloys
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: AlGaN alloys are recognized as promising materials for applications in optoelectronic devices in deep ultraviolet (DUV) spectral range. Highly conductive (p- and n-type) AlGaN alloys are essential for device applications. Although n-type AlN has been reported by Si doping, further improvements in the material quality and conductivity are still needed for many device applications. One of the major difficulties in obtaining highly conductive n-type Al-rich AlGaN alloys is the generation of deep level defects that compensate free electrons. By employing DUV photoluminescence spectroscopy, we have identified three electron compensating centers — isolated cation-vacancy with three negative charges (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">III</inf>)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3−</sup>, cation-vacancy-complexes with two negative charges (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">III</inf>-complex)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2−</sup>, and cation-vacancy-complexes with one-negative charge, (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">III</inf>-complex)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. The energy levels of these three deep level centers in Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>N (0 ≤ × ≤ 1) alloys are pinned to a common energy level in vacuum. It was observed that that suppressing the concentrations of these defects could significantly improve the conductivity and material quality of Al-rich AlGaN alloys and hence the performance of DUV LEDs. However, a far more serious issue for the realization of high performance DUV LEDs is the poor p-type conductivity of Al-rich Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>N, which is inherent to AlGaN. This issue is caused by the large acceptor activation energies (Ea) of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>N (as large as ∼500 meV in AlN). Since the free hole concentration (p) depends exponentially on acceptor energy level, p∼exp(-EA/kT), an Ea value around 500 meV translates to only 1 free hole for roughly every 2 billion (2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>) incorporated Mg impurities (at 300 K). This causes an extremely low free hole injection efficiency into the quantum well (QW) active region and is a major obstacle for the realization of high performance AlGaN-based DUV LEDs. We report on the growth, doping and optical and transport properties of p-type layers optimized for DUV emitter structure incorporation. Benefits of using AlN epi-templates in DUV emitter structures will also be elaborated.

articleTitle: Achieving Sub-Rayleigh resolution via thresholding
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sub-Rayleigh resolution by a factor proportional to [ln(N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>/N)]<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> is demonstrated through unstructured scanning of a focused classical beam across an object and dynamic application of a threshold N less than the maximum count level N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics in gas-filled HC-PCF in the plasma regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser-driven ionization in Ar-filled HC-PCF is accessed through self-compression of few-microjoule pulses. Modeling confirms that the observed blue-shifted spectral bands are caused by light-plasma interactions over an extended length in the fiber.

articleTitle: Large mode area fiber design with asymmetric bend compensation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A large mode area fiber design with asymmetrical bend compensation is proposed, demonstrating Aeff>;2800μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, low bend loss at 15cm radius, and reasonable suppression of higher-order modes.

articleTitle: Highly efficient, high power, inband-pumped Erbium/Ytterbium-codoped fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A highly efficient (~80%), high power (18.45 W) in-band pumped Erbium/Ytterbium-codoped fiber laser is demonstrated. Based on a fitted simulation model, the detrimental effect of pair induced quenching in high power operation is also highlighted.

articleTitle: Generation and near-field imaging of Airy plasmons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the generation and near-field imaging of propagating Airy plasmon beams. These self-accelerating plasmons exhibit self-healing properties and enable novel applications of plasmonics and surface optical tweezers.

articleTitle: Ultra-low phase noise microwaves from optical references
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show a photonic oscillator providing 10 GHz microwaves having L(f)=-104 dBc/Hz at 1 Hz offset and fractional instability ≤8 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-16</sup> at 1 s. These values are verified by operation and comparison of two independent systems.

articleTitle: Parametric tunable dispersion compensation for sub-picosecond optical pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the parametric tunable dispersion compensation can be applied to 400 fs pulses. After transmission through a 500 m DSF, 430 fs-width pulse could be restored.

articleTitle: Temporal shaping of Parabolic chirped pulses with 27 dB extinction ratio for fiber chirped pulse amplification systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel temporal pulse shaping technique for chirped pulses is presented. Parabolic pulses with residual error of less than 5% and signal to noise ratio of 27dB is achieved, ideal for chirped pulse amplification applications.

articleTitle: Ultrafast and high-spectral-density optical communications systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent progress on ultrafast coherent optical transmission toward 1 Tbit/s is overviewed, with a special focus on 640 Gbaud OTDM, 512 QAM with >; 10 bit/s/Hz spectral density, and ultrafast, spectral-efficient transmission with an OTDM-RZ/QAM scheme.

articleTitle: Resolving attosecond processes via high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The author presents an introduction to the field of attosecond science and reviews the progress in this field, discussing recent achievements and the basic limitations.

articleTitle: Intensity damping of Rabi-oscillations and renormalization of the Rabi frequency in InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The source of intensity damping of Rabi-oscillations in quantum dots has long been in question. Here we identify acoustic phonons as the principal source of dephasing and demonstrate the re-normalization of the Rabi-frequency.

articleTitle: Use of fundamental laser material interaction parameters in laser welding
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By using material interaction parameters in laser welding improvements in process phenomenological understanding and transferability are obtained. Using a new parameter, power factor, a more systematic method for specifying laser welding parameters has been developed.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of the coupling between short-rang SPP and dielectric waveguide mode
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The highly efficient coupling between the short range surface plasmon polariton (SRSPP) and conventional dielectric waveguide mode was observed. Based on this coupling, the SRSPP mode can be applied for novel integrated optoelectronic devices.

articleTitle: Terahertz metamaterials: Recent developments and new opportunities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The field of terahertz metamaterials is approximately six years old. I will overview recent developments in the design, fabrication, and characterization of metamaterials and discuss new opportunities which may help fill the ever shrinking THz gap and are, further, of fundamental interest.

articleTitle: Control of optical rogue waves in supercontinuum generation with a minute continuous wave
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically demonstrate that optical rogue wave in supercontinuum generated with picosecond pulse can be controlled by a minute continuous wave.

articleTitle: High power mid-infrared in-plane DBR laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optically pumped in-plane DBR mid-infrared laser is described. A quasi continuous-wave power of ~2.8 Watts is obtained at ~3.59 μm that is contained within a spectral width of ~5 nm.

articleTitle: Slow-light enhanced absorption switches in metal-dielectric-metal plasmonic waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce slow-light enhanced absorption switches in subwavelength metal-dielectric-metal plasmonic waveguides. Both decent modulation depth and moderate insertion loss can be achieved in such switches by small induced changes in refractive index.

articleTitle: Opto-fluidic detection platform for pathogen detection in water
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We prototyped a compact micro-fluidic based flow cytometer for pathogen detection in water. The system uses a pin-photodiode for detection and yielded a detection limit of ~200MEPE, sufficient to reliably identify and count specifically-tagged pathogens.

articleTitle: Direct observation of slow light in the noise spectrum of a laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The role of coherent population oscillations is evidenced in the noise spectrum of an ultra-low noise laser. The coherent population oscillations manifest themselves through their associated dispersion probed by the non-lasing side modes.

articleTitle: Large area near-IR optical ‘fishnet’ metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a CMOS compatible fabrication method for large area near-IR fishnet metamaterials. This process involves patterning a template structures using lithography and dry etching, depositing an Au-SiO2-Au stack and template lift-off.

articleTitle: Optimization of defect hole placement in resonant cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the resonance wavelength and quality factor dependence of 50nm defect-hole placement within photonic crystal L3 microcavities. Proper placement of defect-holes leads to a 12% increase in photonic crystal sensor detection sensitivity.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics near the single photon level with quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe our work on engineering nonlinear optical devices using quantum dots coupled to optical resonators. These systems enable large optical Stark shifts and all optical switching with only a few photons.

articleTitle: Polarization anisotropy of transient carrier dynamics in single Si nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first ultrafast time-resolved, polarization-dependent experiments on both single- and ensemble-silicon nanowires using non-degenerate spectroscopy. Anisotropy was observed for polarizations perpendicular and parallel to the nanowire.

articleTitle: Terahertz propagation through free-standing woven-steel-mesh metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Woven mesh metamaterials are investigated for THz frequencies. Pronounced amplitude transmission with 92% is observed. The spectral positions of surface-plasmon polaritons agree with the theory and abnormal group velocities occur between pass bands.

articleTitle: Octave spanning supercontinuum in an As2S3 taper using ultra-low pump pulse energy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An octave spanning spectrum is generated in an As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> taper via 77 pJ pulses from an ultrafast fiber laser. Chirp compensation allows the octave to be generated directly from the un-amplified laser output.

articleTitle: Octave-wide photonic band gap in three-dimensional plasmonic Bragg structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that a three-dimensional arrangement of particle plasmonic oscillators at Bragg distance leads to a superradiant plasmon mode. We observe the formation of a very broad photonic band gap that spans almost one octave.

articleTitle: Noise reduction by balanced detection in microwave photonic filters based on optical broadband sources
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a microwave photonic filter based on optical broadband source, of which the optical intensity noise is significantly suppressed through polarization-based balanced detection. The signal-to-noise ratio was increased by 15dB experimentally.

articleTitle: Production of ultracold molecular ion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental data to produce ultracold, internal ground-state molecular ions via sympathetic cooling with ultracold atoms. Ultracold molecular ions find applications in ultracold chemistry, precision measurement and quantum computation.

articleTitle: Optical characterization of semipolar GaN light-emitting diodes on sapphire
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Semipolar (11-22) GaN light-emitting diodes are grown on sapphire substrates by orientation controlled epitaxy. Optical emission properties are investigated, and narrow linewidth emission is shown for devices on this low dislocation density template.

articleTitle: Highly-efficient four-wave mixing in a coupled-nanocavity waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced optical nonlinearity in a coupled-resonator optical waveguide comprised of 200 silicon photonic crystal nanocavities. We have obtained the effective nonlinear constant γ as 6,600 /W/m through the four wave mixing experiment.

articleTitle: Optomechanical coupling in a two-dimensional photonic crystal defect cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally investigate the optomechanical properties of a conventional two-dimensional suspended photonic crystal defect cavity. Particularly, we measure localized mechanical modes in the GHz regime exhibiting high values of the optomechanical vacuum coupling rate exceeding 250 kHz.

articleTitle: Photoinduced critical slowing down of femtosecond hole spin relaxation in ferromagnetic GaMnAs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report for the first time photoinduced femtosecond hole spin dynamics and critical behaviors in a ferromagnetic semiconductor, revealing, in particular, a critical slowing down of hole spin relaxation near ferro- to paramagnetic phase transition.

articleTitle: 25.54% efficient single-junction GaAs Solar cells using spin-on-film graded-index Tio2/SiO2 AR-coating
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report high-efficiency single-junction GaAs Solar cells of 25.54% at one sun using a spin-on graded-index TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> films. Improved in efficiency, from 19.19% to 25.54%, was obtained when cell without/with proposed graded-index TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> AR-coating, respectively.

articleTitle: Bottom-up photonic crystal cavities formed by III-V nanopillar arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the optical properties of bottom-up photonic crystal cavities formed by selective-area epitaxy of III-V nanopillars. Photoluminescence spectra demonstrates influence of the photonic band-gap on the emission. Resonant cavity modes are observed.

articleTitle: Optical readout of micro tuning forks for spectroscopic applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interferometrically read-out micro tuning forks are used as small bandwidth acoustic wave detector in photoacoustic spectroscopy. A comparison to the piezoelectrically read-out QEPAS technique and a miniaturized future PAS sensor design is presented.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade laser master oscillator power amplifier with 1.5W output power at T=300K
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum cascade laser (QCL) master oscillator power amplifiers (MOPAs) reaching output power levels of P=1.5W at room temperature were realized. We discuss results and describe directions for future QCL MOPA design.

articleTitle: High-speed nanometer-resolved imaging-based laser vibrometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a new type of laser vibrometer that performs high-speed imaging-based surface vibration measurements with ~1 nm axial resolution at a record scan rate of 36.7 MHz without the need for beam scanning.

articleTitle: A 13C2H2 frequency-stabilized λ/4-shifted DFB laser diode with an external fiber ring cavity having a linewidth of 2.6 kHz and a RIN of −135 dB/Hz
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> frequency-stabilized λ/4-shifted DFB-LD with an external fiber ring cavity, which has a linewidth of 2.6 kHz and an RIN of -135 dB/Hz. The frequency stability reached as high as 2.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup>.

articleTitle: Characterization of the RIN-to-phase-noise conversion in the microwave synthesis from mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The noise conversion from the relative intensity noise to the phase noise in the microwave synthesis (photodetection process) from mode-locked lasers is investigated and is found to decrease as 1/f with the noise frequency.

articleTitle: 980-nm VCSELs for optical interconnects at 25 Gb/s up to 120°C and 12.5 Gb/s up to 155°C
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present high-speed high-temperature 980-nm VCSELs operating continuous-wave up to 200°C demonstrating clear open eyes at 12.5 Gb/s and 25 Gb/s at temperatures of 155°C and 120°C, respectively. 6-μm devices provide 1.4 mW at 155°C.

articleTitle: 4 GHz hybrid mode-locked fiber laser using PDMS/SWCNT thin film composite
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hybrid mode-locked fiber laser was built by using a PDMS/SWCNTs film as a saturable absorber. The system allows for a high repetition rate of 4 GHz, while achieving pulse widths of 730 fs.

articleTitle: Monolithic interferometer based on Gemini fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate a Gemini fiber with two branches bound by a glass bridge to create a stable monolithic Mach-Zehnder fiber interferometer and demonstrate the function of add-drop multiplexing with flat response over the entire C-band.

articleTitle: Analyses of polarization-multiplexed WDM transmission characteristics of high-order optical QAM signals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We analyze optical transmission characteristics of polarization-multiplexed WDM signals using 64-QAM and 256-QAM formats at 12.5 Gsymbol/s. XPM between WDM channels and two polarization tributaries limit the transmission distance below 1,000 km.

articleTitle: Giant AC Stark shift in germanium
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe a strong ultrafast AC Stark shift of the direct band transition in strained germanium quantum wells grown on silicon. At 150 meV, the maximum measured blue shift of the band edge is one order of magnitude larger than typically found in III-V materials. The power dependence shows a linear behavior between the electrical field intensity and the magnitude of the shift which is in good agreement with a dressed-exciton model. The coherent excitation dynamics in germanium are thus mainly governed by the direct transitions.

articleTitle: Recent progress on the PW beamline for SG-II-U laser facility
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The PW beamline for SG-II upgrade laser facility has been implemented. An OPCPA-based front-end system was setup and a 35-mJ pulse was injected into main amplifier. Up to 2kJ chirped pulse was delivered.

articleTitle: Abruptly autofocusing waves
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new classes of waves that tend to autofocus in an abrupt fashion. These waves can be generated through the use of radially symmetric Airy waves.

articleTitle: Saturation of the all-optical Kerr effect
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Kramers-Kronig transform of multiphoton ionization rates allows for a computation of the spectrally dependent nonlinear refractive index change and predicts its intensity dependent saturation and inversion in remarkable agreement with recent experimental results.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional laser lithography with conceptually diffraction-unlimited lateral and axial resolution
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By transferring concepts from stimulated-emission-depletion microscopy to Direct Laser Writing, we improved its lateral and axial resolution significantly. Thus, woodpile photonic crystals with 300-nm lateral rod spacing can be fabricated routinely.

articleTitle: Demonstration of side coupling between high power laser diode array and double-clad fiber using sub-wavelength grating
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A sub-wavelength gold-embedded silica binary grating for side coupling light emission from a 976-nm high-power laser diode array into the 400-μm-diameter inner cladding of a double-clad fiber was demonstrated with near 50% overall coupling efficiency.

articleTitle: Two-photon resonance spectroscopy of single quantum-dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study two photon absorption resonances in single semiconductor quantum dots, using polarization sensitive two beam time resolved spectroscopy. The rich spectrum of the biexciton resonances is fully understood, for the first time.

articleTitle: Effects of growth temperature on epitaxial thin films of vanadium dioxide grown by pulsed laser deposition
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Stoichiometric vanadium dioxide in all of its bulk, thin film and nanostructured forms exhibits an insulator-to-metal transition (IMT) accompanied by structural change, induced by various physical and chemical stimuli such as temperature, ultrashort light pulses, electric field, doping or strain. In these applications, the optical qualities of the films are of paramount importance, but are often highly variable depending on fabrication procedure. We have grown epitaxial films of vanadium dioxide on c-plane (0001) of sapphire using two different procedures involving room temperature growth followed by annealing and direct high temperature growth. Strain at the interface of the substrate and the film due to growth at different temperatures leads to significant differences in morphologies and phase transition characteristics. We present a comparative study of the morphologies and switching characteristics of the two films and conclude that contrary to conventional wisdom, the room-temperature grown films have smoother, more continuous morphologies and better switching performance. Our observation is supported by theoretical and experimental studies of epitaxial growth of semiconductors.

articleTitle: MEMS spatial light modulator for spectral phase and amplitude modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new Micro-Electro-Mechanical-System (MEMS) spatial light modulator with micromirrors designed to piston. This diffractive MEMS modulator is to be used for independently applying amplitude attenuation and phase control along one dimension.

articleTitle: Optical parametric generation of mid-infrared picosecond pulses beyond 6 μm in CdSiP2
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report parametric generation of near- and mid-infrared picosecond pulses at 100 kHz in CdSiP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> pumped at 1.064 μm, providing 154 mW of idler at 6.204 μm and 1.16 W of signal at 1.282 μm.

articleTitle: Resolved sideband laser cooling of a cryogenic micromechanical membrane
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have implemented an optomechanical system consisting of a high finesse cavity centered on a low reflectivity, high mechanical quality factor SiN membrane at a temperature of 400 mK.

articleTitle: Metal-grating trapezoidal plasmonic waveguide sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metal-Bragg-grating-embedded trapezoidal SPP waveguides are fabricated using a novel enclosure method. We will show theoretical and experimental data demonstrating a device having 1100 nm/RIU detection sensitivity.

articleTitle: The effects of spurious loss/gain in numerical simulations
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effects of spurious loss and gain from error are investigated in numerical simulation of four-wave mixing. Results are compared to previously published results and it is demonstrated that these data suffered from erroneous gain.

articleTitle: Doubly resonant optical parametric oscillator: A generic transmitter architecture for DIAL
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Entangled cavity doubly resonant optical parametric oscillators are able to provide high peak power, single longitudinal mode emission, with wide tuning range and high frequency stability, which make them well suited for multi-specie DIAL.

articleTitle: Correlations between light at spectrally distant wavelengths in coupled microring resonator waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that propagation through a silicon microring coupled-resonator optical waveguide can introduce spectral correlations between two or more light sources separated by almost 1 THz over information bandwidths upto 40 GHz.

articleTitle: Lighthouse ultrafast spectroscopy: High speed scanning with a spinning birefringent delay crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple method for high speed pump probe spectroscopy that maintains interferometric stability is presented. The lighthouse scanner demonstrates significant improvement ultrafast nonlinear spectroscopy signal to noise level by averaging large number of scans.

articleTitle: On the mechanism of efficient coupling into slow light photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate effects of evanescent modes on light coupling into low light mode of photonic crystal waveguides. Numerical and experimental results show that group index tapering does not have a dominant role for efficient coupling.

articleTitle: Equiangular spiral tellurite photonic crystal fiber for supercontinuum generation in Mid-Infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate very low and flat dispersion (±2ps/nm/km, slope<;0.0028ps/nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/km@1.8-2μm) in the Mid-Infrared band along with high non-linear coefficient (γ=1155W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>@1.93μm) achieved in a tellurite photonic crystal fiber for generating supercontinuum with a broad bandwidth.

articleTitle: Key factors in achieving ultra-broadband THz emission from a laser-induced gas plasma
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate how the observed emission of ultra-broadband THz pulses (>;100 THz) from a two-color (ω-2ω) laser-induced gas plasma is strongly dictated by the precise spectral and temporal characteristics of the input optical fields.

articleTitle: 1.16 PW sub-30fs Ti:Sapphire laser system of seeding with optical parametrical amplified femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generated 32.3J laser pulse at 27.9fs from a Ti:sapphire laser facility based on chirped-pulse amplification with optical parametrical amplified femtosecond laser as new seeding, result in peak power of 1.16 PW with high contrast.

articleTitle: Broadband direct frequency comb spectroscopy in the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Frequency-comb-based Fourier transform spectrometer operating in the 2100-3600 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> range is presented. System allows rapid acquisition of broadband high resolution (120 MHz) spectra, detecting ppb-level concentrations of various molecules in 30s.

articleTitle: Quantum sensors, computing, metrology, and imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum states of light can be used to make measurements and produce images beyond classical limits. We review recent advances in producing such states of light using ideas from optical quantum computing.

articleTitle: Autonomous optical buffer with function of storing multiple packets in each of fiber delay lines
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An autonomous first-in-first-out buffering system consisting of feedback-looped parallel fibers is proposed. Each fiber can store multiple packets. Buffering performances such as packet loss rate and delay time are improved compared to previously reported system.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase matching in nonlinear metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We employ nonlinear metamaterials to demonstrate alternative quasi-phase matching (QPM) methods not feasible in natural materials. Additionally, we propose a method for dynamic QPM via resonance tuning, allowing for a tunable frequency of operation.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced Raman scattering enhancements from silver atomic layer deposition coated nanowire
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Significant enhancement in SERS response from periodic and aperiodic arrays of nanowires coated with silver by atomic layer deposition was observed in comparison to other deposition methods. SERS detection at 10 meters was also observed.

articleTitle: Parallel direct modulation laser transmitters for high-speed high-sensitivity laser communications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate new power-efficient techniques for generating high-fidelity waveforms from directly modulated lasers using periodic high-contrast spectral and temporal windowing. Real-time optical M-FSK communication experiments demonstrate flexible and scalable transceiver designs with record sensitivity.

articleTitle: Low cost absorption sensors for networked applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Evolution of the laser sources and associated measurement tools provide new opportunities for absorption-based gas sensors. This paper highlights recent work by the authors using mid-IR sources that target two emerging market segments for monitoring major atmospheric species: (1) compact, low-cost sensors for distributed networks, balloons, and unmanned air vehicles; (2) ultra-precise sensors for monitoring local small changes in background levels.

articleTitle: Measurement and control of electric currents in Ar and N2 filaments
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spontaneous currents inside the plasma column of filaments of N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and Argon circulate in opposite directions. A competition between the laser Lorentz force and a Coulomb wake force explains the difference.

articleTitle: Very slow carrier cooling in graphene measured by optical/THz pump-probe spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present results on the relaxation dynamics of photoexcited carriers in graphene using optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy. Our measurements indicate that carrier cooling is extremely slow at low temperatures where electron-optical phonon cooling becomes inefficient.

articleTitle: Pump-probe detection of surface-bound organophosphonate compounds
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a pump-probe approach for the detection of organophosphonate compounds on substrates, in which the pump pulse fragments the parent molecule and the released phosphorous monoxide (PO) fragment is probed using laser-induced fluorescence.

articleTitle: 40-photon-per-pulse spectral phase retrieval by shaper-assisted modified interferometric field autocorrelation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on spectral phase retrieval of 400 fs pulses using shaper-assisted modified interferometric field autocorrelation. The coupled energy is only 5.2 aJ per pulse, corresponding to an unprecedented sensitivity of 2.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> mW<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic two-photon fluorescence and second harmonic generation endomicroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present updates on recent developments of a fully integrated, ultracompact fiber optic scanning endomicroscope for nonlinear optical imaging. Approaches to significantly improve signal collection efficiency and resolution will be discussed.

articleTitle: Bench top milli-joule energy-level nanosecond pulse delivery through hollow-core fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the fabrication of a large pitch hollow-core fiber designed for maximizing energy transmission at 1064nm. Due to an air-mode/silica overlap reduced to 0.05%, a first demonstration of 4mJ nanosecond-pulses coupling is achieved.

articleTitle: Organic materials with negative and controllable electric permittivity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that metal-free materials with negative real parts of the electric permittivity can be realized experimentally and their dielectric functions can be controlled by laser illumination.

articleTitle: Simultaneous morphological and biochemical imaging of oral epithelial cancer in a hamster cheek pouch model
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the results of an animal study aimed at determining the value of collecting both morphological and biochemical images for oral cancer diagnosis using a multimodal optical coherence tomography and fluorescence lifetime imaging system.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband THz semiconductor laser based on heterogeneous quantum cascade gain medium
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report broadband laser emission from a quantum cascade laser based on heterogeneous gain medium. Gapless emission exceeding 1 THz bandwidth is reported around 2.66 THz (40% of the central frequency) from devices operating in double metal waveguides. Pulsed operating temperatures of 125 K with peak powers of 14 mW at 10 K are observed. CW operation is demonstrated and 1 THz bandwidth is observed above 80 K in pulsed mode. Time-resolved spectral analysis with 5 ns resolution revealing strong mode competition is also discussed.

articleTitle: True phase-matched third-order DFB terahertz quantum-cascade lasers using weakly-coupled cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a novel laser cavity design in third-order distributed feedback terahertz quantum-cascade lasers based on true phase-matching technique. This approach dramatically in creases the usable length of third-order DFB lasers and leads to even narrower beam patterns and likely higher output power. Single frequency emissions from 150 apertures (5.6-mm long device) are coherently added up to form a narrow beam with ~6° divergence. Similar device with 40 apertures shows more than 5mW optical power with slope efficiency ~40mW/A at 10K pulsed operation.

articleTitle: Microfabricated surface trap for scalable ion-photon interfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a surface electrode ion trap microfabricated on top of a dielectric mirror, with the ion 169 μm above the trap surface. This represents a scalable approach to trapped ion quantum computing with photonic interconnects.

articleTitle: An ultra-sensitive DC and AC accelerometer using dual superluminal zero-area L-shaped ring lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a pair of zero-area superluminal ring lasers, each configured in an L-shape, can perform as an ultrasensitive DC and AC accelerometer, with sensitivity as small as 10 pico-g/√Hz, and high dynamic range.

articleTitle: Prospects of heterodyning in electro-optic detector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We derive and discuss conditions for the heterodyning in electro-optic detector of the electric field. Proof of principle of this technique is provided for detecting terahertz radiation.

articleTitle: FIR analog filter dependence of HCG-based Hollow-core Waveguides upon varying of waveguide parameters
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We designed and characterized a high performance narrow band FIR filter based on the low loss High Contrast Grating (HCG) Hollow-core Waveguides (HCW) with at least 30 dB rejection and 0.1 dB power leakage.

articleTitle: High resolution THz-TDS using flare coupled metal parallel-plate waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the microwave approach of coupling terahertz radiation into metal parallel-plate waveguides. The coupling ratio is compared to the quasi-optic coupling using silicon lenses. High resolution terahertz spectroscopy of micro-crystalline films is presented.

articleTitle: Cooling of a micromechanical oscillator into the quantum regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using optical sideband cooling, a micromechanical oscillator is cooled to a phonon occupancy below 10 phonons, corresponding to a probability of finding it in its quantum ground state more than 10% of the time.

articleTitle: Observation of strong coupling through transmission modification of a cavity-coupled photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe a transparency in the transmission spectrum of a photonic crystal cavity mode coupled to a waveguide due to the presence of a strongly coupled quantum dot in the cavity. At high pump powers the QD is saturated, and the bare cavity spectrum is recovered.

articleTitle: Semipolar AlN on bulk GaN for UV-C diode lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of nonpolar or semipolar AlGaN for UV-C diode lasers avoids the compromises in gain, injection efficiency, and ohmic losses imposed on c-plane lasers by the unusual valence band structure of AlGaN alloys.

articleTitle: Enhanced omnidirectional photon coupling via quasi-periodic patterning of indium-tin-oxide for organic thin-film solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Enhanced optical coupling with respect to all incident angles via an indium tin oxide quasi-periodic structure (ITO-QPS) for organic thin-film solar cells was demonstrated. The cell efficiency shows 13.8% enhancement after ITO-patterning.

articleTitle: Effects of exchange, phase space filling, and screening on 1s–2p 2D excitonic transitions
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the 1s-2p exciton transition in a quantum well. If the ratio of free carrier to 1s exciton density is greater than 0.15%, screening dominates exchange and phase-space filling, yielding a red shift.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of the “rainbow” trapping effect in adiabatic plasmonic gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Direct measurements on graded grating structures show that light of different wavelengths in the 500–700nm region is “trapped” at different positions along the grating, consistent with theoretical predictions, thus verifying the “rainbow” trapping effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of spur-free dynamic range of a semiconductor resonant cavity linear interferometric intensity modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Numerical simulation of spur-free dynamic range (SFDR) of an injection locked semiconductor resonant cavity interferometric intensity modulator is presented. Theoretically calculated values are in good agreement with experimental results.

articleTitle: Unidirectional emission of a quantum dot coupled to an optical nanoantenna
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show unidirectional emission of a single Q-dot by coupling to a nanofabricated Yagi-Uda antenna. The Q-dot drives the resonant feed element and 82% of the Q-dot emission is emitted in a 12° HWHM angle.

articleTitle: Efficiency droop reduction in InGaN/GaN light-emitting diodes by graded-thickness multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InGaN/GaN LED with graded-thickness MQWs has superior hole and radiative recombination distribution by simulation modeling, and electroluminescence spectrum reveals additional emission from the narrower wells. Output power and efficiency droop behavior are both improved.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy of oriented Ge and Ge/Si core/shell nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the time- and frequency-dependent terahertz dynamics of oriented Ge and Ge/Si core/shell nanowires using ultrafast optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy, and we compare their intraband relaxation, interband recombination and momentum scattering times.

articleTitle: Ultrafast THz saturable absorption in doped semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate ultrafast THz saturable absorption in n-doped semiconductors by nonlinear THz time-domain spectroscopy. This effect is caused by the semiconductor conductivity modulation due to electron heating and satellite-valley scattering in strong THz fields.

articleTitle: Quantum spatial super-resolution by the optical centroid measurement method
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally a new procedure for obtaining spatial super-resolution in quantum imaging by measuring optical centroid. Our results show spatial resolution enhancement identical to that of quantum lithography but with higher detection efficiency.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic circular dielectric grating for efficient free-space extraction of single quantum dot emission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a suspended circular grating for efficient, broadband photoluminescence spectroscopy of single self-assembled InAs quantum dots. Collected photon rates are 20 times greater than in bulk, and significant radiative lifetime reduction is observed.

articleTitle: In-line and compact QWIP for reference signal detection with Quantum Cascade lasers at 4.6μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By implementing quantum well infrared photodetectors (QWIPs) as passive optical elements, we present a novel approach to obtain a reference signal needed in gas spectroscopy systems based on reflection and transmission properties of these photodetectors.

articleTitle: High sensitivity detection of NO2 using ICOS and MLIAS
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Employing an external cavity QCL and using OA-ICOS and multiple line integrated absorption spectroscopy techniques, we report an effective sensitivity of detection of ~28 ppt for NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in Zero-Air.

articleTitle: Singly-resonant optical parametric oscillator in adhesive-free-bonded periodically inverted KTiOPO4 plates: Achieving oscillations at dual wavelengths
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Based on adhesive-free-bonded periodically inverted KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> plates, we implemented a singly-resonant optical parametric oscillator, which has superior advantages of compensating walk-off and oscillating dual-signal wavelengths based on QPM.

articleTitle: Simultaneous modulation and transmission of CATV and radio-over-fiber signals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This study experimentally demonstrates a hybrid transport system. The obtained CNR, CSO, CTB and bit-error-rate performance, not only satisfy the requirements for CATV system, but also satisfy the demand for high-quality radio-over-fiber system.

articleTitle: A self-luminescent horizontal slot microdisk resonator for biosensing applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design and fabricate a self-luminescent horizontal slot microdisk resonator using visible light emission of Si-ncs for biosensing. The surface sensitivity of the sensor is calculated as 2.46 nm/(nm-RIU) using FDTD method.

articleTitle: 2THz optical waveform measurement by development of digital holographic synthesizer & analyzer of 400GHz optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical complex electric field spectra of a 400 GHz optical frequency comb were controlled by a colorless optical synthesizer. The synthesized 2 THz high-speed optical waveform was measured by a proposed multi-heterodyne mixing method.

articleTitle: Ultracompact monolithic broadband in-line micro interferometric sensor based on multi-beam interference
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadband micro interferometric sensor based on multi-beam interference using a singlemode fiber end-spliced with an end-sphered hollow-core fiber lens. The length of sensor head is less than 240μm and displacement resolution is 0.8nm.

articleTitle: Sub-100fs pulse generation from a fiber oscillator mode-locked by nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an ultrafast fiber laser based on carbon nanotube saturable absorber. 84 fs pulses are generated directly from the fiber oscillator with 61.2 nm spectral width.

articleTitle: Selectively providing virtual private network (VPN) services in TDM-PONs with Manchester coding
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: With Manchester coding induced spectral shaping, high-speed optical VPN service channels can be added in a low-speed legacy TDM-PON. The VPN service upgrade can be selective and causes no disruption to the remaining service users.

articleTitle: Transition from amplified spontaneous emission to superfluorescence from biexcitons in semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A transition from amplified spontaneous emission to superfluorescnece from biexcitons in semiconductor quantum dots was observed with increasing the excitation density under resonant two-photon excitation of the biexcitons.

articleTitle: Spectral amplitude and phase evolution in petawatt laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The influence of the active gain medium on the spectral amplitude and phase of amplified pulses in a CPA system is studied. Results from a 10-PW example based on Nd-doped mixed glasses are presented.

articleTitle: 18-Fold power reduction using Bragg grating-based switch in highly-nonlinear bismuth-oxide fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a Bragg grating-based all-optical switch in a highly nonlinear Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> fiber. We achieve 18-fold power reduction for a 6.5 dB switching ratio compared with previous demonstrations in silica fibers.

articleTitle: Demonstration of coherent beam combination of fiber amplifiers in 100ns-pulse regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first experimental coherent beam combining of two fiber amplifiers in 100ns-pulse-regime using a signal leak between the pulses. The ~100W SBS-limited peak power pulses are combined with 95% efficiency and λ/27 phase error.

articleTitle: Lasing and spontaneous emission in gap-plasmon mode Bragg grating waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show strong spontaneous emission modification in subwavelength gap-plasmon mode Bragg grating metal waveguides. The gratings are extremely broadband and have a coupling factor significantly higher than the strongest dielectric gratings.

articleTitle: One step non-contact fabrication of polymer microlens arrays by thermocapillary lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Thermocapillary lithography, a continuous-relief patterning technique, is used to fabricate polymer microlens arrays with variable pitch and focal length. Pattern definition results from sculpting by thermocapillary forces imposed by a cooled mask.

articleTitle: All-reflective Ti:Sa power amplifier for Petawatt laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An all-reflective Ti:Sa power amplifier capable of extracting up to 60 joules has been designed. The power amplifier consists of four passes through a 100mm Ti:Sa crystal really imaged by off-axis parabolas enclosed in a vacuum chamber.

articleTitle: Low-loss silicon-on-diamond optical waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
