abstract: Low-loss optical rib waveguides (2.5 μm × 700 nm) have been fabricated on a silicon-on-diamond (SOD) substrate. 0.74 dB/cm propagation loss is measured. Benefits to heat dissipation for active photonic devices are studied.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave mid-infrared frequency conversion in silicon nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report continuous-wave wavelength conversion from the telecom band to the mid infrared via four-wave mixing in silicon nanowaveguides. We convert a 1636-nm signal to produce a 2384-nm idler, demonstrating a parametric bandwidth of 748 nm.

articleTitle: Dual-wavelength, two-crystal, continuous-wave singly resonant optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a novel generic design for cw singly-resonant-parametric-oscillators(SROs) based on two crystals, providing two signal waves with arbitrary tuning from the same cavity. Using this source we generate two distinct wavelengths with frequency difference 0.556THz.

articleTitle: 1-ps Thin disk amplifier for advanced materials processing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate femtosecond and picoseconds thin disk laser amplifiers based on Yb:YAG as gain material. We obtained a pulse duration of 1 ps in a chirped pulse amplification (CPA) scheme and a pulse duration of about 30 ps in a CPA-free amplifier configuration. Pumped by a max of 70W we obtained an average output power of 20W and pulse energies up to 500μJ.

articleTitle: Observation of auto-focusing radially symmetric Airy beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optical beam auto-focusing without the need of a focusing lens or nonlinearity. Radial Airy beams with inward and outward accelerations are used and an abrupt transition between Airy and Bessel behavior is observed.

articleTitle: Tunable optical coupling in a low-loss hollow core waveguide using adiabatically chirped high-contrast-gratings and MEMS actuators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A low insertion loss optical coupler is designed using chirped high-contrast-grating hollow-core waveguide. 100% tuning of power coupling ratio is realized through mechanically adjusting the waveguide height by ∼3 um.

articleTitle: Silicon nanowire/Poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene): Poly(styrenesulfonate) core-sheath heterojunction solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon nanowire (SiNW)/Poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS) solar cells were fabricated by solution process. The nanowires of 370 nm were coated with PEDOT:PSS. The short circuit current density and power conversion efficiency are 27.46 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 8.05%, respectively.

articleTitle: Tunable high-energy soliton pulse generation from a large-mode-area fiber pumped by a picosecond time-lens source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate high-energy soliton pulse generation from a large mode area fiber, tunable from 1560 nm up to 1700 nm, pumped with a 10 MHz, 1.5-ps time lens source at 1544 nm.

articleTitle: Solid-state polymer waveguide DFB laser with self dye-circulatory function
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated a novel solid-state DFB dye laser with self dye-circulatory function. The nano-porous structure of hybrid PDMS/silicone provides dye mobility and optical transparency. The output recovery was demonstrated high repetition rate pumping.

articleTitle: Low light-level two-photon absorption using tapered optical fibers in rubidium vapor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe an experimental observation of two-photon absorption with ultralow power levels of less than 150 nanoWatts. The experiment involves the use of sub-wavelength diameter tapered optical fibers suspended in rubidium vapor.

articleTitle: Squeezing-enhanced adaptive optical phase estimation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate squeezing-enhanced adaptive optical phase estimation for a stochastically varying phase. By using a continuous-wave phase squeezed beam, estimation accuracy is improved by a factor of 1.4 compared to a coherent beam case.

articleTitle: Characterization of polymer microtoroid resonators fabricated by two-photon stereolithography process
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of high-Q microtoroid resonators made of low loss modified polymers by the two-photon stereolithography process. We found that polymer resonators can be fabricated in a high-speed process, and measurements showed a maximum Q factor of 2.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: Femtosecond dynamics of superconducting and spin-density wave gaps in pnictides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study Ba(Fe,Co)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> by combined ellipsometry and ultrabroadband terahertz pump-probe experiments. The distinctive destruction/recovery dynamics of the superconducting and spin density wave gaps as well as coherent oscillations are resolved.

articleTitle: Tabletop generation of carrier envelope phase stabilized multi-mJ few-cycle pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A compact system for the generation of few-cycle multi-mJ carrier envelope phase (CEP) stabilized pulses is presented. The output 5.4 fs, 1.9 mJ pulses have CEP noise of only 190 mrad rms over seven hours.

articleTitle: Adaptive wavefront aberration correction in a free-space fiber-optic system based only on the received power
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce adaptive wavefront aberration compensation in a free-space communication system, using solely the fiber-coupled power metric. A custom algorithm operating a spatial light modulator is able to recover from losses as high as -30dB.

articleTitle: An optically pumped phonon laser in a silicon micromechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and explain phonon "lasing" ("PhASER") in a photo pumped micromechanical cavity that exhibits all the characteristic of a standard laser near threshold and is described by the standard laser equations.

articleTitle: Effects of inter-electron correlation before ionization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a classical ensemble method, we predict that electron-electron correlation before first ionization leads to measurable effects in both nonsequential and sequential double ionization regimes. Laser field ellipticity is key to observe these effects.

articleTitle: High sensitivity, simultaneous second- and third-order autocorrelation measurement in a GaAsP photomultiplier tube
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method for high sensitivity measurement of pulsed light using a GaAsP photomultiplier tube. 2nd- and 3rd-order autocorrelations are obtained simultaneously by modulating the input power and analyzing the RF harmonic components.

articleTitle: Band filling in p-doped InAs quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Measurements of modal gain spectra show differences in band filling for un-doped and p-doped quantum dot samples which we show is associated with a transition to a non-thermal regime as the temperature is reduced.

articleTitle: CdSe/ZnS quantum dot embedded hollow toroidal microcavities and their modal properties
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricated a light-emitting hollow toroidal micro-cavity by applying low temperature heat treatment to a polymer thin film micro-disk containing CdSe/ZnS quantum dots and investigated their modal properties from quantum dot emission spectra.

articleTitle: 330 MHz repetition rate femtosecond Yb:Fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 330 MHz repetition rate operation in a ring cavity Yb:fiber laser with novel and compact devices. The spectral bandwidth of the pulse is 30 nm and the dechirped pulse width is 48 fs.

articleTitle: Time-to-space conversion at 1.55μm by non-degenerate SFG
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first demonstration of time-to-space conversion of 1.55μm femtosecond optical pulses using non-degenerate, collinearly phase-matched sum-frequency generation. A quasi-monochromatic output signal with a resolution of 10 was obtained.

articleTitle: A fast response photonic crystal fiber grating refractometer with a side-opening structure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic crystal fiber grating refractometer with a side-opening structure is proposed and studied, which can achieve real time response, minimal refractive index resolution of 1.32×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> R.I.U and high efficient grating writing.

articleTitle: Long-term stable passive synchronization of 50-μJ, 690-fs, 0.4-MHz Yb-doped fiber amplifier with a mode-locked Ti:Sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report long-term stable passive synchronization of a 50-μJ, 690-fs, 0.4-MHz Yb-doped fiber chirped-pulse amplifier with a mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser as long as 8 hours with a timing jitter of 42 fs.

articleTitle: Optofluidic waveguides with Ta2O5 cladding layers and low photoluminescence
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new type of hollow core waveguide fabricated with Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> films is demonstrated. The photoluminescence background of ARROW waveguides is decreased significantly by replacing Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> with Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> films, while maintaining low optical losses.

articleTitle: Lifetest of the High Output Maximum Efficiency Resonator (HOMER) laser for the SAFFIRE instrument on NASA's DESDynI project
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We update the status of a diode-pumped, Nd:YAG oscillator that is the prototype laser for NASA's DESDynl mission. After completing TRL-6 testing, this laser has fired over 5.5 billion shots in lifetesting.

articleTitle: A platform for three-dimensional on-chip photonics: Multi-bonded Silicon-on-insulator wafers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel platform for three dimensional photonics. A double layer 1×12 multimode interference coupler is fabricated on a double-bounded Silicon-on-insulator wafer. Optical characterizations confirm low insertion loss and uniform outputs.

articleTitle: Intracavity second harmonic generation in quantum cascade lasers pumped by femtosecond Mid-IR pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Room temperature second harmonic generation at λ=2.2 μm has been obtained from a 4.5 μm quantum cascade laser resonantly pumped by TM or TE polarized λ=4.5 μm femtosecond pulses through the front facet.

articleTitle: Projection of two biphoton qutrits onto a maximally entangled state
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the projection of two quantum three state systems (qutrits) onto a maximally entangled state. The qutrits are represented by the polarization of biphotons — pairs of indistinguishable photons.

articleTitle: Standoff chemical detection using quantum cascade lasers and photoacoustic sensing techniques
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Standoff chemical detection using quantum-cascade-lasers as pump sources and photoacoustic techniques for sensing is demonstrated for the first time. With <;40mW laser power, a chemical detection distance of more than one meter has been achieved.

articleTitle: High-power terahertz generation due to dipole radiation within InGaN/GaN multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have generated broadband THz pulses within eight periods of InGaN/GaN quantum wells due to dipole radiation following generation of spatially-separated electrons and holes. Output powers as high as 1 μW have been obtained.

articleTitle: 15 ps quasi-continuously pumped passively mode-locked 2.4% doped Nd:YAG laser in bounce geometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Passive mode-locking of a quasi-continuously pumped 2,4% Nd:YAG slab in a bounce geometry is reported. The 500 μJ trains with 15 ps pulse duration and excellent stability ± 2 ps were generated.

articleTitle: Self-injected petawatt laser-driven plasma electron acceleration in 1017 cm−3 plasma
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report observation of electron self-injection and acceleration in a plasma accelerator driven by the Texas petawatt laser at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> plasma density, an order of magnitude lower density than previous self-injected laser-plasma accelerators.

articleTitle: Speed investigations toward an industrial application of optical trap assisted nanopatterning
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical trap assisted nanopatterning is a viable method of producing parallel nanoscale features over rough surfaces and large areas. The maximum writing speed on various surfaces is elucidated to evaluate the performance of the method.

articleTitle: Sub-40 fs Er:Fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simulation and experiment results are presented for sub-40 fs pulse generation in Er:fiber ring lasers.

articleTitle: Suppression of filamentation in semiconductor lasers via carrier-induced wavefront tilt
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An analytic model demonstrates filamentation suppression via tilted optical wavefront induced by transverse profiling the injection current. Numerical simulations show a significant collapse of the far field and a 67% increase in device brightness.

articleTitle: Optical emission from fused silica ejecta following localized exposure to nanosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the emission of ejected material during laser ablation of fused silica. The kinetic properties of the ejected particles are also resolved. The results help better understand the transient state of the ejected material.

articleTitle: Parametric replication and sampling of optical fields
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New class of optical processors that rely on wideband, net-gain mixers is described. Principle, operation and limitations of copy-and-sample-all parametric architectures are briefly outlined.

articleTitle: Rigorous quantification of polarized fiber continuum generation for broadband coherent optical sources
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a polarized coherent continuum source based on a dispersion-flattened dispersion-decreased all-normal dispersion fiber (DFDD-ANDiF). The rigorous quantification of continuum generation permits broadband ultrashort pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband tunable wavelength conversion of sub-picosecond pulses in a silicon nanowire
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a tunable wavelength conversion of sub-picosecond pulses based on four wave mixing in a dispersion engineered silicon nanowire. A 100-nm tuning range of the converted wavelength is demonstrated with an almost constant conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Average enhancement factor of molecules-doped coreshell on fluorescence
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose the average enhancement factor of a molecule-doped coreshell (Ag@SiO2) on fluorescence to estimate the overall performance of a large number of coreshells. Results are in good accordance with experimental data.

articleTitle: Cascaded higher-order soliton compression
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically demonstrate high-degree and high-quality optical pulse compression using cascaded higher-order solitons in optical fiber.

articleTitle: High-power radially-polarized Er:YAG laser with Laguerre-Gaussian (LG01) mode output
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple method to allow direct excitation of the first-order Laguerre-Gaussian mode has been applied to a hybrid Er:YAG laser. The laser yielded 13.1W of radially-polarized LG<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> output at 1645nm for 34W of pump power.

articleTitle: Synthetic aperture ladar flight demonstration
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper describes a demonstration of synthetic aperture ladar imaging at 1.5 micron wavelength from an airborne platform at a distance of 1.6 km showing a 30x cross range resolution improvement over the spot size.

articleTitle: Free-space photon storage with variable time delays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss a high-efficiency “digital” photon storage system using multiple optical cavities to create variable storage times.

articleTitle: Quasi passive optical switch based on transition metal oxide device
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose optical switch architecture based on transition metal oxide material. It use electrical field to change oxygen vacancy distribution and its optical property such as absorption coefficient. We demonstrate the absorption coefficient of such device can be latched in binary state, which is useful for optical networking and interconnect applications.

articleTitle: Identifying edge chirality of graphene using polarization resolved μ-Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Development of optoelectronic devices based on the bandgap of nanosctructured graphene requires knowledge of edge chirality. We show that polarization resolved Raman spectroscopy can be used to determine the fractional edge composition of graphene.

articleTitle: Waveguide saturable absorbers in chalcognide glass fabricated by ultrafast lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a waveguide gap structure for nonlinear coupling, written in chalcognide glass with an ultrafast laser. The coupling efficiency between two waveguides is enhanced by the self focusing of shorter and stronger input pulse.

articleTitle: Tracking molecular binding to nanostructures using CO2 snow jet on plasmonic SERS substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Carbon dioxide snow jets are used to eject and rearrange molecules attached to nanostructured plasmonic surfaces. Tracking the dynamics of such perturbations provides strong insight into the origin of different contributions to SERS.

articleTitle: Laser pulse energy control using a high speed digital feedback controller
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a novel electronic feedback scheme which allows laser pulse energy control and stabilization by using a custom high speed FPG A digital controller. This scheme was tested on a high-energy fiber-laser-pumped Ho:YLF ring laser.

articleTitle: Coupling molecular photoluminescence into deep sub-wavelength plasmon waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate Purcell enhancement of spontaneous decay rate up to 60 times and luminescence intensity up to five-fold from dye molecules strongly coupled to a non-resonant deep-subwavelength metal-dielectric hybrid plasmon waveguide.

articleTitle: Single-frequency photonic bandgap fiber amplification
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-frequency operation in an ytterbium-doped photonic bandgap fiber amplifier is presented for the first time. 16 W, 1178 nm narrow linewidth radiation, free from both amplified spontaneous emission and stimulated Brillouin scattering, was obtained.

articleTitle: Diverging Rabi oscillations in sub-wavelength photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that Rabi oscillations between Bloch-modes of an waveguide array with sub-wavelength periodicity diverge, in both frequency and field amplitude, when the optical wavelength approaches a mathematical exceptional point where the Bloch-mode become self-orthogonal.

articleTitle: Space-and-time-resolved spectroscopy of single GaN nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatially-resolved ultrafast transient absorption measurements on a single GaN nanowire give insight into carrier relaxation dynamics as a function of the laser polarization and position on the nanowire on a femtosecond timescale.

articleTitle: Fiber transport of spatially entangled qutrits
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the successful transport of spatially entangled qutrits through a photonic crystal fiber. We test entanglement in two 2D subspaces; in one of them we show violation of a Bell inequality.

articleTitle: Broadband coherent anti-stokes Raman microspectroscopy with shaped femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrabroadband excitation brings CARS microspectroscopy to the next level. An extended spectral range opens up a wealth of information, while shaping schemes tailor the excitation for optimal signal generation.

articleTitle: Development of Transient Absorption Ultrasonic Microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a novel hybrid imaging modality, Transient Absorption Ultrasonic Microscopy, that integrates nonlinear absorption with photoacoustic detection to achieve high resolution absorption imaging. Basic principles and recent progress will be discussed.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation near 2 μm in periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate spectral broadening and self-frequency-shift around 2-μm wavelengths in periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguides, in agreement with simulations. We show numerically that octave-spanning spectra can be achieved with 6 nJ of pulse energy.

articleTitle: Controlling THz wave transmission through organic copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) films on Si by optical excitation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that transmission of THz waves through an organic copper phthalocyanine (CuPc) film on a Si wafer can be controlled by optical excitation. The carriers excited in silicon are injected into a CuPc film and transport along well-ordered direction of a CuPc film, resulting in making a CuPc film metallic and decreasing the THz transmission. Modulation efficiency depends on the phases of CuPc films. CuPc film/Si layers can be exploited for THz optical modulators.

articleTitle: On the isotropic magnetic response of fabricated core-shell clusters and its ability to cloak
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate a scatterer comprising a dielectric core and randomly distributed metallic nanoparticles forming a shell. We show that it acts as an isotropic magnetic meta-atom and as a cloak to conceal the core.

articleTitle: Quasi-TEM mode propagation in dual-wire THz waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated that Quasi-TEM modes in non-subwavelength dual wire THz waveguides (twin lead) can exhibit significant end-fire coupling (>;10%) and broad band low dispersion below lps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/m.

articleTitle: Scattering phenomena in PT-symmetric optical systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the general scattering properties of balanced gain/loss (PT-symmetric) optical structures, without restriction to the paraxial approximation. The scattering eigenstates exhibit a PT-symmetry breaking transition, with experimentally accessible consequences.

articleTitle: Improvement of image resolution beyond classical limit by phase-sensitive optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: When an optical parametric amplifier (OPA) operated as a phase-sensitive amplifier (PSA) is used for point source imaging, the angular resolution improvement can defeat the classical Rayleigh limit, and approach the de Broglie resolution.

articleTitle: Superior warm-white light-emitting diodes integrated with quantum dot nanophosphors for high luminous efficacy and color rendering
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum dot nanophoshor hybridized warm-white LEDs are reported to exhibit high photometric performance of luminous efficacy exceeding 350 lm/W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">opt</sub> and color rendering index close to 90 at correlated color temperatures <;3000 K.

articleTitle: TOF-range image sensor in 0.18μm CMOS technology based on current assisted photonic demodulators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a 0.18μm CMOS range image sensor with 120×160 array of 10×10μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> photonic demodulation pixels allowing for real-time 3D imaging with a worst-case accuracy of 3.3% in the distance interval [1.2-3.7] m.

articleTitle: Laser linewidth tolerance of coherent optical 64QAM and 16PSK systems using decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The exact bit-error rate of 64-quadrature amplitude modulation (64QAM) is derived. By using decision-aided maximum likelihood phase estimation, it is found that 64QAM has almost the same laser linewidth tolerance as 16-phase-shift keying.

articleTitle: High-speed second harmonic generation holographic microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present three-dimensional images of biological samples using nonlinear optical, holographic microscopy. The femtosecond oscillator operates at a wavelength with low scattering in the sample and its low average power prevents damage to the samples.

articleTitle: Ultrafast dynamics of semiconductor interband transitions in THz fields up to 4 MV/cm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Phase-locked multi-THz transients bias semiconductors far above the usual threshold for dielectric breakdown. Few-cycle NIR pulses synchronized to the THz transients on an as-timescale, probe interband transitions under electric fields of 4 MV/cm.

articleTitle: Optofluidic lock-in spectroscopy on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce for the first time the implementation of optofluidic lock-in spectroscopy of sub-nanoliter analyte on a microfluidic chip. Two methods, spatial modulation and pneumatic modulation with integrated optofluidic modulator, were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of decoherence suppression by quantum measurement reversal
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated that the decoherence due to amplitude damping can be suppressed using quantum measurement reversal. By implementing two partial measurements, we succeeded in preferentially selecting the cases where states do not experience decoherence.

articleTitle: Growth and characterization of deep ultraviolet emitting AlGaN structures on SiC substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report MBE growth of AlGaN structures emitting below 250 nm on SiC substrates. We found that the IQE of the MQWs and DHs is as high as 68% and 43% respectively.

articleTitle: Molecular orientation by intense visible and THz optical pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an all-optical method for molecular orientation by using intense visible and THz optical pulses. We show numerically that the highest degree of orientation <cos θ>∼0.6 in HBr is feasible under experimentally available conditions.

articleTitle: Single nanoparticle detection using a microcavity laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical microcavity laser is utilized for label-free detection of single nanoparticles. Detection limit is significantly improved due to the ultra-narrow laser linewidth compared to the resonance linewidth of a passive microcavity.

articleTitle: Observation of Young's double-slit interference with the three-photon N00N state
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of a three-photon NOON state exhibiting Young's double-slit type spatial quantum interference. Compared to a single-photon state, the three photon entangled state generates interference fringes that are three times denser.

articleTitle: Passively phase-locked Er:Fiber technology
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a passively phase-locked seed source for fs-Er:fiber technology with CEO-frequency set to zero. The broadband output is reamplified and phase locking is monitored by means of an f-2f interferometer.

articleTitle: Terahertz frequency magnetoelectric phenomena in condensed matter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Magnetoelectric(ME) correlation in condensed matter provides unique opportunity to electrically control the magnetization or vice versa. We report on terahertz frequency ME phenomena such as electromagnon in multiferroics and exotic Hall effect.

articleTitle: Toward a picometer displacement-sensing interferometry for the next generation of calculable capacitor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high resolution Fabry-Perot interferometer system is designed to measure displacement by measuring both the cavity mode spacing and absolute mode position shifts. We achieve a fractional uncertainty of 2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>/√Hz without any optical frequency standard.

articleTitle: Sheet optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate cavity phase matching for the first time using a sheet optical parametric oscillator. It presents unique features such as high power capability, high slope efficiency, single-longitudinal-mode oscillation and narrow line width.

articleTitle: Influence of nonadiabatic tunneling ionization on short-wavelength-driven high harmonic generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High harmonic generation efficiency is theoretically modeled and compared with experiments using 400 and 800 nm driver pulses. Our study shows that for short drive wavelengths nonadiabatic tunneling ionization leads to enhanced low order harmonics.

articleTitle: Shot-noise limited sensitive detection of OH radicals by Faraday rotation spectroscopy at 2.8 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the development of a Faraday rotation spectroscopy instrument using a DFB diode laser operating at 2.8 μm for the hydroxyl (OH) radical detection with a 1a detection limit of 8.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> OH radicals/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Ultrafast GaAs nano-whisker photodetector for THz-frequency applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have designed and fabricated novel, free-standing GaAs nano-whisker (NW) detectors and demonstrated their femtosecond photoresponse. The NW device was characterized using a femtosecond, time-resolved (THz bandwidth) electro-optic sampling method. Electrical photoresponse transients as short as 600 fs were recorded and their frequency-domain analysis indicated that the intrinsic NW photodetector response bandwidth was well above 2 THz, enabling THz-frequency applications.

articleTitle: High-fidelity 165-fs 5-μJ pulses from an integrated ytterbium fiber system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Energy scaling of μJ fs pulses from monolithic YDFAs is limited by pulse pedestal formation. We demonstrate a chirped-pulse fiber-amplifier that uses a newly developed dispersion compensating fiber stretcher matching the dispersion of a grating pair.

articleTitle: Sub-nanosecond electro-optic modulation of triggered single photons from a quantum dot
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Telecommunications-band single photons from a quantum dot are amplitude modulated on timescales fast compared to its radiative decay. Control of single photon wave-packets is an important resource for developing hybrid quantum systems.

articleTitle: Topological surface modes in photonic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design reconfigurable 'all-optical' photonic structures which can support 'one-way' surface modes. These modes are defined by the topology of the structures and must be robust and tolerant to external perturbations.

articleTitle: Quantum control of two-photon inter-excited states transitions
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate quantum control of two-photon inter-excited states transitions in a V-type atomic system. By varying linear and quadratic chirps, we project the transitions to coherent transient phenomena in a two-level system.

articleTitle: Single-beam CARS imaging for reacting flow diagnostics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Imaging of a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas jet in ambient air via single-beam CARS method is demonstrated. This method will be applied to examine reacting flow systems and flames for diagnostic measurements.

articleTitle: Bayesian analysis of parity based detection scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using Bayesian analysis we characterized the performance of phase estimation in the Mach-Zehnder interferometer with two-mode squeezed vacuum input. Phase uncertainty, averaged over many trials, is examined and the dependence on photon number is found.

articleTitle: Two photon absorption effect of terahertz radiation from low-temperature-grown GaAs photoconductive antennas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the possibility of enhancing terahertz radiation power though two-photon absorption induced extra photo-carrier in photoconductive antenna. Meanwhile, competition between single photon absorption and two photon absorption for terahertz radiation are discussed as well.

articleTitle: Frequency stable coupling of laser oscillators using gain gratings in Nd:YAG
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: To realize frequency-stable operation of a Q-switched loop resonator, a passive coupling scheme based on gain gratings is numerically investigated. Existing numerical models are extended to two spatial dimensions and selected results are presented.

articleTitle: Add-drop filter incorporating a mode-conversion cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new add-drop filter architecture combining an asymmetric Y-branch mode conversion waveguide and a high index contrast shifted grating mode-conversion cavity. Measurements show add-drop functionality in a linear Fabry-Perot filter.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electron diffraction using femtosecond Electron pulses from laser-produced plasmas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated single-shot measurement of electron diffraction patterns for a gold crystal using laser-accelerated 350-keV electron pulses. The electron pulse duration was shortened to be 500 fs on the crystal by a magnetic pulse compressor.

articleTitle: Two-photon accessed excited state absorption in bis(terpyridyl osmium)-(porphinato)zinc
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two-photon absorption properties of a (terpyridyl)osmium-(porphinato)zinc (OsPZnOs) are studied in bulk and waveguides. Integration of OsPZnOs (δ1300GM) in waveguides showed enhanced nonlinear performance and potential for photonic applications.

articleTitle: Two-way secure communication using quantum illumination
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A two-way entanglement-based communication protocol resilient to high loss and noise is implemented. Even though the entanglement is lost during transmission, efficient communication that is secure against passive eavesdropping is possible.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade lasers for sensing CO2 isotopic fingerprints
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a quantum cascade laser for detecting <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> isotopes for use in fingerprinting CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions from sources such as power plants and carbon storage reservoirs. The lasers emit a single mode at 4.32 μm in continuous wave operation.

articleTitle: Plasmonic complementary fractal photoconductive emitter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new class of photoconductive THz emitters based on a complementary Sierpinski fractal is presented. The self-similarity of plasmonic current present on the antenna surface results in superior performance compared to conventional bow-tie emitters.

articleTitle: Upconversion with Ho3+ and Tm3+ codoped lead lanthanum zirconate titanate ceramics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using Ho<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Tm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> codoped PLZT ceramic gain media, excellent upconversion was observed and investigated. A new model was proposed, leading ways towards upconversion-based laser and sensor development.

articleTitle: Electron density of the femtosecond optical filament in air
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first direct radially and axially space-resolved measurement of electron density over the full length of a femtosecond optical filament in air, allowing elucidation of the air nonlinearity leading to beam collapse.

articleTitle: Second-order nonlinearity distribution in a doped silica glass multilayered structure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Corona poling of a multilayered stack of phosphorus-doped and undoped silica glass layers on a fused silica substrate results in the formation of two 8 μm-wide nonlinear regions located near both surfaces of the sample.

articleTitle: Laser microstructuring and processing in printing industry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New laser sources and modulation techniques enforce laser processing methods to improve existing and to open new applications in the printing industry. Laser engraving, the fastest and most versatile process for the gravure cylinder fabrication was improved with high power MOPA fiber lasers. Embossing applications are enforced by high power ps-lasers and fast extra cavity modulation of high power cw lasers (120 W@ 20 MHz) opens the door for printing with laser induced direct ink transfer.

articleTitle: Highly simplified device for measuring the intensity and phase of picosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an extremely simple device with only three easily aligned components for measuring the intensity and phase of ps pulses. We report intensity-and-phase measurements of 15ps long pulses with a time-bandwidth product of 21.

articleTitle: Optical techniques for tracking cells in vivo
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: I will focus on tracking cancer cells, immune cells, and stem cells in vivo using (i) intravital microscopy for 3D tissue imaging, and (ii) in vivo flow cytometry for detection and quantification of circulating cells.

articleTitle: Design of Optical Pulse Envelope Ring Oscillator (OPERO) and fabrication in generic InP technology
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new clock pulse generator is a non-lasing, low threshold (~100 mA), high efficiency (~4 mW/mA) semiconductor Optical Pulse Envelope Ring Oscillator ('OPERO') circuit, containing two cross-coupled SOA sub linear wavelength converters.

articleTitle: Ultra-precise focusing multimodal microprobes for contact laser tissue surgery
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using numerical modeling it is demonstrated that chains of spheres with a refractive index of 1.65-1.75 provide two times more compact focused beams compared to single spheres under conditions of illumination typical for laser surgery.

articleTitle: All-optical particle trap using two orthogonally intersecting beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a novel optical particle trap using two orthogonally intersecting beams. The trapping principle is described and an optofluidic implementation using liquid-core waveguides is discussed.

articleTitle: Sequence of events during the catastrophic optical damage in broad-area lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Kinetics of catastrophic optical damage in diode lasers is monitored for 650, 808, and 980 nm emitting devices. The power-decay time-constants after degradation increase with wavelength pinpointing the better thermal properties of 980 nm barrier/waveguide materials.

articleTitle: Time domain model of a gain medium fitted to pump-probe experiments
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an ADE-FDTD model of gain media fitted to pump-probe experiments with dye(Rh800)-epoxy composite deposited on ITO-silica substrate. The experiment-fitted parameters of the 4-level ADE system are instrumental to modeling active nanoplasmonic devices.

articleTitle: Synthesis of materials by ultrafast microexplosion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microexplosions triggered by single femtosecond laser pulses tightly focussed inside a crystalline or amorphous host can be used to create high-pressure/density forms of nano-materials via an unconventional synthesis pathway: multiply ionized plasma, separation by diffusion, thermal quenching.

articleTitle: Generation of a macroscopic singlet state in an atomic ensemble
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an experiment underway for generating singlet states in a cold atomic ensemble. We use quantum non-demolition measurement and feedback control to produce a macroscopic spin state with total spin zero and reduced spin fluctuations. We have developed a new detection system with the capability of real time measurement and feedback control. Simulations indicate that optical pumping is a good candidate for feedback.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporally focused femtosecond laser pulses for anisotropic writing in optically transparent materials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simultaneous spatial and temporal focusing provides precise control of the pulse front tilt necessary for anisotropic writing and maintains this behavior over a large range of focal positions and at low numerical aperture and fluence.

articleTitle: Hyperfine aperiodic optical superlattice optimized by iterative domino algorithm for phase-matching engineering
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose hyperfine aperiodic optical superlattice optimized by iterative domino algorithm to achieve arbitrary discrete and continuous phase-matching power spectra. This scheme improves the record overall efficiency by 9% and handles >;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> blocks.

articleTitle: Launching single photons into plasmonic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coupling single quantum emitters with plasmonic structures opens the way towards their quantum applications. However both, reliable and flexible launching of single excitation quanta and a detailed investigation of coupled quantum plasmonic system have been missing so far. We study the interaction of defect centers in diamond, molecules with thin metal wires, and bow tie and other antenna structures. By investigating the coupling efficiency as well as the coupling mechanism we achieve an improved insight into the quantum plasmon interaction.

articleTitle: Performance guidelines for WDM interconnects based on silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We derive fundamental performance tradeoffs that determine bandwidth and optical power budget in large-scale WDM links or networks utilizing silicon microresonators. Bandwidth per waveguide scales to >;1THz, but nonlinearities limit optical power to milliwatt levels.

articleTitle: Optical gain in GaInNAs and GaInNAsSb quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experiments show that 1.55 μm GalnNAsSb wells have improved gain -radiative current characteristics over 1.3 μm GalnNAs, one contributory factor being reduction in inhomogeneous broadening, raising the question whether Sb could bring benefits for 1.3 μm devices.

articleTitle: Long-range fiber-transmission of photons with orbital angular momentum
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate propagation of light possessing orbital angular momentum over record fiber-lengths (~km) with minimal cross-talk (<;20-dB). This yields a novel degree of freedom for encoding information in fibers for quantum or classical communication links.

articleTitle: High-speed data transmission in multi-layer deposited silicon photonics for advanced photonic networks-on-chip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a multi-layer silicon photonic microring resonator filter, fabricated using deposited materials, and transmit up to 12.5-Gb/s error-free data, establishing a novel class of high-performance silicon photonics for advanced photonic NoCs.

articleTitle: Low-power 30 Gbps silicon microring modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon microring modulator is demonstrated utilizing IBM CMOS Silicon Nanophotonics technology, achieving 30Gbps operation at a power consumption of ~335fJ/bit in a device suitable for monolithic integration.

articleTitle: 3D In situ mapping of focused cylindrical vector beam using trapped Rayleigh nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optically trapped Rayleigh nanoparticles are used as nanoprobes to map in situ the three-dimensional field distribution of a focused cylindrical vector beam. Intensities calculated from measured trapping energy shows good agreement with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: 32 Gb/s multilevel modulation of an 850 nm VCSEL for next-generation datacommunication standards
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An 850 nm vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser is modulated at 32 Gb/s using pulse amplitude modulation with four levels. Transmitter predistortion generates an optimized modulation waveform, which requires a receiver bandwidth of only 15 GHz.

articleTitle: A 16-fs aperture-jitter photonic ADC: 7.0 ENOB at 40 GHz
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A photonic ADC based on balanced detection, phase encoded optical sampling, wavelength multiplexing, and electronic quantization is demonstrated. It achieves 7.0 ENOB resolution at a 2GSa/s sub-sampling rate for a 40 GHz input analog signal.

articleTitle: Tunable coherent Raman soliton generation with a Tm-fiber system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength tunable coherent Raman soliton generation in a Tm fiber amplifier seeded with a passively mode locked Tm fiber oscillator and subsequent octave spanning continuum generation in highly-nonlinear fibers.

articleTitle: Characterization of THz beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using THz radiation as reliable measurement tool requires the accurate knowledge of beam properties. We present approaches to scan beam profiles and measure the radiation power traceable to SI units between 0.1 and 2.5 THz.

articleTitle: Ultraintense x-ray induced multiple ionization and double core-hole production in molecules
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We used the world first hard x-ray FEL to investigate the response of molecular systems to the ultraintense, femtosecond x-ray radiation. We report sequential multiphoton ionization, frustrated absorption and double core hole production mechanisms.

articleTitle: Ultrasensitive on-chip photonic crystal nanobeam sensor using optical bistability
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An ultrasensitive nonlinear cavity sensing method is proposed and demonstrated, in which the detection limit is not bounded by the quality factor of the cavity. 10mg/dL glucose concentration and 100aM BSA molecules are detected.

articleTitle: Comparison of comb-line generation from InGaAsP/InP integrated ring mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compare comb-line generation from a 30 GHz gain flattened ring mode-locked laser and two standard 30 GHz ring mode-locked lasers. The gain flattened ring has a 1.32 THz spectral width whereas the other devices have 420 and 630 GHz spectral widths.

articleTitle: DPSK modulation using a microring modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of DPSK modulation using a microring modulator. A 250-Mb/s electro-optic silicon microring modulator is shown with a measured 2-dB power penalty in comparison to a commercial LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> phase modulator.

articleTitle: Compressive sensing LIDAR for 3D imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a proof-of-principal implementation of a single-pixel lidar for 3D imaging. Spatial resolution is obtained through compressive sensing. This technique allows for imaging through partially obscuring objects, such as foliage or camouflage net. Our implementation improves on multipixel designs with better SNR, a compact design, and highly scalable resolution.

articleTitle: UV light generation induced by microwave microplasma in hollow-core optical waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally observed for the first time the built up of a microwave microplasma in gas filled hollow-core waveguides with internal diameter down to 65μm. Ultraviolet wavelengths have been generated and guided directly inside the hollow-core.

articleTitle: An extended spectral angle map for hyperspectral and multispectral imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an extension to the widely used spectral angle metric, calculating an azimuthal angle around a reference vector. We demonstrate that it provides additional information, thus improving the classification ability of the spectral angle.

articleTitle: Compact 7.4 W femtosecond oscillator for white-light generation and nonlinear microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a passively mode-locked two-crystal Yb:KGW oscillator delivering 7.4 W average power at a repetition rate of 41.7 MHz and 425 fs pulse duration and demonstrate the generation of high-power supercontinua in tapered fibers.

articleTitle: Brillouin fiber laser with incoherent feedback
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on all-fiber Brillouin fiber laser utilizing feedback caused by Rayleigh scattering in a telecom fiber instead of one cavity mirror. The results of the experimental measurements are in a perfect agreement with the theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Low-loss polysilicon waveguides suitable for integration within a high-volume electronics process
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Polysilicon waveguides are fabricated in a 300 mm wafer process representative of a complete high-volume electronic memory process. 6.2 dB/cm end-of-line loss is measured for narrow waveguides with a confinement factor scaling of 5.1 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic range sensing based on amplified spontaneous emission noise radar with Kramers-Kronig phase retrieval
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Amplified spontaneous emission is used as an optical noise source for range sensing. A depth resolution of 30cm and detection of multiple targets is achieved at a range of 2km, using novel Kramers-Kronig algorithms.

articleTitle: Generation of a telecom-to-mid-infrared spanning supercontinuum using silicon-on-insulator wire waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an ultra-broadband optical supercontinuum extending from 1.53μm up to 2.55μm, generated in a dispersion-engineered silicon photonic wire. The supercontinuum is generated using low power mid-infrared picosecond pump pulses at 2.12μm.

articleTitle: Passively Q-switched Pr:YLF laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report passively Q-switched operation of a diode-pumped Pr:YLF laser using an AlInGaP on GaAs SEmiconductor Saturable Absorber Mirror. Q-switched pulses with 145ns duration and 23mW average output power at 639.5nm are obtained.

articleTitle: A 4×12.5 Gb/s CWDM Si photonics link using integrated hybrid silicon lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 4λ × 12.5Gbps Silicon Photonics CWDM link integrating all optical components, electronics, and packaging technologies required to form the link.

articleTitle: High resolution S2 mode imaging of photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatially and spectrally resolved mode imaging of a 19 cell photonic bandgap fiber with minimum loss at 1550 nm is demonstrated using a high resolution tunable laser and phosphor-coated CCD camera.

articleTitle: Optically Pumped Mixing at 100 GHz with Travelling-Wave Uni-Travelling Carrier Photodiodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Frequency down-conversion Optically Pumped Mixing was performed at 100 GHz with a Travelling-Wave Uni-Travelling Carrier Photodiode. A conversion loss of 40 dB and 54 dB was obtained for fundamental and sub-harmonically pumped mixing respectively.

articleTitle: ICESat-2 and the importance of space-based laser altimetry measurements
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This presentation will summarize the motivation for space-based laser altimetry, the science requirements for ICESat-2, and the current concept for the ICESat-2 mission. ICESat-2 will employ a photon-counting measurement approach using a high-repetition rate laser in a multibeam configuration.

articleTitle: A chromatic dispersion estimation method for arbitrary modulation formats
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Simulations show that a modulation-format-independent method for estimating chromatic dispersion from the phase of a coherently-received signal at four frequencies can estimate 3000 ps/nm of dispersion to within 2% at an OSNR of 10 dB.

articleTitle: Coherent beam combining of fiber amplifiers in a kW regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-frequency coherent beam combination (CBC) of 16 fiber lasers with kW class output power is presented. In addition, kW scale CBC of three Photonic Crystal Fiber (PCF) amplifiers in a filled aperture configuration is reported.

articleTitle: Origin of the temperature dependence of threshold current in InP/AlGaInP quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We quantitatively determine the factors that decide the threshold current temperature dependence at high temperatures in state-of-the-art InP quantum dot lasers and demonstrate a design with low threshold and reduced temperature sensitivity.

articleTitle: 500-GHz mode-hop-free idler tuning range with a frequency-stabilized singly-resonant parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A continuous-wave signal-resonant optical parametric oscillator is frequency stabilized at the kilohertz jitter level to the transmission peak of an external high finesse Fabry-Perot cavity, allowing a widely tunable mode-hop-free idler scan over 500 GHz.

articleTitle: Efficient frequency conversion at low-powers in a silicon microresonator using carrier extraction
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate four-wave mixing in a silicon microresonator at low powers using a PIN diode to extract the generated carriers. We achieve conversion efficiencies as high as -6.6 dB with 7 mW of input power.

articleTitle: High-speed full-duplex optical wireless communication systems for indoor applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A high-speed full-duplex optical wireless communication system with limited mobility for both a 10 Gbps down-link and a 500Mbps up-link with localization is experimentally demonstrated with error-free operation (BER<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>).

articleTitle: Attosecond Ti:Sapphire pulse train phase noise
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical pulse trains from solid-state mode-locked lasers are expected to exhibit extremely low levels of phase noise. An optical measurement technique demonstrates an integrated phase noise of 20 as, 10 MHz to 4 kHz.

articleTitle: Highly stabilized frequency-locked optical frequency comb signal generation using amplified optical fiber loop with SSB-SC modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Frequency-locked optical frequency comb generation was successfully demonstrated with SSB-SC modulation loop technique. We show no significant effect on the frequency comb signal with changes of loop length from 0 mm to 5 mm.

articleTitle: High-performance silicon-based multiple wavelength source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate a multiple-wavelength source by filtering and modulating individual lines from an on-chip optical parametric oscillator frequency comb. Bit-error-rate and eye-diagram measurements yield performance comparable to a tunable laser source.

articleTitle: Characterization of fast and power efficient optical OFDM transmission system based on Hartley transform
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The analysis in unamplified and ASE-dominated optical systems shows that similar performance as DMT can be achieved with FHT-based O-OFDM, providing an efficient scheme in terms of power and complexity for cost-sensitive applications.

articleTitle: Fabrication of low contrast homogenous guided mode resonance filters
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper presents a narrow spectral filter based on a homogeneous Silicon Dioxide structure with a periodic array of air holes. Theoretical and experimental results are provided for a resonant structure with a 6 nm spectral width at 1.591μm.

articleTitle: Carrier depletion based linear silicon modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the linearity of a silicon electro-optic modulator can be improved by optimizing the embedded diode structure. Optimized designs of silicon modulators can give 5.9 dB improvement in SFDR over conventional LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> modulators.

articleTitle: Single exposure fabrication and manipulation of 3D hydrogel cell microcarriers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a simple and high-throughput method for fabricating free-floating hydrogel cell microcarriers using single exposure UV patterning. We also demonstrate magnetic manipulation of the free-floating cell microcarriers using a magnetic nanoparticle-embedded structure for an active agitation and a solution exchange.

articleTitle: Optical low-coherence interferometry for reconstruction of the modal-content in few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel method for reconstructing the dispersion-corrected modal content of fibers is experimentally demonstrated. It provides the modal weights, the profiles, relative group-delays, and dispersion of all the modes without assuming any optical properties of the fiber under test.

articleTitle: Advances in modulation formats for fiber-optic transmission systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This tutorial will provide on overview of advances in modulation formats and digital signal processing for fiber-optic transmission systems. In particular options for 400-Gb/s data transport will be investigated.

articleTitle: Propagation of Laguerre-Gaussian mode light through multi-core fiber at telecom wavelength
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observed phase preservation of Laguerre-Gaussian light after propagation through multi-core fiber (7-core). We showed the possibility of mode-division multiplexing transmission in principle. Denser core promises higher degree of multiplexing.

articleTitle: 2.5-Gb/s broadcast signal transmission in a WDM-PON by using a mutually injected Fabry-Pérot laser diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadcast signal transmission in a WDM-PON by using low noise broad-band light source based on a mutually injected Fabry-Perot laser diodes. This novel multi wavelength WDM source enables to transmit 2.5 Gb/s per channel.

articleTitle: Optical generation of narrow-line RF by injection locking of modulated DFB lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A pair of commercial DFB lasers has been phase locked using electro-optic modulation and injection seeding. By mixing the locked lasers' outputs on a photodetector, we have generated RF from 5 to 50 GHz, with a measured linewidth below 2 Hz.

articleTitle: Multiple-wavelength 25-Gb/s surface-emitting laser array for short-reach WDM links
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multiple-wavelength 25-Gb/s operation of a 1.3-μm-range surface-emitting laser array was demonstrated. The fabricated laser array, which consists of nine distributed-feedback (DFB) active stripes operating between 1260 and 1290 nm at 3.7-nm intervals exhibited clear 25-Gb/s eye openings.

articleTitle: Detecting anthrax in the mail via coherent Raman microspectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, how spatial information can be collected through a turbid medium via coherent Raman microspectroscopic imaging. The technique is capable of identifying anthrax endospores inside a sealed paper envelope.

articleTitle: 100-GHz channel spacing and O-band quantum dot optical frequency comb generator with interference injection locking technique
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An O-band multiple-wavelength light source with 100-GHz channel spacing was successfully demonstrated for the WDM light source using a single quantum dot optical frequency comb laser with an interference injection locking technique.

articleTitle: Smooth and ultra-precise silicon nanowires fabricated by conventional optical lithography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that nanowire waveguides with nanoscale precision and ultra-smooth sidewalls can be fabricated with conventional optical lithography. The presented fabrication scheme exploits the combination of a special staggered lithographic design and preferential wet etching.

articleTitle: Broadband electrical permittivity of gold for plasmonics and nano-optics applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the electrical permittivity of different bulk and film gold samples by spectroscopic ellipsometry from 200 nm to 20 μm, resolving inconsistencies on plasmon resonances, lifetime, and SPP propagation associated with imprecise current literature values.

articleTitle: Demonstration and analysis of a high power radiation balanced laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Detrimental heating in a high power Yb:YAG laser was eliminated by incorporating anti-Stokes optical cooling.

articleTitle: Investigation of the stability of microwave oscillations in an optically injected 1550nm-VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel experimental technique based on the study in the phase plane of real-time series is used for a first experimental analysis of the stability of period-one microwave frequency oscillations generated with an optically-injected 1550nm-VCSEL.

articleTitle: Room temperature CW operation of metal-semiconductor plasmonic nanolasers with subwavelength cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first room temperature, continuous wave operation of the electrical injection nanolasers with subwavelength cavity. The lasing mode is confined in an InP/InGaAs-SiN-Silver cavity of rectangular cross section operating at 1.55 μm.

articleTitle: 58 kHz ultra-low repetition rate ultralong Erbium-doped fiber laser mode-locked by carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper we present a 58 kHz fundamental repetition rate 3.5 km long EDFL mode-locked by SWCNT saturable absorbers. Because laser nonlinearities and accumulated dispersion, we observed chirped soliton-like 6.79 ps pulses with 0.49 nm spectral width. This is the lowest repetition rate in EDFL, to the best of our knowledge.

articleTitle: SESAMs for high power oscillators: Damage thresholds and design guidelines
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a systematic study of lifetime and damage of SESAMs for high power oscillators, comparing nonlinear saturation parameters and damage fluences. Optimized SESAMs with <;0.1% nonsaturable losses withstand pulse fluences >;0.2J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and intensities >;300GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Fast and compact silicon photonic crystal modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 5 Gbps modulation in a 200 μm-length photonic crystal Mach-Zehnder modulator, fabricated using CMOS processes. V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">л</inf>L < 0.029 V. cm was observed under DC operation. RF modulation was performed at 2.2 V peak-to-peak.

articleTitle: Generation of correlated photons in an integrated chalcogenide As2S3 waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first 1550 nm correlated photon-pair source in a highly nonlinear integrated glass waveguide. A pair coincidence rate of 80 s was achieved with the correlation ratio limited by Raman effects.

articleTitle: ZBLAN supercontinuum generation — Detailed comparison between measurement and simulation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a detailed comparison between modeling and experiments on supercontinuum generation in a ZBLAN fiber. Good agreement is obtained when pumping both in the normal and anomalous dispersion regimes.

articleTitle: Thermally tuned dual 20-channel ring resonator filter bank in SOI (silicon-on-insulator)
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two 20-channel second-order optical filter banks have been fabricated. With tuning, the requirements for a wavelength multiplexed photonic AD-converter (insertion loss 1-3 dB, extinction >;30 dB and optical bandwidth 22-27 GHz) are met.

articleTitle: Integrated optical phase locked loop
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon photonics based integrated optical phase locked loop is utilized to synchronize a 10.2 GHz voltage controlled oscillator with a 509 MHz mode locked laser, achieving 32 fs integrated jitter over 300 kHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Passively mode locked GHz femtosecond Yb-fiber laser using an intra-cavity Martinez compressor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 130fs, 3W, 1.3GHz fiber laser system based on a passively mode-locked Yb fiber soliton oscillator using an intra-cavity Martinez compressor with adjustable dispersion and bandwidth and a linear Yb-fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Ultra low bending loss spiral photonic crystal fibers in terahertz regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A spiral PCF design in Topas<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> with ultra low bending loss, very low confinement loss and superior dispersion properties in the Terahertz regime is presented. The design provides parameters for optimal performance over several characteristics.

articleTitle: Nanoscale oxidation of silicon microring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The resonance frequency of a silicon microring was permanently blue-shifted with 1.2 GHz resolution over more than 350 GHz, a full free-spectral-range, by electrochemically changing the waveguide core (silicon) to the cladding (silicon dioxide) material.

articleTitle: Low-cost PCB-integrated polymer waveguide sensor for gas detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An optical waveguide sensor formed directly on low-cost PCB substrates is presented for the first time. The device integrates polymer waveguides functionalized with chemical dyes, photonic and electronic components and allows multiple-gas detection.

articleTitle: Demonstration of metallic nano-cavity light emitters with electrical injection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metallic nano-cavity light emitters with a cavity volume of 0.19 λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and the active region is completely encapsulated by metal is demonstrated with current injection at room temperature.

articleTitle: Long path THz detection of small molecule vapors in the atmospheric transparency windows
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first phase of a long path THz-TDS apparatus to remotely detect the THz spectrum of small vapor phase molecules with rotational transitions that fall within the atmospheric transparency windows.

articleTitle: Optical circuits in fiber cladding: Femtosecond laser-written Bragg Grating Waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High strength, first order Bragg Grating Waveguides are inscribed in the core and cladding of optical fibers using oil immersion femtosecond direct laser-writing. A laser-induced birefringence of 2.05 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> was inferred from polarization split Bragg resonances.

articleTitle: Bright coherent attosecond-to-zeptosecond kiloelectronvolt X-ray supercontinua
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate bright coherent X-ray supercontinua generated through fully phase-matched upconversion of mid-IR laser light into the keV spectral region. The ultrabroad bandwidths can support pulse durations of few attoseconds, scalable to zeptosecond time scales.

articleTitle: Present and future of high efficiency multi-junction solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper reviews our research activities for III-V compound multi-junction (MJ) solar cells and recent R&D topics on concentrator MJ solar cells under the NEDO's R&D Project on Innovative Solar Cells initiated since 2008. The conversion efficiency of InGaP/(In)GaAs/InGaAs triple-junction solar cells has been improved to 35.8% (1-sun, AM1.5G) and 42.1% (230-suns) as a result of proposing double-hetero wide-band-gap tunnel junctions, understanding dislocation behavior in the lattice mismatched system and inverted epitaxial layer structure. We have contributed to industrialization of InGaP-based multi-junction solar cell for space use in Japan.
