The authors have also shown great potential of concentrator PV for terrestrial applications by developing concentrator 3-junction solar cell modules (area of 5,500cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for 550suns use) with an efficiency of 31.5%. Now, we are challenging higher efficiency toward 50% under the NEDO's Innovative R&D Project.

articleTitle: Flat-top microwave photonic filter based on optical frequency comb shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present flat-top microwave photonic filters through amplitude and phase shaping of optical frequency combs. Flat-topped filters with greater than 27-dB stopband loss are demonstrated using 32 taps with both positive and negative tap coefficients.

articleTitle: Optical amplification of propagating surface plasmon polaritons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate amplified spontaneous emission of long-range surface plasmon polaritons in planar metallic waveguides embedded in a fluorescent polymer. A net gain coefficient of 8±2 /cm has been realized for propagation up to 2 mm.

articleTitle: Fiber DFB laser bend sensor with RF signal interrogation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the properties of a dual-polarization distributed feedback fiber laser as the fiber cavity is bent. We show that the RF polarization beat note can sense fiber bend and temperature.

articleTitle: Waveguide single-photon detectors for integrated quantum photonics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first waveguide single-photon detectors. They are based on superconducting nanowires patterned on top of GaAs/AlGaAs waveguides and are suitable for monolithic integration with single-photon sources and passive quantum optical networks.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared broadband modulation instability and 50 dB Raman assisted parametric gain in silicon photonic wires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadband modulation instability, >; 40 dB parametric amplification with on-chip gain bandwidth >; 580 nm, and narrowband Raman-assisted peak on-chip gain exceeding 50 dB, using mid-infrared dispersion-engineered silicon nanophotonic wires.

articleTitle: Observing the continuous transformation of a four level laser into a two level system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Pumping the Cs 852.1nm laser by photoassociating Cs-rare gas atomic pairs allows one to observe a four-level system morph into a two-level system. This occurs when the state 3-state 2 energy defect falls below ~2kT/3.

articleTitle: Single-mode quantum cascade lasers employing a candy-cane shaped Fabry-Perot cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-mode Quantum Cascade lasers employing a candy-cane shaped Fabry-Perot cavity are demonstrated. Single-mode emission with ~25 dB side mode suppression is achieved up to ~500 mA above threshold current in pulsed operation.

articleTitle: High speed modulation of a 1.55-μm MEMS-tunable VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The dynamics of the micromachined-tunable surface-emitting laser are derived from amplitude modulation response. The dependence of resonance frequency on bias current and wavelength is reported. The device shows 3-dB modulation frequency above 6 GHz.

articleTitle: 100-mJ diode-pumped, cryogenically-cooled Yb:YLF chirped-pulse regenerative amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A cryogenically-cooled, Yb-doped YLF chirped-pulse regenerative amplifier with an output pulse energy of 107 mJ was obtained at a 10-Hz repetition rate. To our knowledge, this is the highest energy Yb-doped solid-state regenerative amplifier.

articleTitle: The 4FAD: A high-extinction-ratio, achromatic, temperature-insensitive, high-damage-threshold, all-fiber, power-selective filter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We disclose a novel, power-selective, low-insertion-loss, all-fiber device, based on the interaction of self-phase modulation and cross-phase modulation in a segmented, birefringent waveguide. The 4FAD provides new functionality of great value for pulsed laser systems.

articleTitle: Ultrafast, surface plasmon enhanced strong-field photoemission with a mid-IR OPCPA
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Surface plasmon field enhancement with a few-cycle mid-IR OPCPA achieves tunneling photoemission from a gold surface at low focused laser intensity (∼10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and electron acceleration to hundreds of eV.

articleTitle: Optical comb and pulse generation from CW light
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent progress in compact optical comb/pulse sources is reviewed, mainly focusing on electro-optic synthesizing methods from a CW light. The features, applications, challenges are discussed comparing with other technologies like mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: Automatic wavelength control method using Rayleigh backscattering for WDM-PON with tunable lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an automatic wavelength control method using Rayleigh backscattering and wavelength modulation for tunable lasers in a WDM-PON. By measuring the spectrum of backscattered light, we identified and tracked the allocated wavelength.

articleTitle: Compact spatio-temporal ultrashort pulse characterisation using a pulse shaper and a wavefront sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate compact spatio-temporal ultrashort pulse characterisation. A programmable pulse shaper measures amplitude and phase with bFROG in-line and a Shack-Hartmann sensor measures the spatial phase of the pulse across the whole spectrum.

articleTitle: On-chip focusing of light by metallic nanotip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a numerical simulations, fabrication and experimental results for on-chip focusing of surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) in metal nanotip coupled to the silicon waveguide.

articleTitle: Tunable 2D photonic crystal cavities for cavity electro-optomechanics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present and demonstrate a novel electro-opto-mechanical structure based on a slotted waveguide photonic-crystal cavity, in which electrostatics and optics couple simultaneously to the same "phonon" resonance.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics of light, fluid, and nano-particles: Light-induced flow and beam collapse through radiation pressure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study nonlinear dynamics of light propagating in nano-particle suspensions, and show that radiation pressure creates particle flux, induces flow in the liquid, eventually leading to bottlenecks of high particles concentration, and filamentation.

articleTitle: A 10 GHz 2.5 ps regeneratively mode-locked Yb fiber laser in the 1.1 μm band
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a 10 GHz regeneratively and harmonically mode-locked Yb fiber laser capable of dispersion-managed soliton operation at 1.1 μm. A 2.5 ps optical pulse with a timing jitter of 134 fs was successfully generated.

articleTitle: Coherent ultrashort pulse generation from incoherent light by trapped pulse amplification in birefringent fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 48 pJ, 413 fs, chirp-free, sech<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-shaped, coherent, ultrashort pulse was generated from an incoherent light of super luminescent diode using pulse trapping and amplification by an ultrashort soliton pulse in a 400 m-long birefringent fiber.

articleTitle: Drawn metamaterial fibers with negative permeability
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate terahertz metamaterials with negative magnetic permeability by combining fiber drawing and silver sputtering. We experimentally and numerically characterize the transmittance of spooled metamaterial arrays with different orientations.

articleTitle: Printable DFB laser and wavelength monitor systems by on demand fabrication on flexible films
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated organic laser & monitor array system on film. The laser part was drawn by high precision dispenser and the photodiodes were printed by ink jet. Wavelength resolution of 0.25 nm was obtained.

articleTitle: Explosions of methane clusters driven by intense X-ray FEL pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Explosions of methane clusters driven by intense XFEL pulses were studied during the first experiments at LCLS. Ion fragment distribution dynamics depends strongly on wavelength and pulse width.

articleTitle: Power scaling of actively Q-switched synchronized dual-frequency laser pulses based on two Nd:YLF crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By introducing two Nd:YLF crystals into two laser cavities as a new configuration, we have scaled up the total output power of actively Q-switched synchronized dual-frequency laser pulses by more than 6 times.

articleTitle: Diffuse spectroscopy with very high collection efficiency
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Light from a super-continuum source is spectrally dispersed, coded and recombined before illuminating a turbid medium. In this way, spectroscopic diffuse optical imaging of the medium of very high light collection efficiency is possible.

articleTitle: High-resolution 133Cs 6S-6D, 6S-8S two-photon spectroscopy using an intra-cavity scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an intra-cavity scheme for diode laser based on two-photon spectroscopy. Three <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">133</sup>Cs hyperfine transition groups of different wavelengths are shown. For the 6S-6D transitions, we achieved 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> times better signal-to-noise ratio than previous work with 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> times less laser power, revealing some previously vague and unobserved spectra.

articleTitle: Measuring vortex charge with a triangular aperture
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure the charge of vortex beams (up to ±7) via diffraction in a triangular aperture. We also apply this technique for measuring femtosecond vortices and non-integer vortices. The results compare favorably with numerical modeling.

articleTitle: All-optical switching in SU-8 conductor-gap-dielectric plasmonic microring resonator using thermal nonlinearity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Efficient light-to-heat conversion due to ohmic loss in a Au/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/SU-8 plasmonic microring resonator was exploited to achieve all-optical switching. We obtained 20 times larger resonance shift in the resonator over similar SU-8 dielectric microrings.

articleTitle: Ultrafast nonlinear optical processes and free-carrier lifetime in silicon nanowaveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report self-consistent femtosecond studies of two-photon absorption, optical Kerr-effect and free-carrier index and loss in silicon nanowaveguides using heterodyne pump-probe. Free-carrier lifetime was reduced to 33ps with only 8dB/cm added loss using proton bombardment.

articleTitle: Phase transitions induced by ultrafast laser writing in transparent materials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Evidence of the first order phase transition associated with self-assembled nanostructures formation during ultrafast laser writing in silica glass is demonstrated. Supercooled state of laser damage is observed using pulses with tilted intensity front.

articleTitle: Tm fiber laser mode-locked at large normal dispersion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a mode-locked Tm fiber laser at large normal dispersion, generating 0.4 nJ pulses dechirping to 470 fs. The dispersion is controlled in an all fiber format.

articleTitle: Frequency divide-and-conquer approach to producing ultra-broadband mid-IR combs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new approach for generating mid-infrared frequency combs using degenerate (subharmonic) synchronously-pumped optical parametric oscillation. Octave-wide frequency combs centered at 3.1μm, frequency- and phase-locked to the erbium-fiber pump laser, were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nano-structured optical nanofibers for cavity-QED
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that optical nanofiber cavity can be realized by drilling periodic nano-grooves on a sub-wavelength diameter silica fiber using focused ion beam milling. Due to both transverse and longitudinal confinement of the field, such a nanofiber cavity can become a promising workbench for cavity-QED.

articleTitle: Combining multiple semiconductor laser sources for spectral pulse shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a low cost multiple semiconductor laser source (SCL) for ultra-wideband pulse generation. The parallel gain-switched SCL source configuration, combined with a thermally adjustable pulse shaper, increases the synthesized waveform resolution.

articleTitle: Momentum-space engineering of gaseous Bose-Einstein condensates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Bose-Einstein condensate momentum distributions can be shaped by standing-wave laser pulse sequences. We find that several momentum distributions, important in atom-interferometry applications, can be engineered with high fidelity with two or three pulses.

articleTitle: On the symmetry of efficiency-versus-carrier-concentration curves in GaInN/GaN light-emitting diodes and relation to droop-causing mechanisms
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The ABC model (without and with phase-space filling) predicts IQE-versus-n curves of GalnN light-emitting diodes that have even symmetry. Analysis of IQE-versus-n curves shows the need for a carrier leakage term to explain the droop.

articleTitle: Acoustic plasmons in InAs nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The THz radiation spectra of an ensemble of free-standing InAs nanowires exhibits features consistent with the presence of low energy acoustic plasmons. The deduced electron concentration agrees with separate transconductance measurements.

articleTitle: Coherent control of phonon localization in ZnTe(110) using femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two-phonon bound states have been impulsively excited via second-order Raman scattering in ZnTe(110) and detected with the pump-probe technique. By using femtosecond laser pulses, we have realized the coherent manipulation of phonon localization.

articleTitle: A high-Q exterior plasmonic whispering gallery mode in a metal-coated microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new kind of plasmonic whispering gallery modes that can be highly localized in the exterior of a metal-coated microresonator, and possesses high quality factors at room temperature.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal quasi phase matching
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a temporal extension of quasi-phase-matching of a nonlinear optical process. This allows conserving both momentum and energy over macroscopic length and time scales. This treatment is relevant for any dynamic quasi-phase-matching scheme.

articleTitle: Picometer calibrator for precision linear encoder using a laser interferometer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A calibration system for precision linear encoders was developed. This system evaluated interpolation errors with an expanded uncertainly of 0.55 nm (k=2). A commercial laser interferometer was calibrated, and its cyclic error was evaluated.

articleTitle: Low power polarization modulation of vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Vertical cavity surface emitting lasers with anisotropic cavity supports two orthogonal polarizations, and current injection direction selects the dominant polarization. Low-power, high extinction ratio modulation requiring <; 200 mV is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generating an ultra-stable microwave in the drop tower
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this work we present our efforts to build a drop tower compatible setup to generate an ultra-stable microwave signal, which is used for the Raman beams in an atom interferometer.

articleTitle: Post-processing multicore photonic crystal fibers for locally coupling selected core pairs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coupling selected cores among otherwise decoupled multiple cores in photonic crystal fibers is demonstrated via the use of differential pressure and heat for local processing. Complex interferometer assemblies for all-fiber devices may be achieved.

articleTitle: 8 400-Gbit/s PDM-QPSK with 100 GHz channel spacing over 2000km transmission using MAP detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We simulated 8x400-Gbit/s PDM-QPSK over 2000-km transmission by using Map detection to reduce the channel spacing to 100-GHz. MAP detection can significantly improve the system performance to <; 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> BER compared to non-MAP detection.

articleTitle: Optical orientation in bulk germanium
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafast magneto-optics in bulk germanium reveals optical orientation of charge carriers via both direct and indirect optical transitions. At low temperatures, electron (hole) spins have remarkably long coherence times of ~ 1 ns (~ 100 ps).

articleTitle: High-power Faraday isolator with new method of compensation of thermally induced depolarization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new compensation scheme of thermodepolarization in Faraday isolators was predicted and experimentally verified. Scheme allows creating a new Faraday isolator for high power lasers and upgrades traditional ones, increasing their isolation ratio.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a second-order nonlinear silica fiber taper with self-assembled organic surface layers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimentally a novel technique to generate significant and thermodynamically stable second-order nonlinearity into a silica fiber taper by using nanoscale self-assembly of nonlinear molecules on a fiber surface.

articleTitle: Collinear coherent beam combining of two ytterbium doped single frequency fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We collinearly combined two ytterbium doped fiber amplifiers with an output power of 11.4 W to 21.8 W. The system will be used to evaluate coherent beam combining in laser systems for gravitational wave detectors.

articleTitle: Temporal compression of ultrafast optical filaments by molecular quantum wakes in atmosphere
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An ultrafast pulse filaments in atmosphere, leaving behind a molecular rotational quantum wake. A filamenting probe pulse is injected into the wake and is temporally compressed.

articleTitle: Fabrication of stepped and reflowed 3-D profiles for optical applications by dose-modulated electron beam lithography and selective thermal reflow
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Microlens and prism arrays were fabricated using multi-level electron beam patterning combined with thermal reflow. The molecular weight dependent processing allows selective transfer of stepped into sloped resist structures with smooth surfaces.

articleTitle: 9.5-mJ, 830-ps, 0.5-kHz single frequency MOPA system with near diffraction limited beam quality
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Near diffraction limited, single frequency, passively Q-switched Nd:YAG laser (240 μj, 830-ps at 0.5-kHz) is amplified up to 9.5-mJ in a two stage diode pumped amplifiers whilst preserving pulse duration, beam quality and linear polarization.

articleTitle: Frequency-domain adaptive equalization in digital coherent receivers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Aiming at the reduction of computational complexity of conventional time-domain equalizers in digital coherent receivers, we propose and demonstrate a novel frequency-domain adaptive equalization technique based on the constant-modulus algorithm.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave second harmonic generation in sub-micron AlGaAs waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Modal phase-matched second harmonic generation is obtained in sub-micron AlGaAs waveguides using a continuous-wave laser at telecommunication wavelengths. The tunability and robust fabrication process make this device ideal for integrated wavelength conversion.

articleTitle: Thermodynamics of resonant infrared matrix-assisted pulsed laser evaporation of luminescent dendrimers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The successful demonstration of resonant infrared laser ablation and deposition of intact polymers and thermally labile organic molecules raises complex questions about the thermo dynamics of the process. Here we present results of resonant infrared matrix-assisted pulsed laser evaporation (RIR-MAPLE) of luminescent dendrimers, successfully deposited as thin films using cryogenic matrices of chloroform and toluene and analyzed by atomic-force microscopy and nuclear magnetic resonance of the films. The properties of the two matrices have definite effects on the dynamics of the ablation process, resulting in relatively rough films with little damage to the dendrimer for the chloroform matrix, and smoother films with more structural damage to the dendrimer in the case of the toluene matrix. Thermodynamic modeling suggests that RIR-MAPLE in the chloroform matrix proceeds via explosive vaporization, while the ablation process from the toluene matrix is normal boiling and vaporization.

articleTitle: Time-reversed lasing and control of absorption in a two-channel coherent perfect absorber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel mechanism for controlling absorption of coherent light bytwo orders of magnitude. By varying the phase of incident laser light in a two-port geometry, the absorption is greatly enhanced or reduced.

articleTitle: Electro thermal and electro statical actuation of a surface micromachined tunable Fabry-Pérot filter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a surface micromachined electro-thermal as well as electro-statical tunable Fabry-Perot filter for on wafer mass production. With insertion losses <; 1.4 dB (from standard single mode fiber (SSMF) to SSMF) and a tuning range of 112 nm.

articleTitle: High efficiency photovoltaics: Recent progress and long term goals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Photovoltaic solar cells based on III-V semiconductors are now reaching power conversion efficiencies in excess of 42%. This technology is reviewed and discussed with reference to the fundamental efficiency limit for solar photovoltaic power conversion, which sits at 87%.

articleTitle: Picosecond mid-IR optical parametric amplifier based on GaS0.4Se0.6 pumped by a Nd:YAG laser system at 1064 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Operation of a GaS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub> optical parametric amplifier is demonstrated with 5-11 μm idler tuning range and maximum energies -10 μJ for sub-30-ps pulse durations, and performance ~3 times better than with pure GaSe.

articleTitle: Highly selective single-nucleotide polymorphism detection with optofluidic ring resonator lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optofluidic ring resonator microlasers in conjunction with molecular beacons are used for intracavity detection of DNA single-nucleotide polymorphism. A discrimination ratio of 100 is achieved between the target DNA and single-base-mismatched DNA.

articleTitle: Full quantum mechanically treatment of squeezed vacuum state generation through self-rotation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a full quantum mechanical picture of squeezed vacuum state generation via self-rotation in an X system. As a result, extra noise that is overlooked in semi-classical picture is found and its effect on the degree of squeezing is discussed.

articleTitle: The effect of pump coherence on the efficient generation of CW pumped supercontinuum
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present experimental results on the effect of pump bandwidth on the efficiency of generation of continuous-wave supercontinua. We show that the broadest supercontinuum is obtained for intermediate pump bandwidths in agreement with numerical modeling.

articleTitle: Unidirectional perfect transmission resonances in nonlinear asymmetric photonic multilayers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Unidirectional transmission in asymmetric nonlinear photonic multilayers of the type (BA)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>(AB)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sup>(AABB)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sup> with perfect transmission resonances is examined. Optical diode action with >;92% transmittance in only one direction is demonstrated numerically.

articleTitle: Power-enhanced narrow-band Sub-THz generation by use of a photonic transmitter and shaped optical pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By using optimized shaped optical pulses, we demonstrate a factor-of-~25 enhancement in the spectral power density of sub-THz wave at 93 GHz compared with that for quasi-sinusoidal optical modulation.

articleTitle: 375 W, 20 kHz, 1.5 ns Nd:YAG planar waveguide MOPA
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a high-power, pulsed Nd:YAG master oscillator-power amplifier (MOPA) system consisting of a passively Q-switched, short-cavity oscillator and a series of three self-imaging planar waveguide amplifiers. This unique laser architecture produced 375 W output power at 20 kHz PRF with 1.6 ns pulse duration and 18% electrical-to-optical efficiency.

articleTitle: Probing sensitivity limits by comb-based spectroscopic techniques
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on new concepts of comb-based coherent sources that we apply to high sensitivity measurements of physical quantities, e.g. trace gas concentration and mechanical strain, through different spectroscopic techniques.

articleTitle: Picosecond few-fermion dynamics of a single self-assembled InGaAs quantum dot
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Population dynamics, excited biexciton states, excitonic and conditional biexcitonic Rabi oscillations in a single quantum dot embedded in a photodiode are investigated combining ultrafast pump-probe techniques with sensitive photocurrent readout.

articleTitle: Quantum non-demolition measurements of light via the carrier-envelope phase of mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A detection limit of 10 dB below the quantum limit is experimentally demonstrated for a mode-locked-laser-based quantum non-demolition measurement scheme. The scheme is completely collinear and exhibits a large read-out sensitivity.

articleTitle: Very simple tunable optical data storage of 8Bit 1Gbps data packets up to 500ns
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose the tunable storage of 8Bit data packets for up to 500ns by extension of the Quasi-Light-Storage method. Easy tuning of the storage time in the whole range is possible using conventional telecommunication components.

articleTitle: Giant nonlinear optical enhancement in chalcogenide glass fibers with deep-subwavelength metallic nanowires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A nanostructured chalcogenide-metal optical fiber is proposed. This hybrid nanofiber enables both very strong field confinement and extreme nonlinear light-matter interactions, much larger than a bare chalcogenide nanowire of comparable diameter.

articleTitle: Coupled nanocavity-grating resonances: Large plasmonic enhancement of nonlinear optical phenomena
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A grating of nanogrooves is designed to form resonant nanocavities in a gold film. The large plasmonic enhancement of fourwave mixing makes such structures attractive for surface nonlinear optics.

articleTitle: Ultra-sensitive Faraday rotation spectroscopy of O2: Model vs. experiment
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compare theoretical model simulations based on the HITRAN database with experimental data for the sensing of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> using novel balanced Herriott multipass Faraday Rotation Spectroscopy. A detection limit of 10 ppm is achieved.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional plasma grating from filament interaction in air
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the formation of 2D plasma grating by noncollinear interaction of femtosecond filaments in air. The 2D photonic plasma crystals supported 2D diffraction of the generated third-harmonic pulses.

articleTitle: Intra- and inter-band four-wave mixing in silicon coupled resonator optical waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate intra- and inter-band wavelength conversion enhancement for continuous wave sources in wide-passband coupled resonator optical waveguides (CROWs), compared with their constituent silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: Diffusion and energy relaxation of hot carriers in graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Diffusion and energy relaxation of hot carriers in graphene are studied by high-resolution pump-probe techniques. Diffusion coefficients, energy relaxation rates and optical phonon emissions time are determined.

articleTitle: Signal to noise ratios of pulsed and sinewave modulated direct detection lidar for IPDA measurements
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The signal-to-noise ratios have been derived for IPDA lidar using a direct detection receiver for both pulsed and sinewave laser modulation techniques, and the results and laboratory measurements are presented.

articleTitle: Full-range, complex-conjugate-free, endoscopic spectral-domain optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We implemented full-range, complex-conjugate-free, endoscopic SD-OCT with a forward-viewing miniature resonant fiber-scanning probe and phase modulation in the reference arm. This method can be applied to various endoscopic SD-OCT systems.

articleTitle: Practically deployable and effectively single modeall-solid photonic bandgap fiber with large effective area
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have designed and fabricated a practically deployable large effective area all-solid photonic bandgap fiber. Effectively single mode operation and 440 μm effective area were achieved at a 7.5 cm-bending radius.

articleTitle: Photon drag effect in nanostructured plasmonic films
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong enhancement of the photon drag effect due to nanostructuring of the surface has been demonstrated in thin metal films.

articleTitle: Long-wavelength (λ ≈ 14 μm) Quantum Cascade lasers with low threshold and high characteristic temperature (∼ 300 K)
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a high-performance Quantum Cascade laser at ~ 14 μm wavelength. It shows a low threshold current density of 2.1 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 300 K and high characteristic temperature of 309 K around room temperature.

articleTitle: Integrated electrochromic nanoplasmonic optical switch
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate active switching of light through a nanoslit based plasmonic devices using electrochromic Prussian blue nanocrystals, and achieve large (-95%) transmission modulation by switching the nanocrystals between oxidized and reduced states.

articleTitle: Monitoring of germination dynamics of multiple individual bacterial spores by multiple-trap Raman tweezers and differential interference contrast microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multiple-trap Raman tweezers and differential interference contrast microscopy were used for simultaneously monitoring the germination dynamics of multiple individual bacterial spores.

articleTitle: Gain measurements of a metal-metal terahertz quantum cascade laser using an integrated terahertz pulse emitter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A terahertz pulse emitter is fabricated alongside a quantum cascade laser with a metal-metal waveguide. Terahertz pulses are used to measure the gain of the laser ridge, which is clamped above threshold to 18 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a DMD-based compressive sensing (CS) spectral imaging system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a DMD-based spectral imaging system, which uses a DMD to impose CS measurements on the spatial/spectral information of the imaging scene. The original spatial/spectral information can be reconstructed from the CS measurements numerically.

articleTitle: Semiconductor laser based THz technology
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review the potential of compact diode laser based systems for Terahertz (THz) technology. We discuss different concepts for two color lasers for generating continuous wave THz radiation by photomixing and demonstrate a femtosecond diode laser based system for time domain THz sampling. Finally, we present a compact multi modal diode laser based terahertz spectroscopy system. Our configuration enables fast switching from continuous wave difference frequency generation to broadband THz emission enabling a sophisticated data analysis like much more complex time domain spectroscopy (TDS) systems.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a video frame rate full Muller-metric eye-safe imaging laser radar
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a video frame rate eye-safe imaging laser radar that can detect all four components of the Stokse parameters in the reflected signal, with a variable input polarization state, capable of full Mueller-metric imaging.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical response of graphene to an ultrashort intense terahertz pulse
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The optical response of graphene to an ultrashort intense terahertz pulse is described by the extended optical Bloch equations. The interplay of intraband and interband dynamics is important in the nonlinear optical response.

articleTitle: Electron Laguerre-Gaussian beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use nanofabricated diffraction holograms to demonstrate electron Laguerre-Gaussian beams. These beams are analogous to optical vortices but are composed of charged particle wavefunctions possessing mass.

articleTitle: Photon correlations in multi-cavity nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Second-order photon correlation measurements are established not only as a probe of single-photon nonlinear behaviour of a single cavity, but as an effective probe of the out-of-equilibrium manybody state in multiple tunnel-coupled nonlinear cavities.

articleTitle: UV pump-THz probe study of mechanisms limiting luminescence from nanoscale compositionally inhomogeneous AlGaN
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present ultraviolet pump-terahertz probe and photoconductive decay measurements on nanoscale compositionally inhomogeneous AlGaN. Results compared to photoluminescence and time-resolved photoluminescence measurements indicate luminescence from the material is limited by hole trapping.

articleTitle: Förster-type nonradiative energy transfer directed from colloidal quantum dots to epitaxial quantum wells for light harvesting applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on Forster-type nonradiative energy transfer directed from CdSe/ZnS core/shell quantum dots to InGaN/GaN quantum wells with 69.6% efficiency at 1.527 ns<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> rate at room temperature for potential light harvesting and solar cells applications.

articleTitle: Practical quantum key distribution over 100 km using sinusoidally gated InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the quantum key distribution experiment using ultra-low-noise 2-GHz sinusoidally gated InGaAs/InP avalanche photodiodes. The detectors enabled us to distribute secure keys over 100 km with a bit rate of 24 kbps.

articleTitle: Phonon-mediated exciton-photon coupling in site-controlled quantum-dot-nanocavity systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that far off-resonance exciton-photon coupling reported for self-assembled quantum dots in optical microcavities is not universal, and demonstrate that site-controlled dots exhibit clean phonon-mediated resonant coupling.

articleTitle: 10GHz waveguide interleaved femtosecond pulse train
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 10GHz fs-pulse train by external repetition rate multiplication in four phase-tunable Mach-Zehnder interleavers implemented in planar waveguide technology. A minimum RF suppression ratio of -27dB can be achieved with thermal tuning.

articleTitle: Enhancement of optical emission by coupled metal nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an analytical model of "coupled modes" describing enhancement of emission by the atoms and molecules placed within complexes of metal nanoparticles and apply it to the case where an emitter is placed inside the gap of two coupled Au nanospheres. This new approach has dual advantages of revealing the underling physics of the enhancement and opening straightforward path towards optimization.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon dispersion engineering via double-metallic Au / Ag layers for nitride light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of double-metallic Au / Ag layers coupled to InGaN quantum well (QW) results in wide-spectrum tuning of the Purcell peak enhancement of the spontaneous recombination rate for nitride light-emitting diodes.

articleTitle: Lasing in ZnO nanowires is electron-hole plasma lasing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasing in ZnO nanowires is often interpreted as exciton lasing. However, our experiments and theoretical calculations on the laser threshold and the emission spectrum show that ZnO nanowire lasing is electron-hole plasma lasing.

articleTitle: Analysis of two level atom in bichromatic field: Entropy flow and search for the Carnot cycle
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the two-level atom interaction with bichromatic field to understand the entropy flow during this interaction in the absence of spontaneous emission. This flow is characterized by the Carnot cycle that demonstrates efficient cooling.

articleTitle: Sensitized silicon ring resonators for the detection of TNT in the gas phase
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A silicon ring resonator is coated with receptor molecules for selective enrichment of TNT. Upon intercalation of TNT, changes in effective refractive index lead to a shift in resonance frequency which can accurately be determined.

articleTitle: Correlated imaging with aberration cancellation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss an apparatus capable of producing correlated-photon "ghost" images that cancel all object-induced aberrations in a particular plane and all odd-order aberrations induced by the image-forming optics. We show that both entangled and classically correlated light sources can produce the desired spatial-aberration cancellation.

articleTitle: Vertical chip-to-chip coupling using silicon strip waveguide cantilever couplers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate vertical chip-to-chip light coupling using silicon strip waveguide cantilever couplers. A chip-to-chip coupling loss of 2.5 dB per connection is measured for TE polarization at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Differentiating the roles of surface plasmon polaritons in excitation and spontaneous emission rates and outcoupling efficiency enhancement from nanohole arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Angle-resolved photoluminescence spectroscopy and excitation spectroscopy have been used to differentiate the roles of various surface plasmon polariton modes in the emission enhancement from organic dyes coated with two-dimensional metallic arrays.

articleTitle: Chip-scale multiple quantum well based optical interconnects
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Hybrid integration of multiple quantum well modulators with silicon is proposed for implementing chip-scale optical interconnects. Polymer waveguides with curved facets are used to couple light in and out of the MQW devices.

articleTitle: Splitting and lasing of whispering gallery modes in quantum dot micropillars
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Whispering gallery mode splitting in high quality-factor InAs quantum dot micropillars is observed and attributed to resonant scattering from the dots themselves. Low-threshold multimode lasing with beta-factors approaching unity is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Cavity enhanced spectroscopy with a dual-color, passively locked power build-up external cavity diode laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High-finesse external cavity was passively locked simultaneously at wavelengths of 1.064μm laser diode and 0.532μm with a waveguide PPLN crystal. Cavity enhanced spectroscopy was demonstrated to detect trace NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> employing the cavity.

articleTitle: Optimized 4-μm OPO with intracavity OPA based on a single dual-grating PPLN crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intracavity amplification of the idler radiation of an optical parametric oscillator is achieved within a single dual-grating PPLN crystal, leading to 60 % increase of the 4-μm idler power and significant beam quality improvement.

articleTitle: A novel z-cut LiNbO3 Mach-Zehnder modulator using resonant CPW electrodes with single driving signal for zero-chirp operation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel zero-chirp electro-optic modulator using resonant CPW electrodes operated with a single driving signal. The measured chirp parameter was below 0.1 at the frequency of 20.4GHz.

articleTitle: Ultrabroadband frequency comb generation at 1 μm in a silicon-nitride ring resonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate broadband frequency comb generation from a single-frequency pump laser at 1 μm using parametric oscillation in a silicon nitride ring resonator. The comb spans 97 THz with a 230-GHz free spectral range.

articleTitle: Hollow-bottle optical microresonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Hollow-bottle microresonators have been fabricated by a novel pressure-compensated, "soften-and-compress" method. The Q-factor and excitation efficiency show high tolerance to angular misalignments, while localized losses on the resonator result in spectral clean-up and superior performance.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of an all-diffractive quasi-direct space-to-time pulse shaper by frequency-resolved optical gating
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally characterized the pulse sequences generated by an all-diffractive quasi-direct space-to-time pulse shaper for the first time. This technique is promising in generating user-defined XUV and x-ray pulses.

articleTitle: Resonance fluorescence from quantum dots: Beyond the Mollow triplet
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that the resonance fluorescence spectrum of a quantum dot excited by a strong pulse contains multiple peaks. An analytical model shows how the peak positions depend on pulse width and amplitude.

articleTitle: High sensitivity temperature sensor based on Bragg grating in micro/nanofiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel temperature sensor based on fiber Bragg grating (FBG) in micro/nanofiber (MNF) immerged in the refractive index oil with high thermo-optic coefficient is proposed and simulated. A sensitivity of 0.4168nm/°C can be achieved.

articleTitle: Nanotube-based passively mode-locked Raman laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate passive mode-locking of a Raman fiber laser using a nanotube-based saturable absorber. The normal dispersion cavity generates highly-chirped 500 ps pulses that are compressed down to 2 ps, with 1.4 kW peak power.

articleTitle: Optical 8PSK transmitter using tandem IQ modulators with binary driving electrical signals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an optical 8-ary phase-shift keying (8PSK) transmitter using tandem in-phase/quadrature (IQ) modulators. A 30-Gb/s 8PSK is successfully generated through cascading a rectangular quadrature phase-shift keying (QPSK) and a square QPSK.

articleTitle: Decay dynamics of radiatively coupled quantum dots in photonic crystal slabs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We model spontaneous emission dynamics of two optically-coupled quantum dots in a photonic crystal slab. Due to the different light scattering pathways from the dots, we observe a pronounced non-exponential decay in the emitted intensity.

articleTitle: Origin of the coherent contrast pedestal in petawatt laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that the "coherent" contrast pedestal in compressed pulses from CPA lasers originates from the diffraction gratings in the pulse stretcher. The pedestal intensity correlates with the level of scatter from the gratings.

articleTitle: Sub-natural Raman linewidth and high power CW Raman-Stokes laser in hydrogen filled HC-PCF
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on several tens of Watts CW Raman-Stokes in hydrogen gas with linewidth as low as 80 KHz. This represents a narrowing of the Raman-linewidth by a factor of more than 4 orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Lasers beyond the diffraction limit
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review recent progress on metal-based lasers with optical confinement approaching 1/20th of the wavelength at room temperature and discusses the broader impact of plasmonic light sources and their application.

articleTitle: Fabrication of self-assembled silica / polystyrene microlens arrays for light extraction enhancement in nitride light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The fabrications of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> / polystyrene (PS) microlens arrays with various PS thicknesses were performed, and this approach resulted in 2.2–2.8 times increase in output power for nitride light-emitting diodes.

articleTitle: Techniques for pre-pulse contrast improvement on the 0.5 ps, 80 J, “C” beamline of the Trident Laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Non-linear pulse cleaning is used along with an OPA front end and improved stretcher designs to improve pre-pulse contrast on the high intensity short pulse beam line of the Trident Laser.

articleTitle: Low-power continuous-wave generation of second- and third-harmonic light in silicon photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show visible frequency conversion by simultaneous second- and third-harmonic generation in a silicon photonic crystal nanocavity optimized for efficient far-field in-coupling of a low-power continuous-wave optical excitation at 1.5 microns.

articleTitle: Interferometric output coupling of a high-power picosecond ring optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate, for the first time, successful deployment of an antiresonant ring interferometer within a ring optical resonator for absolute optimization of output power, extracting >;5 W of signal from a picosecond optical parametric oscillator.

articleTitle: Phased locking of two lasers with self-adjusted minimal coupling
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present systems of two coupled lasers and show experimentally and theoretically that they self-adjust their exchanged power to the minimal power required to phase-lock them, even when loss is inserted between them.

articleTitle: Continuous variable quantum communication and computation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use squeezed states of light to implement a robust continuous variable quantum key distribution scheme and an optical Hadamard gate based on coherent state qubits.

articleTitle: Magnetomotive molecular nanoprobes for optical biomedical imaging and diagnostics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Magnetomotive molecularly-targeted iron oxide nanoparticles are demonstrated as in vivo contrast agents and detected using magnetomotive optical coherence tomography. These nanoprobes are also multifunctional as molecular agents in MRI, optical coherence elastography, and therapeutic applications.

articleTitle: Electrically controlled pulse compression using a silicon waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The electrical control of pulse width in a two-photon absorption-based silicon pulse compressor is demonstrated. Approximately 30% improvement in pulse compression rate is experimentally measured under a forward voltage of 3.3 V.

articleTitle: Application of hybrid dielectric — Metallic back reflectors to thin film amorphous silicon solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The application of photonic engineering design concepts to photovoltaic devices is not entirely trivial; if anything, it introduces formidable complexity. This paper investigates some of the opportunities afforded by the amalgamation of the two sciences.

articleTitle: A volume Bragg grating to replace a Faraday isolator in an amplifier with wavefront reversal via SBS
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Faraday isolators limit the power-scalability of multimode MOPA systems that use SBS to restore the diffraction-limited beam quality. We test a volume Bragg grating, a more scalable alternative, designed to separate wavelengths 0.0604nm (16GHz) apart.

articleTitle: Observation of optical phase amplification in three wave mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first measurement of the amplification of optical phase in a phase sensitive optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Energy-scalable pulsed mid-infrared source using orientation-patterned GaAs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a five-fold increase in the energy of mid-infrared pulses from an optical parametric oscillator by amplification in an optical parametric amplifier using OPGaAs. Our approach represents an energy-scalable mid-infrared pulse source.

articleTitle: Recent advances in fiber optic parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper discusses recent experiments demonstrating dramatic improvements in the tunability and power output of fiber optical parametric amplifiers constructed utilising both conventional fibers and photonic crystal fibers.

articleTitle: 2D PPLN for simultaneous laser Q-switching and optical parametric oscillation in a Nd:YVO4 laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a tunable pulsed optical parametric oscillator using a 2D PPLN as simultaneous an electro-optic Bragg Q-switch and a parametric generator in a Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser. >;650-W peak-power eye-safe light was obtained with this system.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh resolution all-reflective OCT system with a compact fiber-based supercontinuum source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the construction and characterization of an all-reflective OCT (R-OCT) system using a newly developed compact fiber-based broadband supercontinuum source. We achieved an axial resolution of 1.5 μm in tissue (2 μm in air) with 87 dB dynamic range at a center wavelength around 1300 nrn.

articleTitle: Third harmonic generation enhancement in nematic liquid crystals via nonlocal solitons propagation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate type I third harmonic generation enhanced by the tight localization of fs laser light in nonlocal spatial solitons excited in nematic liquid crystals.

articleTitle: Plasmon tomography images of two-dimensional periodic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Direct tomography imaging of the reciprocal lattice of plasmonic crystals shows clear isofrequency dispersion directional gaps. The relation between the Fourier plane image and the First Brillouin Zone allows for simple prediction of stop bands.

articleTitle: Picosecond tunable mode-locking of a Cr2+:ZnSe laser with a frequency-doubling nonlinear mirror
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a nonlinear mirror based on a fan-out PPLN crystal that enables tunable mode-locking of a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> :ZnSe laser in the picosecond regime. More than 100 nm tunability is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Maxwell fisheye and Eaton lenses emulated by microdroplets
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Based on the transformation optics approach, we demonstrate that microlenses may act as a two dimensional fisheye or an inverted Eaton lens. An asymmetric Eaton lens may exhibit considerable image magnification, which has been confirmed experimentally.

articleTitle: Contrast enhancement by multi-pass phase-conjugation microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a non-invasive bright field imaging technique that optically enhances contrast for any weakly absorbing object. Results are shown on microscopic biomaterial. All-optical image processing and other filtering capabilities are discussed.

articleTitle: New photonic components for quantum information science
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Optical quantum technologies require new photonic components to exploit integrated architecture. We demonstrate quantum interference in MMI couplers and coupled waveguides that implement two-particle quantum walks, showing unique quantum behaviour.

articleTitle: Non-contact human cardiac activity monitoring using a high sensitivity pulsed laser vibrometer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a high sensitivity pulsed laser vibrometer to determine remotely the detailed, time-phased mechanical workings of various parts of the human heart. Results reported are validated by electrocardiography and accelerometer readings.

articleTitle: Preparation and storage of frequency-uncorrelated entangled photons from cavity-enhanced SPDC
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the preparation and storage of frequency-uncorrelated cavity-enhanced SPDC entangled photons. The frequency correlation is eliminated with a suitable pulsed pump. The storage of a single photon entangled with another flying photon is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 2nd and 4th harmonic generations of a diode-oscillator fiber amplifier for atomic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> and 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonic generations of a single-frequency continuous-wave infrared beam at 1089 nm are demonstrated for calcium spectroscopy. The optical pumping of the calcium atom is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Charge transport and ultrafast localization in nanocrystalline CdS films studied by optical pump — Terahertz probe spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Terahertz time-resolved conductivity measurements supported by classical simulations of photocarrier motion provide length scales of the charge localization within nanocrystals and their clusters and characterize the conductive coupling between them on the ultrafast time scale.

articleTitle: Towards unraveling the mechanism of third harmonic generation in plasmonic nanoantennas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study third harmonic generation from arrays of plasmonic nanoantennas. Specifically, we investigate the size, gap, and material dependence of the conversion efficiency and find it to be a function of the plasmon resonance energies.

articleTitle: Effects of high-order laser distortion products in radio over free-space optical links
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: RoFSO links are found to be susceptible to high-order laser distortion making conventional SFDR ineffective as a performance indicator. For the first time, peak input power is demonstrated as a service-independent bound on dynamic range.

articleTitle: Quantum multiscale modeling of phase changes during femtosecond laser ablation of silica
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Considering the time/length scales where collisions govern the evolution of the phenomena, a quantum multiscale model is proposed to reveal the fundamental science underlying ultrafast, non-equilibrium laser-material interactions, which consists of the first-principles calculation, revised molecular dynamics simulation, plasma model, and improved two-temperature model, for free electron generation, electron-lattice interaction, and phase change mechanisms.

articleTitle: 265 nm light emitting diodes on AlN single crystal substrates: Growth and characterization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High crystalline quality A1N and pseudomorphic AlGaN films were deposited by metalorganic chemical vapor deposition on single crystal A1N substrates for the fabrication of a 265 nm light emitting diode with estimated IQE above 40%.

articleTitle: Nonlocality in multilayered metal-dielectric optical metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have accomplished rigorous dispersion analysis and showed clearly impact of nonlocality on properties of multilayered metal-dielectric metamaterial. The main discovered effect is an appearance of additional extraordinary waves in the metamaterial which leads to the splitting of the TM-polarized beam at the air-MDN interface.

articleTitle: Generation and tight focusing of hybridly polarized vector beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of hybridly polarized beams. Tight focusing analysis show polarization distribution with 3D orientation and space variant ellipticity, which may be useful for particle orientation analysis, microscopy and atomic systems.

articleTitle: Abnormal polarization switching phenomenon in a-plane AlxGa1−xN
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The α-plane Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x-x</sub>N layers show abnormal optical polarization switching behavior. This phenomenon can be well characterized by the assumption of the lambertian-like radiation pattern and simulated by utilizing the 6 X 6 k · p model.

articleTitle: Portable acetylene frequency references inside sealed hollow-core kagome photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A continuous-wave diode laser is stabilized to a near-infrared acetylene transition inside a sealed kagome photonic crystal fiber. Stability and absolute frequency are measured with a frequency comb, and polarization sensitivity is observed.

articleTitle: Few-photon switching via two-photon absorption in Rb-filled photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show 40% all-optical modulation with 1 nW total power via non-degenerate two-photon absorption in Rb vapor confined to a photonic bandgap fiber. This corresponds to 12 photons of switching energy.

articleTitle: Highly linear millimeter-wave over fiber transmitter with subcarrier upconversion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By linearized modulation of a heterodyne subcarrier source using a dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator, a subcarrier up-converted millimeter-wave over fiber transmitter is proposed and experimentally demonstrated with an SFDR of 122.7dB·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>.

articleTitle: Femtosecond VECSELs with up to 1-W average output power
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed novel low-dispersion VECSELs modelocked with fast QD-SESAMs. The first femtosecond modelocked QD-VECSEL achieves 1 W average power with 784-fs pulses. At lower power, we achieved sub-500-fs pulses both with QW- and QD-VECSELs.

articleTitle: Breakdown of the independent electron approximation in sequential double ionization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present coincidence momentum measurements that contradict the independent electron assumption for elliptically polarized laser pulses. This shows that recollision is not the only reason for electron correlation in strong field double ionization.

articleTitle: One million time-bandwidth product full-field waveform measurement using frequency-to-time interferometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Time-multiplexing of a single-shot interferometric measurement technique using frequency-to-time mapping and digital coherent detection characterizes the amplitude and phase of 350-GHz bandwidth waveforms with a 3-μs record length in only 113 μs.

articleTitle: Polychromatic nanofocusing of surface plasmons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce the concept of polychromatic plasmonics and demonstrate a broadband lens for nanofocusing of surface plasmons. This lens has a bandwidth more than an optical octave thus opening opportunities for broadband plasmonic applications.

articleTitle: Low-noise remote transfer of a phase-encoded frequency comb through a 320m phase-stabilized fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 640 frequency-stabilized comb modes are controlled in a line-by-line pulse shaper and transmitted through a noise-cancelled 320m fiber. This allows for transmission of phase-stable, high-fidelity shaped waveforms to a remote location.

articleTitle: Solitonic transistor in the optical event horizon
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report experimental demonstration of an optical transistor and present numerical simulations explaining the observed switching effect by solitonic pulse dynamics in the presence of a optical event horizon.

articleTitle: Analysis of ultrashort pulsed FOPOs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Pulse propagation simulations of fiber-optical parametric oscillators reveal an interesting interplay between spectral filtering, synchronization delay, and pump power. Our analysis implies that generation of sub-20-fs pulses is possible.

articleTitle: Strong-field induced optical absorption in ZnO crystal
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the observation of intensity dependent red shift on the absorption-edge of zinc-oxide driven by a mid-infrared laser pulse. A new regime is identified where the shift is no longer linear to the intensity.

articleTitle: Off-resonant quantum dot-cavity interaction
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Off-resonant quantum dot-cavity coupling is studied both experimentally and theoretically. A theoretical model is proposed to explain the observations.

articleTitle: Plasmonic nanostructures for angle selective photovoltaics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe an angular selective photovoltaic window, designed to transmit normally incident light and absorb off-angle light by exploiting an anisotropic plasmonic nanostructure. The principles of operation and numerical simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Plasmonic photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review our results of metalized hybrid photonic crystal fibers. We explain the important properties of spiralling plasmons on wires and in arrays and discuss our main experimental achievements such as excitation of super-plasmon modes.

articleTitle: A 112 Gb/s duobinary-shaped PolMux DQPSK system with enhanced narrow filtering tolerance
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new modulation format based on PolMux DQPSK with duobinary shape. Simulated results show that proposed scheme with narrow bandwidth can achieve higher tolerance to narrowband filtering without changing DQPSK demodulation structure.

articleTitle: Single-mode interband cascade lasers with coupled ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report Fabry-Perot interband cascade lasers coupled to rectangular ring resonators that produce up to 5 mW of cw power in a single spectral mode at 3°C. The tuning range at 3 28°C exceeds 8 nm.

articleTitle: Active tuning of coupled resonance modes in terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate active tuning of coupled inductive-capacitive resonance in a multi layer metamaterial. Our experiment reveals that one resonance mode of a coupled pair can be selectively switched off by driving the metamaterial with infrared light.

articleTitle: Surface enhanced Raman scattering using planar dielectric structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We predict that large enhancement of spontaneous Raman scattering cross section can be achieved in an experimental scenario where the molecules are placed on planar dielectric structures supporting guided modes or Bloch Surface Waves.

articleTitle: Nonelectrical poling procedure for ordering NLO dyes in novel host amorphous ferroelectric polymer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will report new strategy for providing second-order NLO activity in host-guest NLO polymers without conventional electrical poling procedure. Formation mechanism of polar order of NLO dyes in amorphous ferroelectric polymers will be shown.

articleTitle: Tunable 3D plasmonic swiss rolls
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel 3D plasmonic rolls are fabricated through strain-induced self-rolling of metallic nanopore sheets attached to elastomeric thin films, with optical properties tunable by varying the size and thickness of nanopores, and dynamically by light irradiation.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Raman fiber distributed feedback laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber distributed feedback laser oscillator using Raman gain in a 124mm germanosilicate fiber grating at 1584nm. We measure a 6MHz signal linewidth, more than 1000× smaller than previous Raman fiber laser oscillators.

articleTitle: High sensitivity miniature Mach-Zehnder-interferometer using micro-abrupt-tapers in a cladding-depressed strongly guiding fiber for a picoliter-volume microsensing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate miniature Mach-Zehnder-interferometer with a device length of 179.5 μm using two micro-abrupt-tapers in a cladding-depressed strongly-guiding fiber. The index variation of 2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> from a 6.3 picoliter optical liquid can cause 1.6 nm wavelength-shift.

articleTitle: Frequency tunable metamaterial designs using near field coupled SRR structures in the terahertz region
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present frequency tunable metamaterials at terahertz frequencies using broadside-coupled split ring resonators. Frequency tuning, arising from changes in near field coupling, is obtained by in-plane displacement between the SRR layers. A maximum frequency shift occurs for displacement of half a unit cell resulting in a shift of 663 GHz (51% of f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>).

articleTitle: Nano-scale strain mapping using near-field spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A technique is presented for mapping the strain in light-emitting nano- and hetero structures using near-field spectroscopy. This technique makes use of theoretical calculations to extract the strain from near-field data.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared frequency combs based on microresonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present for the first time mid-infrared frequency comb generation from microresonators. Combs spanning over more than 10 THz around the 2.5 μm-wavelength CW-pump are generated in crystalline MgF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> whispering-gallery mode resonators via four-wave-mixing.

articleTitle: Interactions of sub-wavelength light scatterers with a whispering-gallery-mode optical microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Investigation of the dynamics of mode splitting manipulated by two scatterers in an optical microresonator is presented. The experimental results are explained by a multiple-scatterer theory and the applications on nanoparticle detection and sizing are discussed.

articleTitle: Metamolecular nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We vary relative arrangement of anisotropic metal nanoparticles (metamolecules) in arrays. Their second-harmonic response is not a simple orientational average of the molecular responses. Instead, collective resonances of the structures dominate.

articleTitle: Tight binding model study of photonic one-way edge mode
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A microscopic picture of the emergence of one-way edge mode in a honeycomb lattice of resonators made from magneto-optic material is obtained using tight binding model. One-way slow light scheme is proposed based on the edge mode.

articleTitle: Plasmonic modes of strongly-coupled single-crystalline gold nanoparticle dimers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The plasmonic modes of single-crystalline gold nanoparticle dimers with ultrasmall gaps are investigated. The large mode splitting separates bonding and antibonding modes which can be addressed individually. Q-factors are investigated and compared to FDTD simulations.

articleTitle: Detailed fluorescent study of Nd:YAG dependent on doping concentration
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: It was confirmed that both line-strength and linewidth of Nd: YAG depended on Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> concentration. 30.9% decrease in stimulated emission cross section of 5.4at.% Nd:YAG ceramics at 1319 nm was estimated compared to 0.4at.% Nd:YAG ceramics.

articleTitle: Suitability of supercontinuum light near 2 μm for coherent dual comb spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We evaluate the signal-to-noise ratio penalty for dual comb spectroscopy caused by the excess optical phase noise and relative intensity noise on the long-wavelength supercontinuum of a spectrally broadened Er-fiber laser frequency comb.

articleTitle: On-way slow light in nonreciprocal low-symmetry metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: It is shown that metamaterials containing magnetooptical media exhibit nonreciprocal properties ranging from polarization dependent isolation to one-way slow-light. This opens a new avenues to control light and design ultracompact nonreciprocal optical elements.

articleTitle: Slow light enhanced E-O polymer nano-photonic modulator with ultra-high effective in-device r33
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an E-O polymer infiltrated silicon photonic crystal slot waveguide modulator.
