Enhanced by improved poling efficiency and slow light effect, we achieve an ultra high effective r<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub> of 735pm/V and V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub>L of only 0.44V mm.

articleTitle: Temperature tunable behavior of planar terahertz metamaterials fabricated on bulk strontium titanate substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate thermal tuning of the inductive capacitive (LC) resonance in terahertz metamaterials made up of gold split-ring resonator (SRR) arrays on ferroelectric bulk Strontium Titanate (STO) substrates. Heating the metamaterial from temperature of 150 K to 425 K causes as high as 69% blue shift in metamaterial resonance frequency due to the change in refractive index of the substrate.

articleTitle: Study of the transient behavior of a tunable acoustic gradient index lens for laser processing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A tunable acoustic gradient lens is an adaptive optical system adequate for the processing of materials. In this study, the modulation in refractive index of the lens at the initial moments of operation is determined.

articleTitle: Optical ‘bistability’ with single atom absorbers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present observations of macroscopic switching of the optical field transmitted by a saturation-driven, single-atom cavity QED system induced by the atomic scattering of single photons.

articleTitle: In vivo imaging of kidney microcirculation using Doppler optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated 3D Doppler optical coherence tomography (DOCT) imaging of rat kidney microcirculation within the glomerulus in vivo. Dynamic changes in blood flow were detected under altered physiological conditions demonstrating real-time DOCT imaging.

articleTitle: Growths of InGaN-based light-emitting diodes with AlInN thin barrier for efficiency droop suppression
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The growths of InGaN quantum wells light-emitting diodes with AlInN thin barrier were performed by metal organic chemical vapor deposition, and this approach led to reduction in thermionic carrier escape and efficiency droop.

articleTitle: 25-GHz-channel-spaced DWDM-PON based on ASE injection with reduced filtering effect
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a color-free 25-GHz-channel-spaced DWDM-PON by employing a pre-filter for reduction of the filtering effect. Transmissions of 10 and 50 km at 1.25-Gb/s/channel are demonstrated when BLS is at OLT and RN, respectively.

articleTitle: Single frequency actively Q-switched 2 μm fiber laser by using highly Tm-doped germanate fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a unique all-fiber single-frequency actively Q-switched laser operating at ~1920 nm by using a piezo to press the fiber in the fiber Bragg grating cavity and modulate the fiber birefringence, enabling Q-switching.

articleTitle: Single photons emitted by single quantum dots into waveguides: Photon guns on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a study on single photons emitted by single quantum dots into ridge and photonic crystal waveguides using an extended micro-photoluminescence setup. Our results show promise for future applications in quantum photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: White light sampling and cross-correlation via multi-heterodyne detection with an optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Multi-heterodyne mixing of an optical frequency comb with white light filtered by a Fabry-Perot etalon is used to measure white light cross-correlations at a distance of 13 meters with a resolution of 10 ps.

articleTitle: Transforming conventional PPLN-based frequency converters to cover 13–30 microns: Bridging gap between mid-infrared and terahertz regions
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transverse-pumping geometry can be utilized for efficient generation of far-infrared radiation in 13-30 μm based on difference-frequency generation in periodically-poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> at its polariton resonances. High conversion efficiencies are achievable.

articleTitle: Single-photon detection in near-infrared region based on frequency upconversion in mgo-doped periodically-poled lithium niobate waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: MgO-doped periodically-poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide is used to up-convert photons at 1.535-1.568 μm to those at 598-603 nm, which can be detected by avalanche photodetector at single-photon counting level. Conversion efficiencies up to 45% are achieved.

articleTitle: Directional selectivity through the subwavelength slit in metallic gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An approach for obtaining strong directional selectivity through a single subwavelength slit in non-symmetric metallic gratings is shown theoretically and experimentally. Directionality effect originates from the different resonance frequencies of two interfaces.

articleTitle: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors show exceptional performance for quantum information processing, but several developments promise further progress, including new signal-amplification methods and efficient devices in the mid-infrared.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of field enhancement at the negative-positive index interface
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed field enhancement at the interface between positive and negative index plasmonic crystal media. Numerical simulations of this experiment indicate good agreement with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Practical 4-Stage optical PMD compensator for mitigating first- and second-order PMD on 40-Gbit/s RZ-D(Q)PSK
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A first practical 4-stage compensator with ~1-ms response time is demonstrated for mitigating first- and second-order PMD on 40-Gbit/s RZ-D(Q)PSK. BER and DOP degradations are significantly improved and a power penalty of <;0.5-dB is achieved at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> BER under 25-ps DGD and 400-ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> SOPMD.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-Insulator microresonator-based source of frequency-bin entangled comb of photon pairs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a quantum theory for frequency-bin entangled photon-pair generation via four-wave mixing from a Silicon-on-Insulator microresonator. We also provide design principles for such a microresonator through extensive numerical simulations.

articleTitle: All-optical regeneration based on phase sensitive amplification
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We review recent results regarding regeneration of binary and quadruple phase encoded signals using phase sensitive amplification in fibers.

articleTitle: Observation of a red-blue detuning asymmetry in matter-wave superradiance
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of strong suppression of matter-wave superradiance using blue-detuned pump light and demonstrate a pump-laser detuning asymmetry in the collective atomic recoil motion. In contrast to all previous theoretical frameworks, which predict that the process should be symmetric with respect to the sign of the detuning of the pump laser from the one-photon resonance, we find that for condensates the symmetry is broken. With high condensate densities and red-detuned pump light the distinctive multi-order, matter-wave scattering pattern is clearly visible, whereas with blue-detuned pump light superradiance is strongly suppressed. However, in the limit of a dilute atomic gas symmetry is restored.

articleTitle: Efficient broad-band harmonic generation for UV picosecond temporal pulse shaping
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present efficient and broadband sum frequency generation tenfold beyond nonlinear crystal's acceptance bandwidth. Versatile shapes, up to 4nm bandwidth and 15% efficiency have been achieved for ps flattop UV pulse generation.

articleTitle: Saturation behaviour of PbSe nanocrystal exciton emission coupled to silicon photonic crystal microcavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications

authors.preferredName: Frank C. J. M. van Veggel

abstract: We demonstrate the saturation of non-resonantly pumped, cavity-coupled exciton emission from 5 nm PbSe nanocrystals on silicon photonic crystal microcavities at microwatt excitation powers at room temperature, in agreement with simulations.

articleTitle: Frequency comb metrology in the extreme ultraviolet
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Frequency comb generation and excitation of argon, neon, and helium is shown from 51 to 85 nm with amplified and harmonically upconverted comb laser pulses, resulting in an 8-fold improved helium ground state ionization energy.

articleTitle: Real-time and real-space observation of plasma oscillation in GaAs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A plasma oscillation of electrons and holes is generated in GaAs by a quantum interference and control technique, and is temporally and spatially resolved by detecting an induced second-harmonic generation process.

articleTitle: Radiation-driven phase drift in stochastic nonlinear Schrödinger equations
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Soliton perturbation theory predicts an incorrect phase distribution for solitons of stochastically-driven nonlinear Schrodinger equations. We propose a simple variational model that accounts for radiation and produces the correct phase evolution.

articleTitle: Characterization of high-purity, pulsed squeezed light at telecom wavelengths from pp-KTP for quantum information applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We characterize a pp-KTP crystal designed to produce pure single mode squeezed vacuum at 1570 nm. Measurements show Hong-Ou-Mandel interference with 97% visibility and a circular joint spectral distribution with a Schmidt number of 1.08.

articleTitle: Nanoparticle manipulation using a plasmonic nano-tweezer with an integrated heat sink
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Making use of the field enhancement and confinement, and thermal management, of a template-stripped localized surface plasmon resonance structure, we experimentally demonstrate the trapping and rotation of 110 nm diameter polystyrene nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Below bandgap excitation of SnO2 nanowires: The relaxation of trap states
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Carrier relaxation of SnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanowires is investigated by excitation at 3.2 eV, ~0.4 eV below the bandgap. The excited state transmission spectrum from 1.9-2.7 eV is intensity dependent and recovers uniformly with a biexponential relaxation route.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of a free-standing lithium niobate photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transmission spectra of photonic crystal waveguides in freestanding lithium niobate membranes fabricated by means of ion-beam enhanced etching have been measured by scanning near-field optical microscopy show good agreement with 3DFDTD calculations.

articleTitle: Statistical properties of scattering loss and mode splitting in microdisk resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an experimental observation that in high-Q silicon microdisk resonators, the intrinsic Q and mode splitting can vary significantly over the azimuthal orders. A theoretical roughness model qualitatively explains the observed results.

articleTitle: AlGaN-based deep ultraviolet LEDs by plasma assisted molecular beam epitaxy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the development of AlGaN-based deep UV LEDs by RF plasma-assisted MBE. Devices emitting at 273 nm were evaluated at bare-die configuration and found to have an output power of 1.3 mW at 100 mA injection current and external quantum efficiency of 0.4%.

articleTitle: Time-of-flight measurement using femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We exploit femtosecond pulses for time-of-flight measurement of distances. Not only long distances but also short distances less than 10 m are measured with sub-micrometer precision beyond the traditional limit of time-of-flight measurement.

articleTitle: Active coherent combination of >200 semiconductor amplifiers using a SPGD algorithm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have demonstrated active coherent beam combination of 218 individually-addressable semiconductor amplifiers with 38.5W CW output. Phase actuation was achieved by adjusting the drive current and controlled using a stochastic-parallel-gradient-descent algorithm.

articleTitle: Measurements of pulse dynamics in mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the measurement results of pulse dynamics in a mode-locked Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> fiber laser. The quantitative data will be useful for determining the noise-limits of optical frequency combs generated by mode-locked fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Coherent quasi-cw 153 nm light generated at 33 MHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coherent quasi-cw radiation at 153 nm is generated at 33 MHz repetition rate by successive frequency conversion of the output from Yb-fiber-based laser system using two LBO crystals and two KBBF crystals.

articleTitle: Passive mode locking of discrete mode laser diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate low timing jitter 100 GHz passive mode-locking of a discrete mode (DM) laser. This Fabry-Perot device incorporates a spatially varying effective index selecting modes. Near Fourier limited 2.5 ps pulses were obtained.

articleTitle: Influence of phase matching of the Cooper minimum in argon high harmonic spectra
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We systematically study interference minima in high harmonic spectra using the Cooper minimum in argon, emphasizing that phase matching must be taken into account to fully understand spectral features relevant for harmonic spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Single-longitudinal-mode Brillouin fiber laser incorporating an unpumped erbium-doped fiber loop
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A long-cavity single-longitudinal-mode Brillouin fiber laser is firstly demonstrated by utilizing an unpumped erbium-doped fiber (EDF) loop. The utilized EDF forms a self-induced ultra-narrow grating filter and thus guarantees the SLM operation.

articleTitle: Optically induced rotation of a quantum dot exciton spin
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A polarized picosecond laser pulse, which couples the bright exciton states to biexciton resonant states, is used to manipulate the exciton spin. We directly demonstrate this novel knob in a picosecond time-resolved two pulses experiment.

articleTitle: Microwave generation with low residual phase noise from a femtosecond fiber laser with an intracavity EOM
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A femtosecond fiber laser with an intracavity electro-optic modulator is phase-locked to a high-finesse cavity through two cw transfer lasers. The residual phase noise at the 300 MHz harmonic is -126 dBc/Hz at 1 Hz.

articleTitle: Improving tolerance toward optical in-band crosstalk by employing a high pass filter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a guideline of HPF (high pass filter) for improving tolerance toward optical in-band crosstalk in WDM-PON. A cut-off frequency of HPF should be higher than five times of linewidth for effectively reducing crosstalk.

articleTitle: Probing AC Stark shift with attosecond transient absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The dynamics of helium 1snp excited states in an intense, few-cycle laser pulse are probed using isolated attosecond pulses in a transient absorption scheme. In addition to the dynamic Stark shift, we observe half-cycle oscillations.

articleTitle: Fast high fidelity hole spin initialization in a single InGaAs quantum dot
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A hole spin trapped in a quantum dot is a potential qubit. We demonstrate near unit fidelity initialization of a single hole spin in a InGaAs/GaAs Quantum dot.

articleTitle: 1.5 W output two-color femtosecond optical parametric oscillator pumped by a 7.4 W femtosecond Yb:KGW laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a 42 MHz femtosecond two-color MgO:PPLN OPO pumped by a mode locked 7.4 W Yb:KGW fs laser. Up to 1.5 W average output power and tunability from 1.45 to 1.88 μm have been achieved.

articleTitle: Fabrication of transparent electrodes from AZO nanoparticles by pulsed laser annealing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an approach for fabricating transparent electrodes on a plastic substrate by annealing AZO nanoparticles using a pulsed UV laser. For the resulting AZO film, the resistivity is 7.6 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> Ω-cm and the transmittance is over 80% within the wavelength from 400 to 800 nm. This method is straightforward and executable in the ambient environment and at room temperature.

articleTitle: Novel coupling modulator design using ring-resonator-based light drop structure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coupling modulation using microring-based light drop structure which removes the pattern dependence problem is proposed. Extinction ratio improvement from 3 dB to >;30 dB in 40 Gb/s NRZ signal is obtained with 25X smaller drive voltage.

articleTitle: Theory of Faraday effect in high-Q Whispering-Gallery optical cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The general theory of Faraday rotation in high-Q Whispering-Gallery optical cavities is investigated. We have studied the behavior of the transmission spectrum and identified the optimal condition for maximum sensitivity to external magnetic field.

articleTitle: 430-fs pulses from a SESAM mode-locked GaSb disk laser emitting at 2 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the generation of 430 fs pulses from a passively mode-locked semiconductor disk laser operating at around 2 μm. The gain mirror and the semiconductor saturable absorber mirror comprised InGaSb/GaSb quantum wells.

articleTitle: Deterministic nano-manipulation of single photon sources for integration
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Preselected single photon sources are positioned and immobilized to nanometer precision using flow control and local polymerization. This technique can be useful for integration of single photon sources within nanophotonic structures.

articleTitle: Detecting and measuring single viruses and nanoparticles with an optical microresonator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that adsorption of individual viruses and nanoparticles leads to discrete changes in the mode splitting spectra of a whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) microcavity, which enables a single nanoparticle spectrometry scheme to measure each particle.

articleTitle: Two-mode squeezed vacuum: Phase estimation and parity detection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a parity-measurement-based phase estimation protocol with two-mode squeezed vacuum states; effects of loss and excess noise in squeezed vacuum are discussed; and a parity detection scheme without number-resolving detectors is proposed.

articleTitle: Ultra-high-Q triangular cross-section nanobeam photonic cavities in single crystal diamond
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A single crystal diamond nanobeam with a triangular cross-section and 1D-Bragg reflectors is reported. Modeling shows Q≈2.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>, V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>=1.06×(λ/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. A low-Q cavity version was fabricated by Focused-Ion-Beam, exhibiting a clear mode confinement spectrum.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical spectroscopy of multiferroic LuFe2O4
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temperature-dependent femtosecond optical spectroscopy is used to track polaron dynamics in the spin and charge frustrated system LuFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, revealing the influence of charge and spin ordering on polaron excitation, redressing, and coupling to on-site excitations.

articleTitle: Two-color interferometry using frequency combs for high-accuracy self-correction of air refractive index
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Long-path interferometry of two-color frequency combs is developed for high-accuracy self-correction of air refractive index fluctuation. Interferometric phase difference was highly consistent with calculation: 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> for 10-h measurements.

articleTitle: High sensitivity optical refrigeration spectroscopy: Local cooling of Yb:YLF crystal to 110 K
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Utilizing a novel implementation of differential luminescence thermometry we accurately measure laser cooling efficiency spectra of solids. Cooling to 110K is shown in Yb:YLF at the E4-E5 Stark manifold resonance as predicted by theory.

articleTitle: Optimized two-color polarization gating with infrared laser for isolated attosecond pulse generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed and theoretically demonstrated an optimized two-color polarization gating method to produce isolated attosecond pulse by using a multicycle infrared laser pulses with the pulse duration up to 60 fs.

articleTitle: A germanium-on-silicon laser for on-chip applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasing from Ge was achieved by highly n-type doping and biaxially tensile strain to overcome free carrier absorption. High n-type doping and efficient carrier injection remain the most important issues for electrical excitation of lasing.

articleTitle: A study on cross-talk in nanometric-gap quantum dot photodetectors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a scheme to experimentally investigate cross-talk in closely positioned QD photodetectors. A cross-talk of ~25.8% at separation of 212 nm is demonstrated in pre-optimized devices.

articleTitle: Net normal-dispersion Yb-Fiber laser with anomalous dispersion higher-order-mode fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a mode-locked 24 MHz Yb-doped fiber oscillator with a higher-order mode fiber for dispersion compensation. The oscillator operates in the net normal dispersion regime and generates clean 6 nJ pulses that can be dechirped down to 150 fs.

articleTitle: Ellipticity dependence of high harmonics from 400 nm driving pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: First experimental measurement of ellipticity dependence of high harmonics produced from 400 nm driving pulses is reported and compared with harmonics produced from 800 nm driving pulses in an argon filled gas cell.

articleTitle: Discrete solitons in photonic lattices with topological defects
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate numerically and experimentally how the presence of so-called Topo logical Defects represented by junctions within otherwise periodical planar photonic lattices influences the formation of discrete solitons similar to conventional defects constituted by de tuned waveguides.

articleTitle: A comparative study of Raman enhancement in capillaries
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This work reports on the comparative studies of Raman enhancement in liquid core waveguides. The Raman enhancement in hollow core photonic crystal fibers and conventional Teflon capillary tubes are analyzed and compared theoretically and experimentally.

articleTitle: High-bandwidth, spatially resolved thermometry in reacting flows using femtosecond-CARS line imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spatially resolved thermometry at speeds up to 1000 Hz is demonstrated using 1-D femtosecond CARS. Such measurements can provide invaluable data for validating turbulent combustion models as well as addressing spatio-temporal instabilities.

articleTitle: Frequency down-conversion of non-classical light from visible wavelength to telecom wavelength using difference-frequency generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate frequency down-conversion of non-classical light by difference-frequency generation. We prepared a heralded single photon at wavelength of 780 nm, which corresponds to a resonant wavelength of a Rb atom for a quantum memory, and then converted the wavelength to a telecommunication wavelength of 1522 nm. The observed second-order correlation g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>(0) of the converted light is 0.54 ±0.12, which clearly shows sub-Poissonian photon statistics of light.

articleTitle: Power-scalable narrowband terahertz pulses generated by periodically-poled LiTaO3 based on backward rectification
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Narrowband terahertz pulses are generated by periodically-poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate with average output powers of 100 μW based on backward optical rectification, which is scalable to at least 10 mW.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond pulse generation from a chirped-pulse multipass-cavity Cr4+:Forsterite oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We produced the highest pulse energy directly generated from a room-temperature, mode-locked Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:forsterite oscillator. The chirped-pulse, multipass-cavity, 1261-nm oscillator operated at 4.9 MHz and produced 81 -nJ pulses which could be externally compressed to 620 fs.

articleTitle: Integrated temporal Fourier transformer based on chirped Bragg grating waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally realized an integrated temporal Fourier transformer based on a linearly-chirped Bragg grating waveguide written in silica glass with a femtosecond laser. The device operates in reflection and has a 10-nm bandwidth.

articleTitle: Ultrafast pulse compression by two-photon gain in a semiconductor waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally compression of femtosecond-scale pulses by two-photon gain in an electrically-driven AlGaAs waveguide. Dynamic control of pulse width from 240 to 140 fs is achieved by varying the current injection levels.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matched second-harmonic generation at vacuum ultraviolet 193 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By successful fabrication of fine twin structure, QPM SHG at 193 nm is achieved in crystalline quartz. Mechanical module suppressing switch back of twins enables stable wavelength conversion for all-solid-state compact vacuum-ultraviolet laser.

articleTitle: Conservation of vacuum in an interferometer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We provide a systematic method of quantifying the amount of loss a multimode optical state has experienced. We show that it is not possible to concentrate the non-vacuum components via linear optics.

articleTitle: Open path water vapor measurements using a chirped pulse MIR QCL sensor system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An open path chirped pulse Quantum Cascade Laser system operating from 1900 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> to 1902 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> has been developed for water vapor measurements. QCL retrieval accuracies are shown to be significantly smaller than FTIR retrievals.

articleTitle: Efficient photoconductive terahertz generation using a radio frequency bias
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An efficient photoconductive THz source is described that uses a rapidly oscillating, high voltage bias across electrodes insulated from the GaAs sample. The resulting uniform field enables excitation with a large laser spot.

articleTitle: TEM00 quasi-concentric laser resonator with line-shaped end-pumping profile: Power-insensitive operating point
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> quasi-concentric laser resonator with line-shaped end-pumping profile, based on the design method of thermal lensing and power-insensitive operating point.

articleTitle: Low noise stabilized chirped pulse Theta laser for photonic ADC
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A semiconductor-based 100 MHz Theta cavity design laser using a fiberized Fabry Perot etalon with an intra-cavity modified Hansch-Couillaud scheme is presented. AM noise spectra reveal suppression of the supermode noise spur by >;30 dB.

articleTitle: Tripling of plasma filament length by molecular quantum wakes in atmosphere
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We tripled the length of the plasma filament from a single femtosecond pulse by injecting a second pulse into its molecular rotational quantum wake.

articleTitle: Laser micro/nano patterning of hydrophobic surfaces by contact particle lens array
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser micro/nanopatterning by Contact Particles Lens Array (CPLA) has been extensively utilized but it is limited to hydrophilic surfaces. A technique is presented here to transfer CPLA by an adhesive surface to pattern hydrophobic surfaces.

articleTitle: Piezopotential tuned single ZnO micro-/nanowire photodetector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the piezoelectric effect on the responsivity of a metal-semiconductor-metal ZnO micro-/nanowire photodetector. Piezo-phototronic effect can enhance the detection sensitivity more than fivefold for pW levels light detection.

articleTitle: Carrier envelope phase locked modelocking in fiber lasers at ultra-high repetition rates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a method for high repetition-rate multi-pass carrier-envelope-phase-locked passive modelocking of a fiber-laser. This method uses an intra-cavity Mach Zehnder interferometer and a feedback servo loop to stably control the pulse spacing and phase-slip.

articleTitle: Transformation of self-feedback weak-resonant-cavity fabry-perot laser diode pulsation from gain-switching to mode-locking under direct modulation at 10 GHz
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Pulsation of a self-feedback weak-resonant-cavity Fabry-Perot laser diode transferring from gain-switching to harmonic mode-locking is demonstrated under 10-GHz direct-modulation, which results in a 12-ps pulse-train with 20-dB longitudinal mode suppression and 7 dB mode extinction.

articleTitle: Modal gain and time-resolved photoluminescence of Ga(NAsP) heterostructures pseudomorphically grown on silicon (001) substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present room-temperature gain (up to 80 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) and time-resolved photoluminescence measurements in Ga(NAsP) grown lattice-matched on silicon substrate. We find a strong impact of the barrier-growth conditions on the optical quality of the material.

articleTitle: High fidelity large aperture periodically poled Rb:KTiOPO4 for high energy frequency conversion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate periodic poling of 5 mm thick Rb-doped KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystals at room temperature. The ferroelectric domain grating is shown to be uniform and homogeneous across the whole crystal aperture.

articleTitle: Fast control of a phase-sensitive fiber-optic parametric amplifier by frequency-swept Brillouin-gain dispersion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate in-line control of a phase-sensitive fiber-optic parametric amplifier by tuning the pump frequency of a Brillouin fiber pre-amplifier. This approach achieves an order of magnitude faster response compared to piezoelectric control.

articleTitle: Observation of symmetry-breaking beam dynamics in optically induced hexagonal photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study symmetry-breaking of the multi-vortex Bloch modes in optically induced hexagonal lattices. Such symmetry-breaking results from either exciting with an anisotropic beam or inducing an anisotropic photonic lattice.

articleTitle: Materials processing with femtosecond vortex pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first results on material processing with tightly focused single femtosecond laser vortex pulses. We use double-charge femtosecond vortices to produce micron-size ring-shaped structures with <;100 nm uniform groove thickness.

articleTitle: Continuously tunable wavelength conversion of data with record probe-idler separations in a silicon nanowire
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate tunable wavelength conversion of 10-Gb/s data with up to 168-nm probe-idler separation based on four-wave mixing in silicon nanowires. We incorporate an NRZ to-RZ format change using a pulsed pump and achieve error-free operation.

articleTitle: Non-axial-scanning second harmonic microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a chromatic second harmonic imaging technique that exploits the chromatic aberration of a Fresnel lens to focus different wavelengths into different axial positions to effectively realize axial scanning and improve imaging speed.

articleTitle: Nearly quantum defect-limited efficiency laser operation of a resonantly pumped Er3+-doped YVO4
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nearly quantum defect-limited laser operation of a resonantly-pumped Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> at 1593.5 nm is demonstrated. Achieved slope efficiency of ~85% is, to the best of our knowledge, the highest efficiency ever reported for crystalline Er-doped laser.

articleTitle: An efficient solar concentrator using volume hologram
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In this paper, we propose a simple technique to realize a compact and nearly all-angle solar energy concentrator using a volume holographic element (VHE). Our theoretical calculation predicts up to a fivefold concentration of energy per unit area of photovoltaic material. Hence, our holographic approach can offer an exceedingly high solar-concentration, a universal solution that can be easily integrated to any solar cells. Both the analysis and design of the volume holographic element will be described and demonstrated.

articleTitle: High gain fiber optical parametric chirped pulse amplification of femtosecond pulses at 1 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fiber-based OPCPA is reported in the femtosecond regime at 1 μm. A highly stretched signal has been amplified in a microstructured fiber with more than 30 dB gain by an all-fiber pulsed pump.

articleTitle: Extending quantum optical benchmarks with entanglement measures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Benchmarks based on entanglement verification can show when optical devices are in the quantum domain. Using no additional resources, we extend existing benchmarks to rigorously quantify the entanglement, covering nearly all of the quantum domain.

articleTitle: Design, fabrication and characterization of wideband ultra compact coupler between plasmonic slot and silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel ultra compact and wideband couplers between silicon and plasmonic slot waveguides are analyzed, characterized, and fabricated. An orthogonal junction configuration is employed for coupling between silicon waveguide and 50 nm plasmonic slot.

articleTitle: All-semiconductor plasmonic system in mid infrared range
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The feasibility of an all-semiconductor plasmonic structure is studied using highly doped InAs for Mid infrared (MIR) wavelength range. We proposed an all-semiconductor active plasmonic system on-a-chip with integrated plasmonic source, waveguide, and detector.

articleTitle: Generation of four wave mixing in graphene and carbon nanotubes optically deposited onto fiber ferrules
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We compared the third-order nonlinearity of graphene and carbon nanotubes optically deposited onto fiber ferrules using four-wave mixing. Significant idler waves are generated in both samples, and estimated nonlinearities are similarly high.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of locally oxidized hybrid silicon-plasmonic waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate self-aligned approach for fabrication of hybrid silicon plasmonic waveguide. The demonstrated structure provides both nanoscale confinement together with propagation length of 100 microns. Near-field measurements of propagation and coupling loss are also presented.

articleTitle: Polarization switching in the 2-μm Tm:KLu(WO2)4 laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on polarization switching in the Tm:KLu(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser between the N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub> and N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> states oscillating at different wavelengths. This switching strongly depends on the thermal management of the active medium.

articleTitle: Nanoantenna-enhanced gas sensing in a single tailored nanofocus
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate antenna-enhanced hydrogen sensing at the single-particle level. We place a single palladium nanoparticle near the tip region of a gold nanoantenna and detect the changing optical properties of the system upon hydrogen exposure.

articleTitle: High power tandem pumped photonic crystal fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a photonic crystal fiber amplifier tandem pumped by an industrial style thin-disk laser. Brightness enhancement with an output power of 1 kW and a slope of 74% has been obtained.

articleTitle: Anderson localization in optical waveguide arrays with off-diagonal coupling disorder
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe the transition from extended to Anderson-localized states in silica waveguide arrays exhibiting off-diagonal coupling disorder.

articleTitle: Exciton-photon coupling of InAs quantum dot in GaAs photonic crystal mode-gap nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate single quantum dot coupled to photonic crystal mode-gap cavities with high Q/V ratio. Polarization and temperature dependent photoluminescence are examined. Predominating polarization is observed for quantum dot coupled to cavity mode.

articleTitle: Quantum teleportation of Schrödinger's cat wave-packets of light
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate teleportation of Schrödinger's cat states of light in a fully quantum regime To further increase non-classicality of operations we propose two improvements: wave-packet frequency mode-matching; conditional teleportation.

articleTitle: Advances in fiber-based picosecond coherent anti-stokes Raman scattering thermometry in reacting flows
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A picosecond-laser-based, fiber-coupled CARS system employing multimode step-index fibers is developed for gas-phase thermometry in harsh combustion environments. Temperature measurements using this system are demonstrated in a laboratory flame.

articleTitle: Vibrational photoacoustic microscopy for depth-resolved bond-selective imaging of tissues and organisms
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We realize vibrational photoacoustic microscopy (VPA) using molecular excitation of overtone vibration and acoustic detection of the resultant pressure transients. We demonstrate 3-D VPA imaging of lipid-rich atherosclerotic plaques and lipid bodies in living Drosophila larvae by exciting 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> overtone of the CH bond stretch around 8300 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. Depth-resolved spectral analysis and a penetration depth of several mm are available.

articleTitle: Application of metal-clad antiresonant reflecting hollow waveguides to tunable terahertz notch filter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A continuously tunable terahertz notch filter is demonstrated by using antiresonant reflecting hollow waveguides. The maximum frequency-tuning-range approached 50% of the bandwidth, and a 20 dB notch-depth with a linewidth of 6 GHz was successfully achieved.

articleTitle: All-optical real-time OFDM transmitter and receiver
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: OFDM has emerged as a promising modulation technique in long-haul and access optical networks. The computational complexity of the format can be met with powerful digital signal processors, and especially by exploiting all-optical signal processing.

articleTitle: Advances in quantum dot lasers: Classical lasers and single artificial atom lasers with a nanocavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent advances in quantum dot-based nanophotonics are discussed, including the current state of the art of quantum dot lasers and cavity-QED in quantum-dot-2D/3D-photonic crystal-nanocavity coupled systems for single artificial atom lasers and related physics.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Newtonian photorealistic ray tracing of the conformal grating cloak
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Conformal grating cloaks are relatives of the carpet cloak and can deliver excellent cloaking for reasonable parameters. This is illustrated by photorealistic Newtonian ray-tracing calculations and by cross-correlation coefficients based on these.

articleTitle: Narrow bandgap semiconductor based THz-emitters
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The emission of terahertz (THz)-radiation pulses from binary and ternary narrow bandgap semiconductors is discussed. Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x</sub>As:Fe is a THz-emitter material for time-domain THz systems with potentially ≈1mW of average THz-radiation power at MHz repetition rates.

articleTitle: Remote focusing differential multiphoton microscopy: Application to neuronal imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We apply remote focusing to multi-focal multiphoton microscopy by simultaneously imaging multiple focal planes of Drosophila melanogaster olfactory neurons. This technology permits imaging the entire volume of the antennal lobe in a single scan.

articleTitle: Single-photon tunneling delay in a nematic liquid-crystal frustrated-total-internal-reflection structure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new theoretical treatment of photon tunneling delay in frustrated total internal reflection based on a dwell-time interpretation of the Hartman effect, as well as preliminary experimental measurements of single-photon delay.

articleTitle: Spatially resolved thermal analysis of high power LEDs using thermoreflectance imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 2D thermoreflectance images of light-emitting diodes (LEDs) show lateral temperature variation with contact design. Thermoreflectance imaging of LEDs is quantitatively compared with standard bulk temperature measurements. Encapsulation improves heat dissipation and reduces optical reabsorption heating.

articleTitle: Laser beam quality control with nonlinear interactions and adaptive optics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This lecture will review nonlinear interactions and adaptive optics techniques which permit a dynamic correction of beam distortions in solid-state lasers. Applications of these techniques including beam combining to fiber lasers will be also presented.

articleTitle: Low complexity soft decision circuit for LDPC decoders
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A reduced complexity implementation is proposed of an optical receiver for the soft decoding of low density parity check codes. Coding gain of 9.4 dB is achieved using 20% of the incoming optical signal.

articleTitle: High field transport of photo-injected electrons in GaAs: Transition from ballistic to drift motion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using visible/NIR pump and strong THz probe pulses, we observe the THz field emitted by accelerated photoelectrons in n-type GaAs. A transition from ballistic to drift motion is observed.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of the universal transpose operation using structural physical approximation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate approximating the universal transpose of quantum states of two-level systems (qubits) using the method known as the structural physical approximation to positive maps. We also report its experimental implementation in linear optics.

articleTitle: High TE-polarized optical gain from AlGaN-delta-GaN quantum well for deep UV lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of ultra-thin GaN delta-layer in high Al-content AlGaN quantum wells leads to the strong valence subbands rearrangement, which in turn results in high TE-polarized optical gain at emission wavelength ~250-300 nm.

articleTitle: Laser induced fluorescence for quantitative temperature and concentration measurements in internal combustion engines
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser induced fluorescence is used to acquire quantitative temperature and concentration images from optical engines. The quantification strategy using two wavelengths excitation, calibration results and exemplary results are presented.

articleTitle: Intraband optical transitions in graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured tunable interband and intraband transitions in graphene using infrared spectroscopy. Graphene electrons have strong intraband absorption at terahertz frequency range. The absorption spectra are described by a Drude-like frequency dependence.

articleTitle: Signatures of sub-Poissonian noise in the carrier-envelope phase jitter of highly stabilized mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that the carrier-envelope-frequency noise of stabilized mode-locked lasers can be a up to a factor 30 below the noise that should arise already from shot noise-level fluctuations of its pump laser.

articleTitle: Photoinduced femtosecond formation of ferromagnetism in a strongly correlated antiferromagentic manganite
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a pump threshold behavior of fs photoinduced magnetization enhancement in a antiferromagnetic manganite, which shows the establishment of thermally-inaccessible, hidden ferromagnetic ground state and build-up of new magnetic order parameters within 180 fs.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of classical far-field phase-sensitive ghost imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time far-field ghost imaging with phase-sensitive classical light whose anti-phase correlation between the signal and reference beams is imposed by two spatial light modulators.

articleTitle: Trapping and manipulating aerosols with optical bottle beams generated by Moiré technique
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate optical trapping and manipulation of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> nano-aerosols with optical bottle beams. This method based on the Moiré technique can be used for trapping a variety of absorbing nano-particles suspended in air.

articleTitle: Strong-field quantum control of energy ladder climbing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate coherent control of multiphoton absorption in a dynamically shifted energy level structure. In a three-level model system of atomic sodium, we controlled the quantum interference of sequential 2+1 photons and direct three-photon transitions.

articleTitle: Effect of speed of sound on quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy trace gas sensor performance
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The effect of speed of sound (SoS) on the performance of quartz-enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy (QEPAS) sensor was investigated. Methods to correct QEPAS signal and to minimize effect of SoS by the carrier gas was studied.

articleTitle: 40 GHz AlGaInAs/InP 1.55 μm passively mode-locked laser with low divergence angle and timing jitter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel 40 GHz passively mode-locked AlGaInAs/InP 1.55 μm laser was demonstrated with low divergence angle (12.7° × 26.3°), timing jitter of 440 is (100 Hz - 100 MHz), and RF line width of 25 kHz.

articleTitle: Scaling multipartite entanglement in the optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the simultaneous experimental generation of multiple quadri partite continuous-variable cluster states in the optical frequency comb of a single optical parametric oscillator operating below threshold.

articleTitle: Characteristics of GaN-based vertical cavity surface emitting lasers with hybrid mirrors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated CW current injection of GaN VCSELs with hybrid mirrors at room temperature. The laser characteristics, such as temperature dependent laser threshold current, spontaneous emission coupling factors, have been measured and discussed.

articleTitle: Novel high efficiency vertical optical coupler using subwavelength high contrast grating
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel vertical optical coupler using subwavelength high contrast grating is presented. Surface-normal incidence plane wave can be coupled into in-plane silicon-on-insulator waveguide with highest efficiency of 84% over a broad wavelength range.

articleTitle: Scaling mode-locked fiber lasers to high energies using chirally-coupled core fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report energy scaling of mode-locked fiber lasers using chirally-coupled core fiber. Pulse energies above 40 nJ dechirping below 200 fs are demonstrated, as well as dechirped durations around 100 fs at pump-limited energies.

articleTitle: Third-order antibunching from an imperfect single-photon source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure second- and third-order coherences of an imperfect single-photon source. The magnitude of third-order antibunching indicates that imperfect second-order antibunching results from background emission with Poissonian photon number statistics. Work of the United States government, not subject to U.S. copyright.

articleTitle: Measurement range expansion in Brillouin optical correlation-domain analysis system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel method for extension of measurement range in a Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis (BOCDA) sensor system by cascading fibers with different Brillouin frequency shifts.

articleTitle: Impact of sidewall roughness on integrated Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spectral responses of long Bragg gratings on photonic wires suffer from average effective index fluctuations caused by sidewall roughness. We numerically investigate this effect and determine the required roughness parameters for good quality gratings.

articleTitle: Spectral analysis of noise sources in InGaN light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Noise characterization of InGaN light emitting diodes shows that the exponent in current dependence of low-frequency flicker noise amplitude and the corner frequency in high-frequency generation-recombination noise spectra are two possible indicators for device reliability.

articleTitle: Tunneling current in a double quantum dot excitonic system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two coupled quantum dots entangled through their interaction with a cavity mode, including Forster and exciton-phonon interactions, allow for observation of the Josephson effect in terms of photon assisted tunneling current similar to super current.

articleTitle: Atomic vapor quantum memory for a photonic polarization qubit
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an experimental realization of an atomic vapor quantum memory for the photonic polarization qubit. The quantum memory is realized by means of electromagnetically-induced transparency in two spatially separated ensembles of warm Rubidium atoms in a single vapor cell. We have fully characterized the memory with quantum process tomography.

articleTitle: Amplified stimulated terahertz emission from optically pumped graphene
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The gapless and linear energy spectra of electrons and holes in graphene lead to nontrivial features such as negative dynamic conductivity in the terahertz spectral range. This paper reviews the recent advances in theoretical and experimental study on terahertz light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation in optically pumped graphene.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 10 GHz CMOS-compatible integrated photonic analog-to-digital converter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate two fully-functional channels of a real-time photonic ADC using mostly CMOS-compatible devices to optically sample and electronically digitize a 10-GHz RF signal with 37.9 dB SNR (6.0 ENOB) with a 1 GHz optical pulse train.

articleTitle: CO2 laser driven ion acceleration in a gas jet
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A train of multiterawatt, 3 ps CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser pulses is used for proton acceleration in a plasma at the critical density. Maximum energy of ions is strongly affected by a temporal structure of the pulse.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared direct injection and sub-wavelength focusing of designer's surface plasmons polaritons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A surface plasmon polariton (SPP) mode is directly excited on a metal/air interface using an integrated mid-infrared (MIR) quantum cascade laser. We demonstrate the SPP generation and propagation via far-field and near-field MIR imaging. We also demonstrate bending and focusing of MIR surface-plasmons using a sub-wavelength metal patterning.

articleTitle: Compact quantum cascade laser based atmospheric CO2 sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a compact sensor system for environmental CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> studies based on quantum cascade laser. The sensor targets the strongest fundamental CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> ro-vibrational band at 4.24μm and requires only 8mm optical path to provide sensitivity of 2 ppm.

articleTitle: Measurements of blood flow and hemoglobin concentration change in anesthetized rat using two-wavelength laser speckle imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measured simultaneously blood flow and hemoglobin concentration change in the exposed area of an anesthetized rat using laser speckle patterns acquired at two wavelengths. Blood flow was successfully analyzed in a frame rate. Changes of oxy- and deoxy-hemoglobin concentrations were temporally measured. These results indicate the usefulness of the method.

articleTitle: Effects of laser spectrum on amplified spontaneous emission prepulse duration in chirped pulse amplification lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that prepulse duration via amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) is strongly related to laser spectra in chirped-pulse amplification lasers due to pulse compressor dispersion. Although ASE prepulses overlap with stretched main pulses, we show that ASE prepulse duration can be reduced by injecting a laser pulse with a short center wavelength.

articleTitle: Multitap microwave photonic phase filter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate multitap microwave photonic filter with complex coefficient taps as a programmable spectral phase filter based on single-sideband modulation of an optical frequency comb, and line-by-line optical pulse shaping in an interferometeric scheme.

articleTitle: Enhancement of effective electro-optic coefficient in domain engineered UV-written waveguides in LiNbO3
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: UV laser-induced poling-inhibition produces inverted domains in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> which overlap significantly with waveguide modes. We have observed a 26% enhancement of the effective electro-optic coefficient in such domain-engineered waveguides.

articleTitle: Increase of capacity retention by laser structuring of thin film battery materials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Laser processes for fabrication of microstructures in thin film electrodes were developed with respect to a significant improvement of capacity retention of batteries. Several types of battery materials and surface structures were investigated.

articleTitle: Frequency-domain tomography of evolving light-velocity objects
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated single-shot frequency-domain tomographic imaging of laser-produced refractive index structures that evolve during propagation, using multiple probe pulses multiplexed to a single spectrometer and tomographic reconstruction algorithms.

articleTitle: Integrated hybrid nanophotonics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Based on a hybrid-plasmon (HPP) platform, we report the first demonstrations of low-loss, deep-subwavelength waveguiding and plasmon semiconductor Nanolaser with room temperature operating, towards wavelength-scale photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Pulsed laser triggered high speed microfluidic fluorescence activated cell sorter
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a high speed microfluidic fluorescence activated cell sorter (μFACS) capable of sorting at a throughput of 3000 beads/sec and 560 cells/sec with >;90% sample purity and 90% cell viability after sorting. The sorting mechanism is realized by exciting dynamic vapor bubbles with focused laser pulses in a microfluidic PDMS channel. The explosive bubble expansion generates fast fluid flows which are directed into a neighboring sample channel to switch the particle of interest into the collection channel. This ultrafast laser triggered switching mechanism has the potential to advance the sorting speed of the state-of-the-art μFACS.

articleTitle: Optically pumped room temperature InAs/InGaAsP microtube laser operating near 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an optically pumped InGaAsP microtube laser operating in the 1.64 μm wavelength range with InAs quantum dots as the gain medium. We observe room temperature continuous wave operation and a 4 μW threshold.

articleTitle: Ultrafast-laser interactions with soft biological tissues — A study with viable 3-D hydrogel cell cultures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We've developed a 3-dimensional hydrogel cell culture to investigate the effects of ultrafast laser pulses on soft biological tissues. We characterize the physical and histological impact of intense laser irradiation at >;100MHz repetition rates.

articleTitle: Optofluidically reconfigurable channel based microfluidics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we demonstrate the use of optofluidics to create rapidly reconfigurable channel based microfluidic systems, implemented through reversible rheological changes in a polymer solution flowing within the microfluidic device and dynamic photomasking.

articleTitle: Metallized ultrathin nanocrystalline Si membranes as biochemical SPR sensors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metal-coated ultrathin nanocrystalline Si membranes provides a novel substrate for biochemical sensing. FDTD simulations show SPR formation. The SPR peak is polarization dependent. Sensing experiments are performed with IPA and methanol.

articleTitle: Solution-processed 3D chalcogenide glass waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use solution-based micro-molding in capillaries and micro-transfer molding methods to fabricate and characterize integrated chalcogenide glass waveguides on non-planar, such as curved or stepped, surfaces for communication or sensing applications.

articleTitle: Tailored transverse modes in high-finesse femtosecond enhancement cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Degenerate transverse modes are used to excite a field distribution with maximum on axis intensity near the focus and avoiding a large on-axis aperture far away from the focus in a femtosecond resonator with finesse 3000.

articleTitle: Lensless on-chip color imaging using nano-structured surfaces and compressive decoding
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By modulating the diffraction pattern of a multi-color object using a nano-structured substrate, we demonstrate lens-free color imaging on a chip. This on-chip imaging modality could be important to create compact lens-free fluorescent microscopes.

articleTitle: Therapeutic applications of light: PDT — The killer; LLLT — The healer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Visible and near-infrared light can treat all human diseases. Light plus non-toxic dyes called photodynamic therapy (PDT) can kill cancer cells, pathogens and destroy unwanted tissue. In contrast light alone can reduce inflammation, stimulate healing and tissue repair.

articleTitle: Cross-correlation frequency-resolved optical gating by molecular wakes for ultraviolet femtosecond pulse measurement
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a molecular-alignment-based cross-correlation frequency-resolved optical gating technique for ultraviolet femtosecond pulse measurements by experimentally performing the measurements of the second and third harmonic UV pulses centered at 400 and 267 nm.

articleTitle: An epitaxial metal/semiconductor system for active plasmonic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an epitaxial metal/semiconductor system for integrating plasmonic functionality into the heart of active III-V nanophotonic devices. We describe their optical properties, growth, and prototype application to plasmonic light emitting diodes.

articleTitle: Sized-based optical particle sorting using an orthogonal beam in optofluidic waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate on-chip, sized-based, optical sorting in optofluidic ARROW waveguides. Large particles are separated out of a mixture of particles of varying size as they pass through an intersecting beam.

articleTitle: Strained germanium membrane using thin film stressor for high efficiency laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel method to introduce more than 0.6% biaxial tensile strain and achieve a 60meV direct band gap reduction in epitaxially grown germanium is demonstrated. Possible applications include high efficiency germanium lasers on silicon substrates.

articleTitle: Assessing human skin with light
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a variety of methods based on optical spectroscopy for assessing human skin health status.

articleTitle: Characterization of DNA optical microfiber devices fabricated by drawing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the characterization of DNA optical microfiber devices fabricated by manually drawing. The strength, flexibility and optical loss are experimentally investigated. DNA optical microfiber devices are expected to be used as optical biosensors.

articleTitle: High speed 980 nm VCSELs for short reach optical interconnects operating error-free at 25 Gbit/s up to 85 °C
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present 980 nm VCSELs operating error-free at a bit rate of 25 Gbit/s at temperatures of up to 85°C. These devices are advantageous for future optical interconnects in high performance computer applications.

articleTitle: CW and modelocked operation of an Yb:(Sc, Y, Lu)2O3 thin-disk laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the first cw and modelocked thin-disk laser based on the broadband sesquioxide material Yb:(Sc, Y, Lu)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. We demonstrate 50 W in cw operation with a slope efficiency >;70% and 3.9 W in 236-fs pulses in modelocked operation.

articleTitle: Time-domain analysis of pulse propagation in high-contrast layered structures with resonant nonlinearities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a generalized time-domain transfer-matrix method, the only method to our knowledge that is capable of modeling high-index-contrast layered structures with non analytical form of dispersion and slow resonant nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Brillouin-based DPSK demodulation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present BER performance of all-optical 10-Gb/s DPSK demodulation obtained by an SBS active filter generated by an incoherent pump, tailored with a FBG properly designed to achieve a 6.7-GHz Gaussian spectral response.

articleTitle: Direct amplification of ultrashort pulses in μ-pulling down Yb:YAG single crystal fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated that Yb:YAG single crystal fibers have a strong potential for the amplification of femtosecond pulses. Seeded by 230 fs pulses with an average power of 400 mW, the system produced 330 fs pulses with an average power of 12 W. This is the shortest pulse duration ever produced by a Yb:YAG amplifier. The gain in the single crystal fiber reached a value as high as 30 in a simple double pass configuration.

articleTitle: ENZ-enhanced transmission through subwavelength slits
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have performed comprehensive analysis of the ENZ-enhanced light transmission through subwavelength slits, identified bulk plasma resonance as a main cause of this transmission, and developed an analytical description of the phenomenon.

articleTitle: Characterization of dodecane-surfactant-brine emulsions using THz imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the feasibility of using terahertz imaging to quantify the relative dodecane (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">26</sub>) content and long-term stability of dodecane-surfactant-brine emulsions of varying salinity for their use in surfactant-enhanced oil recovery.

articleTitle: Generation and detection of very short-wavelength surface acoustic waves at nano-interfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using an ultrafast laser to excite 2D nanostructures, and coherent extreme ultraviolet light to detect the resulting acoustic response, we observe and characterize the shortest-wavelength (35 nm) surface acoustic waves to date.

articleTitle: On-chip mirrorless-oscillation in nonlinear silicon waveguides using non-degenerate four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Nondegenerate mirrorless four-wave mixing oscillation with frequency tunability is proposed in silicon nonlinear waveguide by using higher spatial mode. As low as ~2W threshold power is obtained in several centimeters long waveguide.

articleTitle: Optical Metatronics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metamaterial structures provide suitable platforms for unifying the concepts of electronics, photonics, and magnetics. In this tutorial, I give an overview of the fundamental concepts, recent developments, and future directions in the field of metatronics.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave diode-pumped Pr3+:BaY2F8 orange laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a continuous wave orange Pr:BaY<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</inf> laser pumped by a blue GaN laser diode. A maximal output power of 78 mW at 607 nm is obtained in a quasi single transverse mode beam.

articleTitle: Spatially incoherent random lasers for full field optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate control of the spatial coherence of random laser emission by tuning the scattering strength and excitation volume. The optimized, spatially incoherent source is applied to full-field optical coherence tomography to mitigate crosstalk.

articleTitle: Line-by-line pulse shaping at spectral resolution below 1 GHz
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Line-by-line pulse shaping is demonstrated on mode-locked titanium sapphire laser with a repetition rate <; 1 GHz. The necessary high spectral resolution pulse shaper is described and its output analyzed.

articleTitle: Waveguide mode filter fabricated using laser-induced forward transfer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Titanium in-diffused lithium niobate index-tapered waveguides have been fabricated using laser-induced forward transfer technique for mode-filtering applications. Details of their fabrication, losses and transmission characterization are presented.

articleTitle: Phase-managed alias sampling in 1-Tb/s coherent optical OFDM
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The sampling rate is reduced to half of the Nyquist frequency to release the ADC requirement in CO-OFDM system. An experiment of 1-Tb/s multi-band CO-OFDM with hybrid subcarrier modulations and phase-managed alias sampling is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional invisibility carpet cloak at 700 nm wavelength
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a three-dimensional carpet cloak composed of a 350-nm rod-spacing woodpile photonic crystal with tailored local volume filling fraction. Microscope images under monochromatic illumination reveal excellent cloaking at 700 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Search for patterns in single-photon polarization sequences
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Sequences of polarization measurements on single photons were subjected to comprehensive runs analysis without numerical unbiasing. No significant discrepancies with the predicted numbers of runs were observed, even with multi-photon events retained.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact coupled-resonator device for four-wave mixing applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
