abstract: A coupled-resonator device consisting of three compact microresonators is proposed and demonstrated for efficient FWM in silicon. The possibility of tuning of signal and idler wavelengths in this device enables novel reconfigurable nonlinear experiments.

articleTitle: Full phononic bandgap in 2D-optomechanical crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous strong confinement and interaction of photons and phonons in a quasi two-dimensional (2D) slab.

articleTitle: Simultaneous nanometer and femtosecond spatiotemporal control of optical fields
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the simultaneous and independent spatiotemporal control of optical fields on nanometer length and femtosecond time scales, enabled by the intrinsic adiabatic and mode-matched surface plasmon polariton nanofocusing ability of 3D tapered Au tips, in combination with femtosecond pulse shaping using MIIPS.

articleTitle: Terahertz endoscope based on anti-resonant reflecting hollow core waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A terahertz endoscope utilizing a single plastic hollow-tube with low bending loss is demonstrated to identify molecular concentration and map out object surface-altitudes. The measurements are well consistent with the calculated results.

articleTitle: Rapid automatic high-precision in-situ wavelength calibration for tunable lasers using an athermal AWG
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This paper presents a rapid in-situ automatic calibration technique for tunable SSG DBR lasers using an athermal AWG. The preliminary experiment demonstrates laser calibration for 3 wavelengths completed in 30 seconds with an accuracy of ±0.015 nm.

articleTitle: Triggering, guiding and deviation of long spark discharges with femtosecond laser filament
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show for the first time that filaments are able to divert electric discharges from their normal path. Comparison between negative and positive discharge polarities reveals important differences in the guiding mechanism.

articleTitle: Nonlinear self-trapping of broad beams in defocusing lithium niobate waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the localization of broad beams in defocusing waveguide arrays. Unlike gap solitons, these novel localized states have an arbitrary width defined by the size of the input beam while independent on nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Optical devices based on cylindrically anisotropic metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By exploiting resonance cones inside cylindrically anisotropic materials, we present two optical devices, an optical multiplexer based on the dispersive properties of a metal-insulator stack metamaterial, and a far-field bilayer subwavelength imaging system.

articleTitle: Mechanically compliant high contrast grating mirrors for radiation pressure cooling
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed micromechanical membranes with high reflectivity and low mass for optical cooling. By patterning silicon nitride membranes with grating structures we have achieved reflectivity of R = 99% and a quality factor of Q = 1.6 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>.

articleTitle: Highly-stable Yb-doped fiber laser mode-locked in a regime of SESAM two-photon absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a single-polarization Yb-doped fiber laser mode-locked in a regime of SESAM two-photon absorption. The laser emits ultra-stable pulses at 1030 nm with a pulse-width of 2 ps, an pulse-energy of 1 nJ at the repetition rate of 186 MHz, a spectral-width of 26 nm, and the dechirped pulse-width of 116 fs, respectively.

articleTitle: Self-accelerating self-trapped beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present self-accelerating self-trapped beams in self-focusing and self-defocusing Kerr and saturable media. Such beams are stable under self-defocusing and weak self-focusing, whereas for strong self focusing they off-shoot solitons while their main lobe continues accelerating.

articleTitle: Seeded femtosecond supercontinuum in Kr gas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe spectral enhancement of femtosecond supercontinua in krypton gas using weak, nJ to μJ, seed pulses with the order of ~mJ pump pulses resulting in >; 3× total energy enhancement and spectral broadening.

articleTitle: Spontaneous emission near hyperbolic metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that there is an infinite local-density -of-states in the near-field of a hyperbolic metamaterial. This leads to channeling of spontaneous emission into resonance cones of metamaterial states opening the route to quantum-optics with metamaterials.

articleTitle: Remote backwards lasing in air
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate high gain lasing in air from two-photon dissociation of molecular oxygen and simultaneous resonant two-photon pumping of an atomic oxygen fragment. This backwards emission provides a remote laser source for standoff detection.

articleTitle: Sub-femtosecond timing jitter optical pulse trains from mode-locked Er-fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate sub-femtosecond timing jitter optical pulse trains generated from passively mode-locked Er-doped fiber lasers. The measured rms timing jitter is 0.84 fs integrated from 10 kHz to 40.6 MHz (Nyquist frequency).

articleTitle: Narrow-linewidth chirped frequency comb from a seeded frequency-shifted feedback Ti:Sapphire laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the coherence properties of a narrow-linewidth chirped frequency comb from a frequency-shifted feedback laser seeded by a phase-modulated sub-kHz-linewidth single frequency fiber laser. A length-dependent, <;20-Hz wide RF beat is observed.

articleTitle: Two-color-laser-driven direct electron acceleration in infinite vacuum
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a scheme that uses a two-color pulsed radially-polarized laser beam to achieve electron acceleration exceeding 90% of the theoretical energy gain limit, over twice of what is possible with a one-color beam.

articleTitle: Mid-IR supercontinuum (SC) generation in ZBLAN fiber pumped by Tm-doped amplifier with fused silica SC input
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate supercontinuum generation beyond 4.5 μm by first shifting 1.55 μm laser-diode pulses to ~2 μm in standard single-mode fiber followed by amplification using Tm doped amplifier and subsequent coupling to ~7 m ZBLAN fiber.

articleTitle: Formation of laser-induced periodic structures in TiO2 crystals depending on the surface quality
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The formation of femtosecond laser induced periodic surface structure in TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> crystals significantly depends on surface quality. Higher roughness shifts ripple formation towards lower fluence and lower pulse number and improve structural coherence.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable photonic metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the first temperature driven mechanically reconfigurable photonic metamaterials (RPMs) providing tunability at optical frequencies.

articleTitle: Mid-IR few-cycle pulses approaching a 0.1 TW peak power
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a compact 20-Hz-repetition-rate mid-IR OPCPA for application in high-field science which operates at 3900 nm with a FWHM bandwidth of 600 nm delivering 6 mJ pulses compressed to 75±10 fs (<;6 optical cycles).

articleTitle: All-normal-dispersion fiber lasers for frequency metrology
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Development of an all-normal-dispersion Yb-doped fiber laser-based frequency comb is reported. Repetition-frequency stabilization to the cesium standard, amplitude and phase noise measurements indicate low-noise performance.

articleTitle: Anti-stokes photoluminescence in GaN due to three-photon absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed anti-Stokes photoluminescence from n-type free-standing GaN, pumped at the excitation photon energy of 1.586 eV, due to three-photon absorption.

articleTitle: Enhanced conversion efficiency of a crystalline silicon solar cell with frustum nanorod arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Enhanced photoelectric conversion is demonstrated in a crystalline silicon (c-Si) solar cell with frustum nanorod arrays (FNAs). The omnidirectional antireflection of FNAs is also investigated using an angle-resolved reflectance spectroscopy and simulated by RCWA method.

articleTitle: Design of three-terminal GaN light emitting HBT for free space communication
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: This abstract presents design and simulation results of a GaN-based multi-quantum well (MQW) heterojunction transistor (HBT) LED. The combination of the narrow base and collector terminal allows a very fast turn-off delay in the device.

articleTitle: Full-field quantum correlations with multi-pixel detectors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using multi-pixel detectors, we demonstrate strong full-field quantum correlations in the position and momentum bases. Spatial light modulators used as tunable lenses enabled the observation of correlations in various superpositions of these bases.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration and simulation of lossless metal-free integrated elliptical reflectors for waveguide turnings and crossings
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Novel on-chip waveguide turnings and crossings based on metal-free elliptical reflectors are simulated and demonstrated, 1μm-wide waveguide case gives half the loss in elliptical reflector turn (16% loss) compared to plane mirror turn (30% loss).

articleTitle: Wavelength engineered luminescent material incorporating colloidal quantum dot within a nanoporous gallium nitride matrix
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A new nanocomposite material was created by embedding colloidal CdSe-based quantum dots (QDs) within single crystal nanoporous gallium nitride (GaN) host. High efficiency luminescence and wavelength-engineered ability of colloidal QDs combined with high performance of nitride blue LEDs suggest this nanomaterial's potential for solid state lighting.

articleTitle: Promotion of the inverted polymer solar cells with NiO modification
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The solution derived NiO suppresses the leakage current and acts as the oxide and moisture barrier to improve the stability with 80% of the maximum efficiency retained over 60 days and the efficiency to 3.87%.

articleTitle: Dynamic sub-20 ns reconfiguration of a silicon CMOS photonic filter and filter shape measurement
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dynamic filter shapes of a silicon photonic lattice filter switching between a notch and bandpass filter are measured at a 16.67 ns interval using a frequency-to-time mapping method and a coherent measurement technique.

articleTitle: Anderson delocalization in one dimensional μ or ∊-near-zero metamaterial stacks and other dispersion effects on localization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have carried out a comprehensive study of dispersion and absorption effects on Anderson localization in one-dimensional metamaterial stacks and have shown that the field is delocalized in μ or ε-near-zero media at normal incidence.

articleTitle: Design of synchronous “plug & play” QKD-WDM-PON for efficient quantum communications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a new design of quantum key distribution (QKD) - WDM-PON with "plug & play" scheme and synchronization. Simulations show that the design can improve the quantum key generation rate 3-4 times over conventional schemes.

articleTitle: Amplification of surface plasmons: Theory and experiment
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The amplification of single-interface and long-range surface plasmons by dipolar gain media is reviewed. Of particular interest are plasmons on thin metal stripes propagating through dye, where amplification and reduced spontaneous emission were simultaneously observed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear microspctroscopy for biomedical applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will present modern trends in nonlinear microscopy spanning a multitude of different technologies from e.g. multi-photon fluorescence microscopy towards label free methods e.g. generation of second harmonic as well as nonlinear Raman microscopy (CARS).

articleTitle: Continuous tuning of terahertz generation in fan-out periodically poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Tunable terahertz pulses were generated in fan-out periodically poled structure with QPM period of 50 to 90 μm. Center frequency was tuned from 0.94 to 1.55 THz with as narrow as band-width of 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Cavity optomechanical sensors for atomic force microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a silicon cavity optomechanical sensor for atomic force microscopy through near-field coupling between a nanocantilever and microdisk cavity. The device exhibits sub-fm/ VHz displacement sensitivity, GHz bandwidth, and > 60 dB of dynamic range.

articleTitle: Robust optical inversion of the excitonic population of InGaAs quantum dots via adiabatic rapid passage
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show population inversion in a semiconductor quantum dot with a chirped optical pulse via adiabatic rapid passage. This method is insensitive to variations in the dipole coupling and provides a new tool for preparing ensembles of quantum states.

articleTitle: Dual-function metallic nanohole arrays: Electrokinetic analyte concentration and plasmonic sensing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Metallic nanostructures facilitate analyte sensing through localization of surface plasmons. In this work, we demonstrate that the same metal nanostructures can also facilitate the concentration and localization of analyte at the active sensing surface. Specifically, the structure of flow-through plasmonic nanohole array sensors presents the opportunity of locally increasing analyte concentration using electrokinetic phenomena. The synergistic combination of analyte concentration and sensing promises increased effectiveness and reduced detection limits. An 80 fold increase in concentration is achieved in 100 s with a 100 V field applied. This is the first demonstration of an optofluidic system in which a nanostructure enables both analyte concentration and sensing.

articleTitle: Demonstration of terahertz generation by mixing passively Q-switched dual-frequency ND:YLF laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: After reducing timing jitter between each pair of dual-frequency pulses generated by a passively Q-switched laser by 20 times, we have successfully generated THz pulses based on frequency mixing.

articleTitle: Functional fluorescent nanocapsules for molecular imaging and potential targeted therapy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dual-functional nanocapsules are developed using FDA approved materials for translational fluorescence molecular imaging and potential targeted therapy. In intro and in vivo experiments were conducted to test the performance of the functional nanocapsules.

articleTitle: Subwavelength waveguide grating coupler for fiber-to-chip coupling on SOI with 80nm 1dB-Bandwidth
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel subwavelength grating coupler on SOI for coupling between fiber and nanophotonic waveguide with a wide bandwidth. 80 nm 1 dB bandwidth was experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Two pulse control of magnetization precession in ferrimagnetic GdFe films under low-power excitation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated two pulse control of magnetization precession of GdFe films using low-power pulse of 18 μJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Our result suggests that the accurate control of magnetization precession should be achieved only by the low-power excitation.

articleTitle: Wide-field lensless fluorescent imaging of transgenic Caenorhabditis Elegans on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate lensless on-chip fluorescent imaging of transgenic C.Elegans over >;2-8 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> field-of-view with a resolution of -10 μm. This is the first time that a lensless on-chip platform has successfully imaged transgenic C.elegans samples.

articleTitle: Color-tunable periodic emission of alloyed CdS1−xSex/Sn: CdS1−xSex superlattice microwires
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a color-tunable emission from the semiconductor superlattice alloyed microwire. Such unique microwire can modulate photons and/or excitons, like one-dimensional coupled optical microcavities, to produce multiple emission modes.

articleTitle: Peregrine soliton in optical fiber-based systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first observation in optics of the Peregrine soliton, a novel class of nonlinear localized structure. Two experimental configurations are explored and the impact of non-ideal initial conditions is discussed.

articleTitle: A VBG-stabilized narrow linewidth, spectrally tunable, Yb:YAG thin-disk laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an Yb: YAG thin-disk oscillator providing a tunable linewidth of 50-pm via VBG-based feedback. Output powers of up to 2 W have been recorded while maintaining an excellent spatial profile.Volume Bragg gratings

articleTitle: Remote gas leak detection using a portable mini-Lidar, based on a doubly-resonant OPO
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on remote gas leak detection using a portable mini-Lidar. The Lidar transmitter is based on a micro-laser pumped, entangled cavities, doubly-resonant optical parametric oscillator, allowing specific tuning procedures in the 3.8-4.3μm range.

articleTitle: Yb:YLF as active medium in the thin disk laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Results of the first Yb:LiYF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> thin disk laser experiments are presented. 5.87 W output power and up to 42% slope efficiency have been obtained under 973 nm pumping using a 30% Yb-doped disk with 200 μm thickness.

articleTitle: Direct visualization of delocalized band-edge Slow-Bloch Mode laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the near- and far-field investigation of the Slow Bloch Mode associated with the Γ point of the Brillouin zone, for an active honeycomb lattice photonic crystal, using near-field scanning optical microscopy.

articleTitle: Hybrid modal-phase-matched and bent-quasi-phase-matched wavelength conversion in AlGaAs/SiO2 rib-type zigzag waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel wavelength conversion device based on hybrid modal phase matching and quasi phase matching in combined straight and bent waveguides with the laterally inverted core structure. Numerical simulations revealed that conversion efficiency as high as 27500 %/W is attainable for 1.55-μm SHG in a 32-mm-long AlGaAs/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> rib waveguide that can be folded up into a 1.6-mm x 84 μm domain.

articleTitle: Terahertz coherent control of many-electron qubits in a quantum hall system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coherent control of many-electron qubits in a GaAs quantum well is demonstrated using a sequence of THz pulses. There is no signature of electron-electron interactions, generalizing the Kohn's theorem to the level of coherent dynamics.

articleTitle: High-sensitivity in vivo THz fiber-scanning mammography of early breast cancer in nude mice
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an in vivo transmission T-ray mammography for early breast cancer detection in an animal model. Compared to the state-of-the-art sensitivity of X-ray mammography (Volume: 4.22mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>), T-ray achieved much earlier cancer detection (Volume: 0.5mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>).

articleTitle: Low-threshold lasing in organic semiconductor microcones
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the fabrication and optical characterization of whispering-gallery microcavity lasers with an organic semiconductor gain layer and laser thresholds as low as 1 nJ per pulse, operating at visible wavelengths.

articleTitle: Metamaterial models of exotic spacetimes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that optical space in metamaterials may be engineered to mimic physics of such exotic spacetimes as the warp drive and various five-dimensional spacetimes.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic device optimization with adjoint FDTD
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The sensitivity of a nanophotonic device's performance with respect to changes in its shape and size can be efficiently obtained by adjoint FDTD. By optimizing the structure's boundary we constrain resulting designs to be fabricatable.

articleTitle: Time domain switching / demultiplexing using four wave mixing in GaInP photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Dynamical four wave mixing in GalnP photonic crystal waveguides is demonstrated for time domain switching/demultiplexing to extract one out of 16 or 32 channels having an aggregate bit rate of 10.56Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation with self-healing Airy pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report experiments and simulations of supercontinuum generation with Airy pulses in a microstructured fiber. The dominant peak of the pulse is continuously rebuilt after soliton formation events resulting in the generation of distinct spectral features.

articleTitle: Multiplexed fluorescence lifetime microscopy by frequency-sweeping Fourier spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a multiplexed fluorescence lifetime confocal scanning microscopy method based on frequency sweeping Fourier fluorescence lifetime spectroscopy. It simultaneously obtains nanosecond fluorescence lifetime images at multiple excitation wavelengths.

articleTitle: Quantum control of electron spins in semiconductors with phase-locked Raman pulse pairs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of full quantum control of electron spins in semiconductors with phase-locked Raman pulse pairs, mapping relative optical phase directly onto the phase of electron spin polarization.

articleTitle: 10-fs deep-ultraviolet pulses without second- and third-order dispersions
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 10-fs deep-ultraviolet pulses are generated by broadband four-wave mixing and with a pulse compressor consisting of prisms and gratings. Pulse distortion in an ultrafast spectroscopic setup can be compensated by the compressor.

articleTitle: Coherent phonons in polycrystalline bismuth film monitored by ultrafast electron diffraction
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The generation of coherent phonons in polycrystalline bismuth film is observed by ultrafast time-resolved electron diffraction. The dynamics of the diffracted intensities from the (110), (202), and (024) lattice planes show pronounced oscillations at 130–150 GHz. The anisotropy in the energy transfer rate of coherent optical phonons is discussed.

articleTitle: Laser metal deposition of steel components using machining waste as build material
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Gas atomised metal powders are generally used in laser cladding. However, costly new powders prompt the use of machining swarf as an alternative build material. This paper reports on this investigation and establishes its feasibility.

articleTitle: Modal gain, loss, and thermal resistance of a metamorphic GaSb-based laser in room-temperature continuous-wave operation at 2 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a metamorphic type-I GaSb-based laser grown on a GaAs substrate that operates continuous wave at room temperature with low internal loss and low thermal resistance compared to pseudomorphic lasers.

articleTitle: Visible light generation and its influence to supercontinuum in As2S3 microstructured fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate visible light generation in As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> microstructured fiber for the first time. It limits the spectral range of supercontinuum. The visible light generation can be avoided by designing the fiber for the single-mode operation.

articleTitle: Toothed mid-infrared metal-insulator-metal waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We fabricate subwavelength varying periodicity toothed metal-insulator-metal waveguides for mid-infrared frequencies. The transmission spectra of these structures for TM and TE polarized light is investigated, and our results compared to numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave-band pulse formation using Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Millimeter-wave-band pulse formation was demonstrated by mixing cw lights and optical pulses extracted from optical comb signals. Millimeter wave pulse with the carrier frequency of 130 GHz and 10 ps-width was observed.

articleTitle: Sub-millijoule CEP stable 1.6 cycle laser pulses at 1.8 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report sub-mJ carrier envelope phase (CEP) stable 1.6 cycle pulses at 1.8μm. With those pulses, we have obtained 160eV cut-off in argon at an intensity of 1.4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> using the process of high harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Coupled mode theory of field enhancement in complex metal nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an analytical model that takes into account the coupling between the surface Plasmon modes in complex metal nanostructures. We apply this model to evaluate the field enhancement in the gap of two coupled metal spheres. This approach offers a clear physical insight for the enhancement and a straightforward method for optimization.

articleTitle: Highly unidirectional whispering gallery mode lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report elliptical resonators with a wavelength-size notch at the boundary, which supports highly unidirectional emission from whispering gallery modes. Using quantum cascade lasers, a unidirectional in-plane beam divergence of 6 degrees has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Kilometer range filamentation: Effects of filaments on transparent and non-transparent materials at long distances
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe filamentation of a Terawatt laser beam after 1 km propagation in atmosphere. The white light generated was strong enough to saturate a CCD camera and damages on material were characterised.

articleTitle: Light localization and Shockley surface states in honeycomb photonic lattices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an induction technique to generate honeycomb photonic lattices with equal and unequal sites in each unit-cell. We show light localization as nonlinear solitons and linear Shockley surface states in lattices with unequal sites.

articleTitle: Nanoscale lasers: How small can they go?
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent progress in both theory and experiment of nanoscale lasers will be presented. We will discuss metal-cavity nanolasers, their designs and performances, and how our theory explains the experimental data with a good agreement.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics in catastrophic optical bulk damaged InGaAs-AlGaAs strained QW broad-area lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated catastrophic optical bulk damage in high power broad-area InGaAs strained quantum well lasers with windowed n-contacts using time-resolved EL and transient PL techniques.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal nanolasers, modulation and coherence characteristics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate coherent emission at 300K and at 1.55μm from photonic crystal nanolasers under gain-switched operation. 10GHz gain switching operation has been achieved with bit-pattern independent chirp.

articleTitle: Synthesis of flat and broadband parametric gain by idler loss in optical fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Besides dispersion engineering, idler-band distributed loss provides a new synthesis freedom to flatten and broaden the gain spectrum for fiber-optic parametric amplifier. The pump-to-signal conversion efficiency is kept high in spite of the loss.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser direct fabrication of integrated optical wave plates in fused silica
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond laser fabrication of optical waveguides in bulk silica glass is extended to integrated optical waveplates. Polarization retardation was controlled by laser exposure, providing for trimming of waveguide birefringence between 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>.

articleTitle: Noise reduction of supercontinua via optical feedback
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Noise reduction via optical feedback concerning the pulse energy and spectral amplitude of supercontinua is demonstrated experimentally and numerically by comparing the feedback system with a common single-pass supercontinuum generating system.

articleTitle: Influence of modulation of pump and seed signals on fiber amplification of broadband pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on characterization of the transfer of pump and seed signal modulations, including noise, during fiber amplification. We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that pump (signal) modulations are transferred only below (above) a cut-off frequency.

articleTitle: A highly efficient diode-pumped pulsed laser based on room-temperature Yb:YAG ceramics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A highly efficient pulsed-diode-pumped, room-temperature Yb: YAG ceramic laser with a slope efficiency of 78% and an optical-to-optical efficiency of 51% has been demonstrated. This is the highest slope efficiency for a room-temperature Yb: YAG ceramic laser reported to date.

articleTitle: Critical coupling requirements for surface plasmon enhanced magneto-optic isolators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The critical coupling criteria between dielectric waveguides and lossy surface plasmons is applied to isolator designs. This framework shows that non-reciprocal plasmon-semiconductor waveguides are not achievable, and alternatives are proposed.

articleTitle: Diffraction control of Bessel beams generated in fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0,m</sub> fiber cladding modes propagate as Bessel beams in free space. We show that selecting the mode order with a long period grating enables tuning of the propagation distance and width of the center spot.

articleTitle: Coherent optical spectroscopy of a single quantum dot via an off-resonant cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Coherent interaction between a quantum dot and a resonant laser is observed through an incoherent read-out channel created by coupling to an off-resonant cavity. Under bichromatic driving of the quantum dot optical output collected from the off-resonant cavity exhibits two peaks, a signature of Rabi-side bands that matches closely with our theoretical model. The off-resonant cavity provides a convenient method for resonant quantum dot spectroscopy and quantum dot state readout.

articleTitle: Space-time features of THz emission from optical rectification in sub-wavelength areas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present our investigation on the THz space-time emission characteristic induced by the non-paraxial generation regime in highly localized THz generation via optical rectification on sub-wavelength areas.

articleTitle: Optical fibre with embedded diamond nanocrystals: Towards a high collection efficiency, waveguided single photon source
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A model for the capture of diamond colour centre emission by a step-index fibre, including effects due to the fibre core-cladding interface, is presented. We investigate the parameter space for optimal single photon capture.

articleTitle: Fourth order cascaded Raman shift in As38Se62 chalcogenide suspended core fiber pumped at 1.995 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fourth order cascaded Raman wavelength shift is demonstrated in As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>gSeg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> suspended core fiber using 1995 nm nanosecond source. The measured Raman gain coefficient is-2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> m/W at 1995 nm. The Raman peaks are reproduced by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Strong coupling between excitons in J aggregates and waveguide modes in thin polymer films
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe waveguide exciton-polaritons with large room temperature Rabi splittings of 190 meV and 125 meV for TE and TM modes respectively. The experimental results are in good agreement with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Theoretical approach to the ultrafast nonlinear optical response of metal slabs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an ab-initio method for calculating nonlinear and nonlocal optical effects in metallic slabs with sub-wavelength thickness. We find a strong localization of the second-harmonic current at the metal-vacuum interface.

articleTitle: Line-by-line pulse-shaping reconfigurable at GHz rates using injection-locked VCSELs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate pulse-shaping at reconfiguration rates at half the repetition rate of the laser. Injection-locked VCSELs independently modulate four optical comb lines at frequencies up to 3.125 GHz, changing the pulse shape from pulse-to-pulse.

articleTitle: Laser-induced forward transfer of pre-machined donor films
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Micro-pellets of ZnO with a diameter of 5–10 μm and extremely smooth edges have been printed using laser-induced forward transfer from 1 μm thick films, that had been pre-patterned using focussed ion beam (FIB) machining.

articleTitle: Invisibility at entire visible frequency using carbon nanotube carpet
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we show a perfect absorption ground plane cloak that works at entire visible frequency. Such homogeneous perfect absorption carpet is made of low density carbon nanotube (CNT) "forest", and invisibility has been observed by naked eyes for unpolarized light at entire visible frequency with cloaking area 100 times larger than a wavelength.

articleTitle: Observation of slow relaxation on nano-confined water in nanoporous MCM-41 by terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interfacial structural and condensed water in nanoporous MCM-41 were investigated by THz-TDS for the first time. A slow reorientation relaxation time of 30 and 100 ps were observed for condensed and structural water.

articleTitle: Forming a nonlinear grating in Silicon nanowire waveguides using the intrinsic anisotropic Kerr nonlinearity of Silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a numerical analysis demonstrating that the anisotropy of the Kerr effect in Silicon can be used to form a nonlinear grating in Silicon waveguides with uniform cross-section.

articleTitle: VACNT-on-silicon platform for improving heat conduction in optoelectronic packaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon platforms with high-density vertically aligned carbon nanotubes on patterned substrates are designed to provide efficient thermal transfer for optoelectronic chips. 20% increase in output power is obtained when applying for LED packaging.

articleTitle: Plasmonic junctions with cucurbit[5]uril ‘glue’: Fabrication of precise sub-nm junctions in gold nanoparticle assemblies
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Aggregation of gold nanoparticles with rigid cucurbit[5]uril molecules generates fixed inter-particle separations of 0.91 nm. These nanoparticle assemblies possess discrete plasmonic modes which elucidate nanoscale growth and serve as molecular-recognition based SERS substrates.

articleTitle: Impact of Brillouin scattering on R-SOA based WDM PON power budget
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Brillouin scattering effect in a colorless 25-km bidirectional WDM PON is experimentally evaluated. Downstream 10-Gb/s DPSK signal is directly received with a novel FBG, seeding an R-SOA at the ONU, for upstream 1.25-Gb/s OOK transmission.

articleTitle: In-line holographic CARS microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigated inline holographic CARS microscopy, in which the reference generated from a nonlinear medium co-propagates with the CARS signal produced from a specimen. We show that this technique has 3D chemical selective imaging capability.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal nonlinear optics in arrays of subwavelength waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spectral broadening in an array of subwavelength silicon waveguides pumped with fs pulses is studied. Adjusting input pulse position, different spectral patterns are observed and explained using the resonant emission from temporal supermode solitons.

articleTitle: Micro-fluidic flow switching by using an optical beam
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the application of an optical beam to redirect sheathed micro-fluidic flow without direct interaction with the sample. The hydrodynamic properties of the sheath are locally modified resulting in a sample location shift.

articleTitle: Extracting an entanglement signature from only classical mutual information
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use classical mutual information to characterize two photons measured in three mutually unbiased bases. We theoretically and experimentally compare entangled and separable states and find a bound on the information capacity of the pair.

articleTitle: Optomechanical coupling in slot-type photonic crystal cavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a strong optomechanical coupling air-slot mode-gap photonic crystal cavity with dispersive coupling g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">om</sub> up to 940 GHz/nm. Optical and mechanical measurements are shown. Radio frequency spectrum is obtained theoretically and experimentally with a megahertz resonant frequency.

articleTitle: The smallest deformed disk with unidirectional output
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the smallest deformed microdisk laser with unidirectional output. The radius of disk over emission wavelength is as small as 0.7.

articleTitle: 163 nJ graphene mode-locked Yb-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: High pulse-energy up to 163nJ is generated in a graphene mode-locked Yb-doped double-clad fiber laser with repetition-rate of 1.04-MHz. Graphene passive-Q-switched operation of ~2.2μs pulse-width is also demonstrated with tunable repetition-rate from 6-kHz to 150-kHz.

articleTitle: Observation of nonlinear Light Bullets in waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate femtosecond spatiotemporal dynamics in waveguide arrays. Experiments use an ultrafast cross-correlator tracing the Light Bullet evolution. Simulations with higher-order effects underline the solitary nature of the observed wavepackets.

articleTitle: Lidar measurements of atmospheric oxygen using a 1.27 micron Raman amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have developed a high-power narrow linewidth Raman amplifier near 1.27 micron and integrated it into an Integrated Path Differential Absorption lidar. Ground-based measurements of atmospheric oxygen have been performed using the integrated amplifier.

articleTitle: Local composition and temperature determination in laminar flames by laser-induced plasma diagnostics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We utilize laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy for measuring mixture composition and temperature in flames. Spectroscopy of the plasma emission yields concentration information, while temperature is derived from the breakdown threshold pulse energy.

articleTitle: Attosecond-resolution timing jitter characterization of Yb-fiber lasers in stretched-pulse and self-similar regimes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The timing jitter characterization of 80-MHz mode-locked Yb-fiber lasers in stretched pulse and self-similar regimes shows the rms integrated jitter of 0.86 fs and 4.2 fs [integrated from 10 kHz to 40 MHz (Nyquist frequency)], respectively.

articleTitle: Thermo-optical effects on the transduction of mechanical motion of a microspherical pendulum
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate the thermo-optical effects on the transduction of the mechanical motion of a microspherical pendulum evanescently coupled to a tapered optical fiber. Pendulum motion of 1–2 nm is determined by forced gap and frequency modulation.

articleTitle: Demonstration of dynamic optical arbitrary waveform generation with 5-ns record lengths and 33-ps features
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate bandwidth-scalable, high-fidelity dynamic arbitrary optical waveforms with 30-GHz of bandwidth by coherently combining three 10-GHz spectral slices generated with just 5.5 GHz of electrical bandwidth per I/Q modulator signal.

articleTitle: Polarization dependence of carbon fragments from methane in strong and ultrastrong laser fields
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the polarization dependence of the ultrafast photoionization for C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+n</sup> (n ≤ 5) fragments from methane. The study extends from the strong field (C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+2</sup>) at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to the ultrastrong field (C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+5</sup>) at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Mid-IR fiber lasers based on molecular gas-filled hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasing from HCN gas contained in HC-PCF is observed for the first time. Mid-IR pulses (3.15 and 3.09 μm) were generated by optically pumping at 1.54 μm. A <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-filled gas laser is also studied quantitatively.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser-assisted etching of three dimensional woodpile micro-channel arrays in fused silica
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A three-dimensional inverted-woodpile micro-channel array was fabricated in bulk fused silica with femtosecond laser and HF etching. An exposure compensation algorithm provided uniform periodic woodpile structure defining a novel micro-channel.

articleTitle: Tuning the resonance in superconducting terahertz metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report tunable resonances in terahertz metamaterials made from high-temperature superconducting films. Taking in account the temperature-dependent complex conductivity, we develop a theoretical model for correct interpretation of the observed resonance switching and frequency tuning.

articleTitle: High energy and efficient cross polarized wave generation for high contrast ultrashort laser sources
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a compact and energy-scalable crossed polarized wave generation setup with waveguide filtering. A 1.4 mJ, 14.5 fs FTL, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> contrast ratio enhanced XPW pulse is produced with 11 mJ, 40 fs input pulse.

articleTitle: Theoretical investigation of length-dependent flicker-phase noise in opto-electronic oscillators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss possible sources for the experimentally-observed length-dependent phase noise in opto-electronic oscillators. We eliminate several possibilities and show that conversion of laser amplitude noise to phase noise is a likely candidate.

articleTitle: Low-loss slow light in high contrast grating hollow-core waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A chip-scale hollow-core waveguide using high-contrast grating yields slow light with a group velocity <;0.02c and loss as low as 0.2dB/cm over 50GHz bandwidth. Loss and group velocity are independently optimized for the first time.

articleTitle: Investigation of slow, stop, and fast light based on polariton resonances in boron nitride
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Following our measurement of polariton resonances in boron nitride, we have investigated slow, stop, and fast light behaviors in mid-infrared region.

articleTitle: Cascaded interband/intersubband thermophotovoltaic energy conversion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of interband/intersubband photodetection for thermophotovoltaic energy conversion is numerically investigated. The simulation results indicate that this approach can double the present state-of-the-art in thermophotovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: High repetition rate high average power all-normal dispersion Yb:Fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate high repetition rate (up to 225 MHz) all-normal dispersion Yb:fiber ring laser. The average output power is 280 mW at a pump power of 600 mW. The dechirped pulse is 93 fs.

articleTitle: Accessing photon bunching with photon number resolving multi-pixel detector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The intensity correlation function of squeezed vacuum, produced in an OP A, was measured with a photon-number resolving multi-pixel detector (MPPC). Based on realistic MPPC model, strong photon bunching was revealed for low-gain OP A radiation.

articleTitle: Realization of small footprint microring reflectors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present design, fabrication and characterization of a single wavelength narrow-band reflector made by integration of a DBR inside a ring resonator. The DBR covers half of the ring's circumference and is only reflective at one ring resonance.

articleTitle: Stable and near-omni-directional high-efficiency amorphous Si photovoltaic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Highly stable high-density plasma-fabricated amorphous Si solar cells (7-9%) exhibit ultra-low photo-induced degradation in conversion-efficiency by 5.7%. This photovoltaic device with low-defect absorption layer is also a near-omni-directional solar-electricity generator.

articleTitle: GaN-based LEDs with photonic crystal nanorod sidewall reflectors for versatile radiation directionality control
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: GaN-based light emitting diodes with proper-designed photonic crystal structures as surface texturing and sidewall reflectors are fabricated to improve the collection of laterally propagated light and the directionality of the device.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive grating coupler for lightwave coupling between silicon nanophotonic waveguide and surface mounted photodetector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The lightwave connection of silicon chips and external elements is a serious problem. The grating coupler is effective for the connection of the surface mounted photodetector. We demonstrate the polarization insensitive operation.

articleTitle: Hyper-transport of light by virtue of disorder
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally and theoretically that when a spatially-random potential exhibits fast fluctuations also in the propagation direction, transport becomes considerably faster than ballistic. This new concept has major implications on transport of quantum particles.

articleTitle: Quantum frequency-entangled optical spread spectrum for stealthy target detection and communications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a transceiver design for performing stealthy communication and target detection based on the continuous-variable nature of frequency entanglement that achieves improved detection sensitivity using weak signals in an environment of high background noise.

articleTitle: Dense small molecule assemblies for third-order nonlinear optics: DDMEBT
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We determine the optical losses of DDMEBT planar waveguides and characterize the shelf-life and robustness of DDMEBT thin films used for ultra-fast all optical data processing.

articleTitle: Active and passive composite metal-dielectric nanophotonic devices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We explore metallo-dielectric composite nanostructures for localization and resonant excitation of optical fields and investigate design, fabrication and testing of nanolasers. Integration with silicon photonics material platform is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Material-specific detection and classification of single nanoparticles
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A material-specific dual-color common-path interferometric detection system for discriminating between nanoparticles in solution in real time is described. The detection technique is applicable to situations where both particle size and material are of interest.

articleTitle: Stability of chalcogenide glass solutions for photonic applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The stability of arsenic sulfide solutions towards absorbed moisture is investigated through accelerated aging studies. Water-induced precipitation can be mitigated, producing chalcogenide materials that are unaffected by the lifetime of the solution.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency and slow light with optomechanics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate electromagnetically induced transparency and slow light in an optomechanical cavity, at cryogenic and ambient conditions, and show effects analogous to electromagnetically induced absorption.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical entanglement control between two quantum dot spins
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using continuous-wave lasers and picosecond optical pulses, we demonstrate initialization, single qubit gates, and two qubit gates in a system of two electron spins in separate tunnel-coupled InAs quantum dots.

articleTitle: Nano-sensing with a silica microtoroid
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report nano-detection using a silica microtoroid with a reference interferometer. Single polystyrene nano-beads at a record 12.5nm radius are detected; Influenza-A virion binding events with signal-to-noise ratio exceeding 38:1 are observed.

articleTitle: Single-shot multiple-delay crossed-beam spectral interferometry for measuring extremely complex pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a simple single-shot interference-based linear measurement technique for measuring the complete intensity and phase of extremely complex ultrashort laser pulses, achieving temporal resolution of ~130fs and temporal range of 120ps.

articleTitle: Plasmonic waveguides for active semiconductor devices at telecom wavelengths using transverse-magnetic-polarized diode lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a basic building block for the realization of integrated active plasmonic devices: a distributed-feedback semiconductor laser working at room temperature and λ=1.3μm obtained with metal patterning on a thinned top cladding.

articleTitle: Novel electrode shape to reduce heating in light-actuated digital microfluidics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel, ring-shaped optical electrode is employed to reduce heating in light-actuated digital microfluidics. Using thermo-sensitive hydrogel microspheres, the temperature rise is measured to be 0.35°C, about 15× lower than those using square electrodes.

articleTitle: Near infrared scanning imaging of cancerous and normal prostate tissues enhanced by a receptor-targeted contrast agent (Cytate) and independent component analysis
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Cytate, a receptor-targeted contrast agent and independent component analysis (ICA) was used to enhance the contrast between a pair of stained small pieces of cancerous and normal prostate tissues embedded in large piece normal tissue.

articleTitle: Ultra-high Q long-path As2S3 ring resonator on LiNbO3
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A vertically integrated As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> ring resonator side-coupled to Ti:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide was designed and fabricated. We have demonstrated an ultra-high Q value of 3.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> and low propagation loss of 1.2 dB/cm over a 1.7 cm race-track ring resonator.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon assisted stimulated emission on smooth and corrugated silver surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study surface-plasmon-assisted stimulated emission of Rhodamine 6G and Rhodamine B laser dyes and find a striking difference of the stimulated emission behavior on smooth and corrugated silver surfaces.

articleTitle: Energies above 30 μJ and average power beyond 100 W directly from a mode-locked thin-disk oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of pulses containing more than 30 μJ of energy with a pulse length of 1040 fs directly out of a thin-disk laser in ambient atmosphere. The laser oscillator was operated at 3.5 MHz repetition rate and 108 W of average output power.

articleTitle: Enhanced two-photon absorption in polycrystalline silicon
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We discuss measurements of the two-photon absorption coefficient (β) in polycrystalline silicon deposited in a scaled CMOS process; measurements in thin film, waveguides and microring resonators indicate β is over two orders of magnitude larger than in crystalline silicon.

articleTitle: Sub-joule level high repetition rate cryogenic disk laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spectral and thermooptical properties, the stored energy and amplification in Yb: YAG disks are investigated at 77-300K temperature range. The current status of the laser system development with 0.5J output energy at 1kHz repetition rate is presented.

articleTitle: High single-pass small signal gain in femtosecond solid state Yb:CaF2 amplifiers pumped by a 976-nm YDFA
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an enhancement of the single-pass small signal gain up to 3.2 in a longitudinal pumping scheme by using a 10 mm-long Yb:CaF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystal at room temperature. This result significantly outperforms any CW-diode pumped scheme.

articleTitle: Multiple selective excitations of localized surface plasmons in coupled gold nano-spheres
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Numerical simulations show up to five localized surface plasmons (LSP) states can be selectively excited using simple source polarization control in gold nano-spheres. The extinctions among different selective states are quantitatively analyzed.

articleTitle: Continuous and discrete multimode interference liquid level sensor
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An all-fiber continuous and discrete liquid level sensor using Multimode Interference (MMI) effects is demonstrated. The sensing range and also multiplexed operation can be easily controlled by just changing the length of the MMI sensor.

articleTitle: Imaging of terahertz surface plasmon waves with a sub-wavelength aperture probe
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present imaging of THz surface plasmon polariton (SPP) waves with an integrated sub-wavelength aperture probe. Using detected SPP patterns, we explain the mechanism of SPP coupling into the probe.

articleTitle: Coherent control of gold nanoparticles formation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We use pulse-shaping of femtosecond pulses to coherent control the synthesis of gold nanoparticles induced by two-photon absorption. Applying distinct phase masks to the pulse, we were able to shift the plasmon absorption band.

articleTitle: Melt-grown molecular mono-crystals: Morphology, optical properties, role of the substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Molecular mono-crystals can be grown and integrated in devices from the melted compound. The role of the substrate and the resulting morphology, crystallinity, optical anisotropy and properties are discussed.

articleTitle: Near-infrared nano-imaging spectroscopy of semiconductor quantum dots using a phase change mask layer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed a near-infrared nano-imaging spectroscopy of semiconductor quantum structures using a phase change mask layer. The performance of this method was demonstrated by numerical simulation and photoluminescence measurement of quantum dots.

articleTitle: On-chip optical pulse erasure for ultrahigh bandwidth signal processing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present on-chip, all-optical pulse erasure for enabling ultrahigh-bandwidth signal processing. 15 dB pump depletion is achieved for picoseconds pulses using the instantaneous χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> nonlinearity in a dispersion-engineered chalcogenide waveguide.

articleTitle: Highly efficient carrier multiplication and bright exciton luminescence under intense terahertz pulse
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The nonlinear interactions of GaAs quantum wells with intense single cycle terahertz (THz) pulses with amplitudes exceeding 1 MV/cm have been studied. We demonstrated for the first time that the number of carriers is enhanced 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> times more with an increase of the electric field amplitude of the THz pulse from 0.5 to 1 MV/cm, eventually which leading a bright near infrared luminescence. This highly efficient carrier multiplication process with a threshold-like behavior implies that the carriers driven under intense THz pulse can efficiently gain enough high kinetic energy to induce cascading impact ionizations.

articleTitle: Spin polarization of single NV centers in diamond after non-resonant optical excitation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The polarization state of the zero-phonon line of single NV<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> centers is studied after non-resonant optical excitation. High-resolution Fabry-Perot spectra reveal the possibility of observing two-photon interference of distant quantum emitters.

articleTitle: Precise spectral shaping of mode-locked oscillations
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a powerful method to control the spectrum of a mode-locked laser by placing the gain medium inside an intra-cavity pulse shaper.

articleTitle: Experimental and numerical study of the laser-induced printing of liquid materials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a numerical and experimental study of laser-induced jetting behavior associated with direct-write printing of liquids using a polymer absorbing layer. We focus on the limits of minimum material transfer that can be achieved.

articleTitle: A vertical SG-DBR based tunable hybrid silicon evanescent laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a tunable hybrid silicon evanescent laser with vertical sidewalled sampled grating distributed Bragg reflectors (SG-DBR) on SOI. The device utilizes a Vernier comb and the electrooptic effect in silicon for tuning within a 30 nm range.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of a bandwidth scalable LAN emulation over EPON employing OFDMA
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a novel EPON system supporting bandwidth scalable local area network emulation by using orthogonal frequency division multiplexing access technology. Added to the EPON traffic, 250Mbps and 500Mbps OFDM LAN traffics are experimentally emulated.

articleTitle: Plasmonic particles with engineered resonances — Superfilters and superabsorbers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: New families of plasmonic particles with on-demand resonance design are obtained by applying ‘Evolutionary algorithm’. Other particles were designed to exhibit multipole resonance degeneracy, e.g. collocated dipole-quadrupole, which may be applied as superfilters and superabsorbers.

articleTitle: Magnetically controlled broadband THz absorption in a multiferroic hexaferrite at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: THz time domain spectroscopy reveals the existence of a broad absorption band owing to electromagnons in a multiferroic polycrystal of Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Co<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">24</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">41</sub>. The absorption can be controlled by weak external magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Towards an optical frequency comb with mm-scale microresonators for distributing atomic standards
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We will discuss progress on the fabrication of optical microresonators for generation of a frequency comb via nonlinear parametric oscillation. With disk-like resonators of quartz we have achieved Q = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup>.

articleTitle: Low power resonant optical excitation of an optomechanical cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the actuation of a double beam optomechanical cavity with a sinusoidally varying optical input power. We observe the driven mechanical motion with only 200 nW coupled to the optical cavity mode.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral nanoscale imaging on dielectric substrates with coaxial optical antenna scan probes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An important goal in nano science is to unlock previously inaccessible physics and dynamics within nanoscale systems by combining the efficient nanoscale field confinement/optical resolution (~10 nm) of optical antennae and the ultrafast temporal resolution (fs) inherent in optical studies with the capabilities of modern scanning probe techniques. Here the authors report on a significant step toward this goal using a novel nanofabricated coaxial antenna tip capable of recording useful Raman spectra in ~50 ms to acquire 256 by 256 pixel images on dielectric substrates with a full spectrum at each pixel.

articleTitle: Phase-slope measurement of tunable CW-THz radiation and application for distance measurement of optically rough object
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate phase-slope measurement of tunable CW-THz radiation by photoconductive heterodyne detection with a photocarrier THz comb. Distance of optically rough object is determined from the measured phase-slope within accuracy of 100 μm.

articleTitle: Perimeter deposition and annealing for increasing Cr4+ ncentration in ultra broadband Cr: AG fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using laser-heated pedestal growth method to re-grow Cr:YAG single crystal fiber with CaO perimeter deposition under annealing treatment at 1500°C. The Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup> concentration of Cr:YAG fiber amplifier was raised by a factor of 91.87%.

articleTitle: Characterization of laser-induced air plasmas via third harmonic generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Third harmonic generation by a femtosecond probe intersecting a laser-induced air plasma is measured and a general model developed to describe such signal. The electron density distribution and nonlinear coefficient of the plasma are determined.

articleTitle: Bandstructure measurements of lithium niobate waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally determined the bandstructure of lithium niobate waveguide arrays by means of angle dependent tuning curve measurements. We used these results to calculate linear coupling constants of various higher order second harmonic modes.

articleTitle: Transverse electro-magnetic modes in apertures filled with an extreme anisotropic meta-material
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate that in simply connected apertures containing a meta-material with extreme anisotropy all modes become purely transverse electro-magnetic modes, are dispersion-free, and have zero cutoff frequency. We show a meta-material design using existing materials.

articleTitle: Reflective silicon binary diffraction grating for visible wavelengths
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new device based on sub-wavelength resonant gratings. We built a silicon-on-oxide reflective binary grating for visible light that mimics the functionality of a blazed diffraction grating in a flat geometry.

articleTitle: Wavelength tuning and athermal operations of micro-machined VCSELs for uncooled WDM applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We successfully demonstrated the wavelength tuning and athermal operation of micro machined VCSELs at the same time. A small temperature dependence of below 0.002 nm/K is realized with precise continuous wavelength tuning of 1.1 nm.

articleTitle: Efficient third harmonic generation by two crossing filaments
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Enhanced third harmonic by two crossing filaments is studied as function of pulse polarization, time delay, and interacting position. These systematic results point to the substantial role of the Gouy phase shift in the filament.

articleTitle: Coherent processes in the ultrafast magnetization dynamics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The ultrafast magnetization dynamics induced by femtosecond laser pulses involves several coherent mechanisms described in this tutorial. They include the spin-photon, the spin-orbit and the spin-lattice interactions occurring from a few femtoseconds to several picoseconds.

articleTitle: Real-time group-delay monitoring of ultra-broadband dispersive devices by incoherent light interferometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A simple incoherent interferometry technique is demonstrated for real-time group-delay (GD) profile monitoring of ultra-broadband dispersive devices. We report accurate GD characterization of a dispersion-compensating fiber over a bandwidth >;70nm at 15 frames/s update rate.

articleTitle: Effect of metallic and hyperbolic metamaterial surface on electric and magnetic dipole emission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spontaneous emission patterns of electric and magnetic dipoles on different material surfaces were studied numerically and experimentally. The results show the modified behavior of electric and magnetic dipoles on metallic and HMM surfaces.

articleTitle: Single-shot frequency-resolved-optical-gating device for complete temporal intensity-and-phase measurements of nanosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a simple FROG device for completely measuring nanosecond pulses. Its key innovation is its use of ~89.9° pulse-front tilt to obtain a several-ns delay range. We measure even complex several-ns Yb-fiber amplifier pulses.

articleTitle: 3D OPCPA simulations for a petawatt class system including nonlinear refractive index effects
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present 3D OPCPA simulations for 3.67 J, 4 fs transform limited pulses. Including nonlinear refractive index effects reduces the energy by ~11%, increases the transform limit by ~17%, and reduces peak intensity by ~30%.

articleTitle: A novel mechano-optical sensor based on read-out with a Si3N4 grated waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications

authors.preferredName: H. A. G. M. van Wolferen

abstract: A proof-of-concept study is reported on fabrication and characterization of a novel and compact integrated mechano-optical sensor based-on a micro-bridge suspended above a Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> grated waveguide.

articleTitle: Multi wavelength characterization of ultra fast carrier dynamics in InAs/InP quantum dash optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafast cross saturation dynamics of inhomogeneously broadened InAs/InP quantum dash optical amplifiers were characterized by multi-wavelength pump probe spectroscopy. Carrier relaxation processes are identified and quantified for the first time.

articleTitle: Giant Goos-Hänchen effect at photonic crystals surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Giant Goos-Hanchen effect is detected using TIR spectroscopy, directly observed in surface electromagnetic waves at photonic crystals surfaces using far-field optical microscopy visualization and achieves 100-times enhancement in comparison with dielectric surfaces.

articleTitle: Efficient parametric cavity enhanced terahertz generation based on quasi-phase matched GaP bonded structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate cavity enhanced parametric THz generation with power of 339μW and enhancement factor of ~151 through quasi-phase-matched GaP pumped by 1.5um pulsed fiber lasers.

articleTitle: Octave-spanning supercontinuum generation in CMOS-compatible silicon nitride waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
