abstract: We demonstrate ultrabroadband supercontinuum generation in CMOS-compatible dispersion engineered silicon-nitride waveguides. Our process produces a supercontinuum spectrum extending over 1.6 octaves from 665 nm to 2025 nm using 160 pJ pulses.

articleTitle: Slow light, fast light, and their applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ve provide a brief overview of the field of slow and fast light. We then describe some of the applications of slow light that have been and are currently being developed.

articleTitle: Ultrafast observation of weak coupling effects in ZnO-Ag heterostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Transmission and reflection pump-probe-spectroscopy on ZnO/MgO heterostructures demonstrate a 600fs excitonic decay to impurity bound states located near the ZnO/MgO interface. Surface-plasmon-polaritons supported on a 30nm Ag film quench this process through weak coupling effects.

articleTitle: Optical tractor beams in scattering-induced left-handed fields
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show here that left handed electromagnetic fields can be established over extended regions in fully dielectric structures. Particles immersed in such field configurations would move upstream against the radiation pressure of the incident wave.

articleTitle: Purcell effect in a magnetic cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study dipole emission inside a homogeneous, magnetic sphere. For fixed refractive index, the largest emission rate for an electric source is observed, in general, when the magnetic permeability is maximized. The corresponding result for a magnetic source follows by symmetry.

articleTitle: Extremely broad-gain quantum-cascade lasers based on dual-upper-state design
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Broad-gain quantum cascade lasers based on dual-upper-state design are reported. The devices exhibit a wide (-570 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) electroluminescence spectra, a low cw threshold-current-density of 1.5 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and a high cw output-power of -200 mW at 300 K.

articleTitle: Integrated optical refractometer based on multimode interference
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An integrated optical refractometer based on multimode interference, with sensitivity enhancement due to sub-micrometer axial features, is demonstrated with experimental sensitivity as high as 3200 nm/RIU and resolution limits on the order of 5 ppm.

articleTitle: Zeno or anti-zeno: Which is more useful ?
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The quantum Zeno effect (QZE) introduced by Misra and Sudarshan consists in the ability of repeated measurements to inhibit or slow down unitary evolution. Its fundamental status in quantum mechanics has long been firmly established, but its much broader context, in-depth understanding and its applications are growing at a faster pace than ever before. Over the years , there have been several pivotal developments that have made the QZE and related effects the basic paradigms underlying the control of evolution in quantum systems.

articleTitle: Measurement of energy contrast of amplified ultrashort pulses using cross polarized wave generation and spectral interferometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We interfere an amplified output pulse with a copy that has been converted using third-order cross-polarized wave generation. The ASE pedestal shows as a background in the interference, yielding the short-pulse/ASE energy contrast.

articleTitle: Fabrication of binary Fresnel lenses in PMMA by femtosecond laser micromachining
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Binary Fresnel lenses are fabricated by ablation of PMMA substrates with a femtosecond laser. The minimum feature size in our experimental conditions is 600 nm. Lenses with good transparency and focal lengths in the range from 500μm to 5mm are obtained, with a maximum efficiency close to the theoretical one.

articleTitle: VCSEL-based tilted fiber grating vibration sensing system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Fiber-optic vibration sensing system using a tilted fiber grating and a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) has been demonstrated. Dynamic vibration measurement up to 200 Hz with improved signal-to-noise ratio better than 40 dB was achieved.

articleTitle: Quantum logic operations using the Zeno effect
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Quantum logic operations can be performed using the quantum Zeno effect based on strong two-photon absorption. This approach can be generalized to perform all-optical switching of classical signals.

articleTitle: SPIDER on-chip: A subpicosecond phase sensitive optical oscilloscope
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a CMOS-compatible monolithic device for the amplitude and phase characterization of ultrafast optical pulses based on FWM. It operates at 100mW pulse peak powers, with <;700fs accuracy and over a 100ps time window.

articleTitle: Characterizing the point spread function of retinal OCT devices with a model eye-based phantom
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have designed, fabricated, and tested a nanoparticle-embedded phantom incorporated into a model eye for characterizing the point spread function of retinal OCT devices in three dimensions under realistic imaging conditions.

articleTitle: Optical trapping at the ultimate nanoscale in the near-field of plasmonic antennas
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the trapping of nanoscopic objects in the near-field of plasmonic nanostructures and demonstrate experimentally that 10nm particles can be trapped in the 15nm gap of a dipole antenna. Applications for biosensing are discussed.

articleTitle: 3–4 THz InGaAs/InAlAs quantum-cascade lasers based on the indirect pump scheme
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the operation of an indirectly pumped InGaAs/InAlAs THz quantum-cascade laser. The threshold-current-density is obtained to be low, ~470 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 6-25 K, with recourse to the absence of lower level pumping.

articleTitle: Combining phase contrast microscopy and laser tweezers Raman spectroscopy to characterize germination of single bacterial spores
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a method that combines external phase contrast microscopy, Raman spectroscopy and optical tweezers to monitor a variety of changes during the germination of single bacterial spores.

articleTitle: Nanocavity enhanced diamond nitrogen-vacancy center zero phonon line emission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Resonantly enhanced emission of the zero phonon line of a diamond nitrogen-vacancy center in single crystal diamond is demonstrated experimentally using a hybrid whispering gallery mode nanocavity.

articleTitle: InGaAs/GaAsSb terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present THz QCLs based on the InGaAs/GaAsSb material system, which benefits from the low effective masses. The devices are emitting between 3.6-4.2 THz up to a temperature of 135K.

articleTitle: Single-shot imaging of nanoscale dynamics by extreme ultraviolet microscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Snap-shot imaging with nanometer spatial resolution and nanosecond temporal resolution is used to make movies of the interaction dynamics of nanostructures.

articleTitle: Experimental repetitive quantum error correction with trapped ions
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: For scalable quantum computation errors occurring during storage and processing need to be continuously corrected. Here we report on the experimental realization of repetitive quantum error correction with trapped ions.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic Cherenkov radiation in the few-cycle regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate (both theoretically and experimentally) that fiber-optic Cherenkov radiation in the few-cycle regime exhibits three unique features absent when pumped with long pulses: continuum generation, high conversion-efficiency (up to 40%). and broad bandwidth (70-nm).

articleTitle: Polarization entangled state measurement on a chip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the realization of an integrated beam splitter able to support polarization-encoded qubits. Using this device, we demonstrate quantum interference with polarization-entangled states and singlet state projection.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation with fs frequency combs and limitations due to intracavity plasma dynamics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The dynamic intracavity ionization of a dilute gas target can substantially alter the pulse formation inside resonant fs enhancement cavities. We numerically and experimentally study these effects and how they affect intracavity high harmonic generation.

articleTitle: High-performance entangled photon pair generation in Bragg reflection waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Entangled photon pair generation by spontaneous parametric downconversion in Bragg reflection waveguides is theoretically investigated. Enhanced nonlinear interaction through tight mode confinement in the waveguide results in pair generation rate up to 4×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> pairs/s/mW/nm.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of variable optical hexadecimal coding/decoding of 10-Gbaud/s 16-QAM using FWM in HNLFs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate optical hexadecimal coding/decoding of 16-QAM using degenerate four-wave mixing (FWM) in highly nonlinear fibers (HNLFs). Constellation manipulation for variable coding/decoding of a 10-Gbaud/s 16-QAM signal is implemented with an OSNR penalty of <;1.1 dB with CW pump and <;1.2 dB with phase-modulated pump Key.

articleTitle: Demonstration of statistical mechanics phase transitions with arrays of thousands of coherent lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Thousands of coherent lasers are phased locked by global and local coupling in order to demonstrate first and second order phase transitions. The measured and calculated phase distribution reveals similar behavior to XY spin model.

articleTitle: Patterned plasmonic nano-antennas embedded in the active layer of organic photovoltaic cells — Enhanced absorption
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ordered arrays of Au nanodisks, extending into the active layer of organic photovoltaic device exhibit enhanced external quantum efficiency, stemming from resonances of plasmon and nanopatch antennas. Design rules were verified experimentally.

articleTitle: A quantum-optical approach to carrier multiplication in quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Measurements of carrier multiplication (CM) in quantum dots show promising but also contradictory results. We approach this problem theoretically by identifying relevant signatures of CM in accessible quantum-optical emission spectra.

articleTitle: Direct referencing of a quantum-cascade-laser at 4.3 μm to a near-infrared frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A sum-frequency-generation scheme is exploited to refer the frequency of a quantum cascade-laser at 4.3 μm to a near-IR frequency comb based on a dual-branch Er: fiber laser without interposition of any transfer oscillator.

articleTitle: Near-field observation of zero index bandgaps in negative refraction photonic superlattices
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present near-field observations of tuned zero-index bandgaps in photonic crystal superlattices consisting of cascaded negative and positive index media. Supported by precise nanofabrication and experimental measurements, these observed zero-order gaps have potential for wavefront control for arbitrary phase delay lines and open cavity resonances.

articleTitle: Low-timing-jitter near-Infrared single-photon-sensitive 16-channel intensified-photodiode detector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a 16-channel InGaAsP photocathode intensified-photodiode (IPD) detector with 78 ps (1-sigma) timing-jitter, < 500 ps FWHM impulse response, >15% quantum efficiency at 1064 nm wavelength with 131 kcps dark counts at 15 C.

articleTitle: Spectroscopy of Rydberg atoms in a ponderomotive optical lattice
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study Rydberg atoms in ponderomotive optical lattices. Unlike for ground-state atoms, for Rydberg atoms in an optical lattice, the extent of the electronic wave-function can approach the lattice period. This leads to state-dependent adiabatic trapping potentials that are unique to Rydberg atoms. We use microwave spectroscopy to experimentally demonstrate and investigate the state-dependence of the adiabatic potentials of S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</inf> Rydberg states of rubidium. The observed microwave spectra depend strongly on both the principal quantum number and the depth of the lattice. A semi-classical simulation is used to interpret the features seen in the microwave spectra. A large fraction of the Rydberg atoms can be trapped in the ponderomotive optical lattice.

articleTitle: Highly efficient InGaN/GaN blue LED grown on Si (111) substrate
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: For the first time, based on the high crystalline quality of n-GaN on Si template, highly efficient InGaN/GaN LEDs grown on 4-inch silicon substrates comparable to those on sapphire substrates have been successfully demonstrated. At driving current of 350 mA, the overall output power of 1 × 1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> LED chips exceeded 420 mW and forward voltage was 3.2 V under un-encapsulated condition, which is the best value among the reported values of blue LED grown on Si substrates. The internal quantum efficiency of 76% at injection current of 350 mAwas measured.

articleTitle: Third-harmonic generation in engineered slow light photonic crystal waveguides in chalcogenide glasses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report third-harmonic generation in slow-light photonic crystal waveguides realized in chalcogenide glass membranes. This material enables a more uniform conversion along the waveguide and a higher efficiency than in comparable silicon structures.

articleTitle: Electrostatic tuning of optomechanical cavities to semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The integration of optomechanically coupled photonic crystal cavities to indium arsenide quantum dots is studied experimentally and theoretically. Electrostatic tuning results for one- and two-dimensional photonic crystals are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of pulse width in ultrafast laser fabrication of embedded waveguides in chalcognide glasses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report embedded waveguide fabrication in Gallium Lanthanum Sulphide glasses using an ultrafast laser. The influence of pulse-width on the waveguide formation was studied and compared using 240-fs and 2-ps pulses, respectively.

articleTitle: Calculations of the two-photon Franz-Keldysh effect and field-induced quantum interference control in GaAs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The two-photon Franz-Keldysh effect in bulk GaAs is calculated using a 14-band model for the band structure. Strong effects are predicted for both two-photon absorption and quantum interference control of carrier injection.

articleTitle: Refractive index of nanolayered polymeric optical materials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally tested a predictive model of refractive index proposed for nanolayered polymer films for use in designing and fabricating biologically inspired GRIN lenses, which enables good estimation of index based on component weight fractions.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgap fusion by magnetically aligned 3D photonic bandgap structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the photonic bandgap fusion by the sequential self-assembly of superparamagnetic nanoparticle and ultra-violet (UV) exposure.

articleTitle: Mixed gas sensing system based on super-luminescent diode coupled with a Fabry-Perot etalon
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Mixed gas sensing based on a broad-band super-luminescent diode (1535 nm) coupled with an external Fabry-Perot etalon is proposed. The wavelength tuning by tilting the etalon will provide selective gas sensing by absorption spectroscopy technique.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics, phase coherence, and mode locking in quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We overview our recent theoretical and experimental studies of nonlinear interaction of laser modes in quantum cascade lasers (QCLs) which results in phase coherence, frequency locking, and in some cases complete synchronization of laser modes.

articleTitle: Sub-12 fs pulses characterization by self-referenced spectral interferometry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 11.7 fs nearly perfect Fourier Transform pulses were characterized with Self referenced spectral interferometry after precise optimization. A measurement quality control criterion is presented. Each experimental result was cross-checked with SPIDER.

articleTitle: Noise reduction of a carbon nanotube fiber laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the reduction of noise in a carbon nanotube fiber laser frequency comb using pump attenuation and phase-lead compensation. The measured f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ο</sub> linewidth was decreased by a factor of four.

articleTitle: Extended tunability of narrow-linewidth Yb-fiber laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on a tunable ytterbium-doped fiber laser bridging the gap from three-level lasing around 980 nm to true four-level lasing at 1066 nm. Wavelength-locking and -tuning was achieved by an external volume-Bragg grating (VBG). Results are compared with a numerical analysis based on a spectrally resolved rate equation analysis.

articleTitle: 30 GHz relaxation resonance frequency and 35 Gbit/s data rate in single-mode 850 nm VCSELs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report single-mode 850 nm-range VCSELs with a relaxation resonance frequency as high as 30 GHz, peak output power up to 2.0 mW, and a record data rate of 35 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Mode-locked fiber laser with few-layer epitaxial graphene grown on 6H-SiC substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Few-layer epitaxial graphene grown on 6H silicon carbide (SiC) wafers by thermal decomposition was used as novel saturable absorbers for mode-locking of ytterbium-doped fiber lasers, which generated 19nJ single pulse energy at 1.05MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Self-interference Lloyd's fiber interferometer
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We proposed an ultracompact, simple and robust in reflection-type of self-interference Lloyd's fiber interferometer based on a diffused-core fiber endface with Sn-overlay. Interference fringes are observed experimentally and investigated for the first time.

articleTitle: Bandwidth scalable, coherent transmitter based on parallel spectral slice waveform generation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a bandwidth scalable optical transmitter for creating high bandwidth optical signals using parallel low speed electronics. Proof-of-concept 20 GHz spectral width, 100 ns, 10 Gb/s DPSK and 20 Gb/s QPSK waveforms are generated.

articleTitle: Frequency-tuned isolated attosecond pulses characterized by both 750 nm and 400 nm wavelength streak fields
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel Mach-Zehnder type interferometer coupled with the double optical gating technique provides tunable XUV or VUV isolated attosecond pulses and streak field detection with fields centered at both 750 nm and 400 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: Direct estimation of the intensity contrast of high-energy laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The focal spot of the incoherent pedestal preceding a high-energy laser pulse is predicted using the coherence properties of imaging systems, determining the on-shot intensity contrast of kilojoule laser pulses from OMEGA EP.

articleTitle: Optically generated 2-dimensional photonic cluster state from coupled quantum dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a deterministic approach for the generation of a 2D photonic cluster state from optically manipulated quantum dots. Our scheme can be implemented with existing technology. Error localization allows for quantum error correction.

articleTitle: The role of plasma formation in mode-locking of few-cycle Ti:Sapphire lasers: A spatiotemporal model
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The spatiotemporal pulse dynamics of few-cycle Ti: sapphire lasers is studied. It is found that in the high-intensity regime, plasma formation in the crystal plays an important role in the mode-locking process and for the laser behavior.

articleTitle: Phase dependent second-order fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The phase dependent properties of a second-order FBG are presented. At the second Bragg condition, the radiated power of the second-order FBG varies by a factor of 2.4 as the phase changes by π radians.

articleTitle: Matrix assisted growth of nanoparticles and nanoporous thin films: An emerging approach
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Complex inorganic nanoparticles and nanoporous films have been synthesized by ultraviolet decomposition of metal based acetate precursors. Unary, alloyed and oxide crystalline nanoparticles where characterized via transmission electron microscopy.

articleTitle: Flap-top interleaver by femtosecond laser writing of cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers in fused silica
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond laser writing of cascaded Mach-Zehnder interferometers were optimized in fused silica to form flat-top interleavers with 0.5-dB bandwidth of 10 nm and 15 dB extinction ratio that opens new directions in wavelength division multiplexing.

articleTitle: Nanoparticle-enhanced tunnel junctions for reduced free-carrier absorption in mid-IR lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present tunnel junctions, employing buried semimetallic nanoparticles, to reduce intervalence-band absorption in mid-IR lasers. Proof-of-concept results demonstrate low resistance tunnel junctions with low p-type dopant concentrations, suitable for integration into GaSb-based diode lasers.

articleTitle: Measuring nanomechanical motion with an imprecision below that at the standard quantum limit
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report an optomechanical near-field coupling detection scheme which enabled the first optical measurement of nanomechanical motion with an imprecision 3 dB below that at the standard quantum limit at room temperature.

articleTitle: Plasmonic monopole antenna arrays for biosensing, spectroscopy and nm-precision optical trapping
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose surface plasmon polariton driven plasmonic monopole antenna array system for biosensing, nanospectroscopy and optical trapping. The structure exhibits high refractive index sensitivities, nearfield resolution and optical gradient force.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in planar Au/Co/Si structure: Current- and magneto-induced effects
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Second-harmonic generation (SHG) in planar Au/Co/Si nanostructures are studied. Current- and magneto-induced contributions to the SHG signal from cobalt interfaces are observed, and are shown to be comparable with the crystallographic SHG component.

articleTitle: 1.5 μm dual-frequency pico-second optical parametric generator pumped by a Nd-doped vanadate bounce laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated 1.5μm dual-frequency optical parametric generation from tandem PPSLT crystals pumped by a pico-second Nd-doped vanadate bounce laser. The signal frequency was controlled in the range 1.57-1.63μm. A signal power of 1.54W was achieved.

articleTitle: Statistics of photon transport in hundreds of coupled resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Intensity and group delay are measured with high spectral resolution in long silicon microring coupled-resonator optical waveguides (CROWs), with the first experimental evidence that coherent oscillations of the coupled resonators constitute the propagating eigenmodes.

articleTitle: Second harmonic nanoprobes for femtosecond laser pulse characterization in complex microstructures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Femtosecond pulse characterization in air-core region of a photonic crystal fiber is presented. The proposed nanoprobe can be a promising candidate for probing optical fields at nano-femto spatiotemporal scale in complex 3D micro- or nanostructures.

articleTitle: Deterministic resonance and phase control for photonic sub-and super-radiance in coupled nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Integrated chip-scale electrodes allow isolated control of resonances and phases in optical multi-cavity system. By varying the round trip length, destructive and constructive intra-cavity interferences are observed, representing all-optical analogue to electromagnetically-induced-transparency and superradiance on-chip.

articleTitle: Coherent and tunable terahertz emission from nano-metric field effect transistor at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on reflective electro-optic sampling measurements of TeraHertz emission from nanometer-gate-length InGaAs-based high electron mobility transistors. The room temperature coherent gate-voltage tunable emission is demonstrated. Our results shows that properly exciting nanotransistors can pave the way for new class of coherent and easily tunable THz sources.

articleTitle: Controlled coupling in silicon microrings for high-speed, high extinction ratio, and low-chirp modulation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Silicon-on-insulator microring modulators with integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer couplers exhibiting drive voltages near 1 V, modulation insertion loss <; 1 dB, extinction ratios as large as 16 dB, and low chirp are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics of magnetic plasmonic nanostructures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Magnetization-induced second harmonic generation in core(shell) Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(Au) nanoparticles and Au/Co/Au nanosandwiches was studied in the transversal Kerr effect geometry. Plasmon-assisted changes in the nonlinear magneto-optical response were revealed.

articleTitle: Interaction-based quantum metrology giving a scaling beyond the Heisenberg limit
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Atom-mediated optical nonlinearities, generated within an atom-light quantum interface, allow spin measurement with sensitivity that scales better than the Heisenberg limit. This demonstrates interactions as a new resource for quantum metrology.

articleTitle: Selective thermal emission from patterned steel surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Selective thermal emission from metal surfaces can be achieved through wavelength-scale patterning of the substrate. Here we demonstrate mid-infrared selective thermal emission from periodically patterned steel surfaces with selective emission enhancement at the selected wavelength of a factor of 2.6. This phenomenon is numerically modeled and the emission is characterized with Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Engineered nonlinear optical structures based on metal nanocomposite photonic crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a three-fold increase in the nonlinear optical absorption of an engineered metal nanocomposite based photonic crystal as compared to a single metal-nanocomposite film of comparable thickness using Z-scan measurements.

articleTitle: 20Gbps receiver based on germanium photodetector hybrid-integrated with 90nm CMOS amplifier
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Receiver based on Ge waveguide PD hybrid-integrated with CMOS amplifier shows an unprecedented data rate of 20Gbps, -7.1dBm sensitivity, and 7pJ/bit power efficiency. Further improvement is obtained with avalanche gain and feed-forward equalization.

articleTitle: Spontaneous currents inside air filaments
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Currents circulating in the plasma column of filaments in air are detected with a fast current monitor. The currents can be amplified with circularly polarized light.

articleTitle: Precise signal processing schemes in resonator fiber optic gyro with bipolar digital serrodyne phase modulation technique
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Precise signal processing schemes for resonator fiber optic gyro (R-FOG) with bipolar digital serrodyne phase modulation technique are proposed. One scheme is to suppress the noise induced by higher harmonics of the frequency used to extract the rotation signal when the bipolar digital serrodyne modulation technique is used. The other scheme is to increase the stability of the control signal for the amplitude adjustment of the phase modulation waveform, in which a lock-in reference waveform with 90° out of phase compared with the modulation waveform is introduced.

articleTitle: Double-blind frequency-resolved optical gating for measuring two different pulses simultaneously
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a simple method for simultaneously and robustly measuring two arbitrary, potentially very complex pulses, which we call "double-blind" FROG. It uses the standard FROG algorithm and can operate on a single shot.

articleTitle: Metamaterial based terahertz detector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a metamaterial based terahertz (THz) detector. The detector design, which combines metamaterials and MEMs, is frequency selective, and we have fabricated and tested detectors at 95 GHz and 693 GHz with noise equivalent powers of 1.13 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> W/√Hz and 2.96 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup> W/√Hz and responsivities of 16,500 V/W and 6,800 V/W, respectively. These values were achieved at room temperature and pressure.

articleTitle: Novel optical architecture for high capacity and high data transfer rate holographic data storage
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A novel optical system architecture employing local holographic recording with a pico-second pulsed fiber laser and a small page size SLM has the potential towards realizing compact, high capacity and high data transfer rate optical storage.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond microjoule-class fiber lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study the impact of the mode-locking mechanism on the performances of a microjoule-class all-normal dispersion fiber laser featuring large-mode-area photonic crystal fibers.

articleTitle: Plasmonic properties of metallic nanoparticles: The effects of size quantization
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We examine the quantum mechanics of plasmons in metallic nanoparticle systems using time-dependent density functional theory. We identify “quantum core plasmons” and “classical surface plasmons”.

articleTitle: Tailored intensity distributions with vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser systems
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Robust top-hat laser beams with a large degree of freedom of the outer shape and scalable in optical power are realised by laser modules consisting of surface-emitting laser diodes (VCSELs) and a simple optic.

articleTitle: Biomedical applications of enhanced backscattering spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Enhanced Backscattering Spectroscopy enables minimally invasive measurement of optical properties of biological tissues by characterizing the shape of backscattered light in both angle and spectrum. The peak in scattering intensity in the retroreflection direction depends on the scattering properties of a random medium including mean free path, anisotropy, and even higher order characteristics such as mass fractal dimension. These properties are shown to be significant markers of risk in gastrointestinal cancers. Miniaturization of the technology with development of a fiber optic probe and supporting instrumentation enables in vivo clinical studies of risk stratification.

articleTitle: High-throughput fabrication of plasmonic nanoantenna arrays using nanostencils for spectroscopy and biosensing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a novel approach for high-throughput and high-resolution fabrication of engineered infrared plasmonic antenna arrays with reusable nanostencils for vibrational spectroscopy. Optical responses of these antennas are identical to ones fabricated by electron beam lithography.

articleTitle: Image-guided breast biopsy with optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the development and preliminary testing of a breast biopsy guidance approach based on optical coherence tomography. The detailed description of the instrumentation and the preliminary results on an animal model of breast cancer will be discussed.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated solid-state terahertz transceivers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We monolithically integrated a Schottky diode and a THz quantum cascade laser to create a THz transceiver, capable of detecting incident THz radiation and/or characterizing the performance and dynamics of the QCL.

articleTitle: Hybrid CATV and 16-QAM OFDM to the home device networks
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: CATV and 16-QAM OFDM signals are experimentally transmitted through a span of a 20 km single mode fiber plus a 25 m polymer optical fiber in-house network. Without any wavelength converting process or bridge circuit, good performance was achieved.

articleTitle: Active photonic crystal terahertz laser operating in higher bands
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the design, fabrication and characterization of active photonic crystals terahertz quantum-cascade lasers operating in higher photonic bands. The upper bands lead to a large tuning range during operation.

articleTitle: A cavity QED-ion trap system for a scalable quantum network
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We observe an enhancement of the spontaneous emission from a single trapped ytterbium ion into a cavity QED system. This technique helps to scale up an ion-photon quantum network.

articleTitle: Development of reliable mW level powers in pseudomorphic ultraviolet light emitting diodes on bulk aluminum nitride substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The use of low defect density bulk AlN substrates has led to reliable pseudomorphic ultraviolet light emitting diodes capable of mW level power outputs from packaged devices emitting from 250-275 nm.

articleTitle: Intracavity generation of continuous wave terahertz radiation in the milliwatt regime
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a terahertz source based on intracavity difference frequency generation within a dual color vertical external cavity surface emitting laser. The generation of continuous wave terahertz radiation in the milliwatt regime is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fast tuning of MEMS-based tunable terahertz wire lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a fast frequency tuning of a terahertz wire-laser. Using a piezo actuator and a MEMS-plunger enables a tuning speed up to ~15 KHz. Improved bonding-pad design of wire-lasers leads to larger fabrication yield and better mode discrimination.

articleTitle: Controlled optomechanical quantum phase gate of phonon states
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We describe a scalable optomechanical array, with double-disk resonators, for two-qubit quantum phase gate of phonon states where mechanical systems exhibit significantly long lifetime. Simulation results show high fidelity and low photon loss.

articleTitle: Ultra-high finesse, low mode volume Fabry-Perot microcavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We construct microcavities comprising ultralow-loss micromirrors fabricated by laser ablation and reflective coatings. With quality factors of 3.3×10 and finesses of 1.5×10 , strong coupling or lasing with a single quantum emitter may be achieved.

articleTitle: AlGaN-based ultraviolet lasers — Applications and materials challenges
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Recent progress in the development of ultraviolet laser diodes will be reviewed. The effect of the heterostructure design on the gain characteristics as well as epitaxial growth challenges for AlGaN-based UV lasers will be discussed.

articleTitle: Laser fabrication of 3D microenvironments for small cellular populations
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present development of a lithographic strategy based on multiphoton-excited crosslinking of proteins and other biological molecules. Application of this approach to study cultured cells in physiologically relevant, 3D microenvironments will be discussed.

articleTitle: Dielectric nanostructures for broadband light trapping in organic solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We investigate broadband light trapping using only dielectric components to improve organic solar cell efficiency. We show that substantial absorption and photocurrent enhancement is possible using top-surface ITO gratings in these devices.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics investigation in a quantum cascade laser using Mid-IR femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: In a room temperature 4.5 μm QCL resonantly pumped with fs Mid-IR pulses, we observe an ultrafast gain recovery within the first 200 fs, gain oscillation within the 1 ps and a slower gain recovery of lifetime ~2-3 ps.

articleTitle: Broadband engineering of quantum dot spontaneous emission using flat dispersion metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the broadband (~25 nm) control of radiative decay rate of colloidal quantum dots by exploiting the flat dispersion of a one-dimensional nonmagnetic metamaterial structure.

articleTitle: Gradient-index adiabatic impedance matching (GRIN-AIM) antireflective diffractive optics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated suppression of reflection diffracted orders by at least 100× in a silicon grating by tapered nanostructures emulating adiabatic index matching. Novel fabrication using self-assembled nanospheres as lithographic mask was employed.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact angular reflector based InGaAsP/InP micro-lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a linear cavity micro-laser design utilizing the ultra-compact angular reflector as end mirrors. Laser fabricated on InGaAsP/InP quantum well wafer has a threshold of 22.4mA and can give mW output power.

articleTitle: An all-fiber 2μm wavelength tunable mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose an all-fiber thulium-doped wavelength tunable mode-locked laser operating near 2 μm. Reliable self-starting mode locking over 50nm tuning range is observed using fiber taper based carbon nanotube (FTCNT) saturable absorber (SA). Spectral tuning is achieved by stretching another fiber taper.

articleTitle: Digital reverse propagation in focusing Kerr media
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report experimental image reverse propagation in focusing Kerr media. These results are compared with a linear Zernike filter operation. A method for the measurement of the nonlinear coefficient is derived from these results.

articleTitle: Ultrafast non-thermal switching of the magnetization in (III, Mn)V ferromagnets
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using density matrix equations of motion and a tightbinding bandstructure calculation, we demonstrate nonthermal ultrafast spin switching in (Ga,Mn)As triggered by coherent photoexcitation and controlled by pump fluence and external magnetic field.

articleTitle: Off-axis and multi-directional plasmonic lenses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce a new class of plasmonic lenses generating one or several free-space beams in arbitrary directions from a point source of surface waves and demonstrate such plasmonic lenses on the facet of semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Time-dependent inhibited spontaneous emission
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The spontaneous emission rate of photon pairs in a parametric downconverter can be inhibited by a cavity mirror. Using a fast switch, we detect photons within the cavity during times when the emission was inhibited.

articleTitle: Direct visible lasers by rare earth doped waterproof fluoro-aluminate fibers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully drawn rare earth (Pr and Dy) doped waterproof fluoro-aluminate glass fibers at low loss (0.1~0.3 dB/m) and demonstrated visible laser oscillations pumped by a GaN-LD.

articleTitle: Freezing ultrashort light pulses by exciton-polariton interference in glass
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Self-assembled nanostructures with two characteristic periods, sub-wavelength along polarization and close to wavelength along propagation direction, are revealed in silica glass after femtosecond laser writing. The phenomenon is interpreted in terms of exciton-polariton crystal formation.

articleTitle: Terahertz superconducting plasmonics and metamaterials
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a superconductor array of subwavelength holes and split ring resonators with active thermal control over their resonant transmission. The arrays were lithographically fabricated on high temperature YBCO superconductor and characterized by terahertz-time domain spectroscopy. We observe a clear switching effect in the plasmonic as well as metamaterial devices as the superconducting film undergoes phase change at the transition temperature.

articleTitle: Transmission Bragg-grating grisms for pulse compression
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We design a grism compressor based on Bragg transmission gratings and high index prisms. Single-pass throughput of ~76% over 740-840nm with large negative third order dispersion matchable to bulk stretcher dispersion is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of Raman-shifting soliton pairs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Two types of fiber-optic soliton pairs in the presence of Raman self-frequency shift were predicted recently. We report experimental observation of one of these types and obtain good quantitative agreement.

articleTitle: Double-resonant enhancement of surface enhanced Raman scattering using high contrast grating resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a high contrast grating double-resonator design, which can enhance SERS signal by >;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> by simultaneously enhancing both the surface-normal incident pump and the Raman signal, whereby both enhancements are at the same spatial location.

articleTitle: Modal formulation for scattering on the absorbing silicon nanowire arrays for photovoltaic applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We develop a modal method for modeling the scattering off absorbing silicon nanowire arrays for photovoltaic applications. This semi-analytic approach allows the efficient, accurate calculation of absorption and gives insight into the absorption mechanism.

articleTitle: Differential carrier lifetimes and efficiency of InGaN/GaN quantum well and quantum dot light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Temperature-dependent efficiency and differential carrier lifetimes have been measured on InGaN/GaN quantum well and quantum dot LEDs. The roles of Auger recombination and carrier leakage in LED efficiency roll-off are elucidated.

articleTitle: Multiexposure speckle contrast imaging using current pulsed VCSELs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We implement multiexposure contrast imaging using VCSELs to quantify cortical blood flow, towards a portable technique. Device characterization and noise compensations algorithms are used to show robustness of our technique in non ideal conditions.

articleTitle: Quantum interference of multiple beams induced by multiple scattering
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on quantum interference induced by the transmission of quantized light through a multiple-scattering medium. We show that entangled states can be created by multiple-scattering and that quantum interference survives disorder averaging.

articleTitle: Thin substrates for enhanced metamaterial sensing applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that metamaterials on thin substrates exhibit great sensitivity to changes in their dielectric environment. They thus show excellent potential for sensing applications as the analyte film can be applied on the substrate side.

articleTitle: Polarization entanglement generation based on birefringence in polarization maintained dispersion shifted fiber at 1.5 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 1.5 μm polarization entanglement generation is experimentally demonstrated based on birefringence in polarization maintained dispersion shifted fiber. Two-photon interference with visibility of >;89% without subtracting background counts is achieved, indicating its polarization entanglement property.

articleTitle: Nanolasers on Si-MOSFET: A monolithic integration
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: InGaAs nanopillar lasers directly grown on the gate, source and drain areas of Si MOSFET are demonstrated for the first time using 410°C MOCVD. This represents the first monolithic integration of lasers on functional transistors.

articleTitle: Intensity dependence of optically-induced injection currents in semiconductor quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The intensity dependence of optically-induced injection currents in semiconductor quantum wells is investigated numerically. Oscillatory behavior of the electron charge current transients as function of intensity and time is predicted and explained.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional multi-wave mixing with high-field THz transients in InSb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Strong 4- and 6-wave-mixing is detected electro-optically when two multi-THz fields of 5 MV/cm interact in InSb. These processes are mediated by 2-photon interband transitions. A non-collinear geometry paves the way for background-free measurements.

articleTitle: Magnetic nanoparticles for contrast enhanced infrared thermal imaging
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate the use of superparamagnetic nanoparticles with specific antibodies as contrast agents for tumor detection. Using the same nanoparticles, three different approaches for detection are shown: thermal imaging, acoustic imaging and fluorescence lifetime imaging.

articleTitle: Optically referenced double comb interferometry: Applications and technological needs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Interferogram chirping to enhance the quality of dual comb interferometry is discussed, along with the associated trade with multiplicative noise. It is also shown that the signal providing the optical path difference axis is not oscillating at the carrier frequency of the optical signal. Applications less affected by the limited spectral range are proposed.

articleTitle: Passive resonance tuning through closely spaced coupled split ring resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Bilayer split ring resonators as a function of separation (~λ/500) and orientation are measured. Terahertz measurements match simulations showing frequency shifting of the resonances with implications for electrically small antenna design.

articleTitle: Ultra-low power fiber-coupled gallium arsenide photonic crystal cavity electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate electro-optic modulation in a GaAs laterally doped photonic crystal cavity diode with ultra-low switching energy of several fJ/bit. A short non-radiative carrier lifetime allows fast switching with an upper threshold of 100 GHz.

articleTitle: Partial-coherence colored-noise approach to model FEL pulse statistics
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An efficient numerical method allows to generate statistically representative sets of pulse shapes of free-electron lasers (FELs) operating in the self-amplified spontaneous emission mode (SASE) without detailed knowledge of the technical machine parameters.

articleTitle: Tellurite nanostructured fiber
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a distortion factor which indicates the distortion degree of the geometry of fiber compared with the geometry of preform. Hexagonal core, and triangular core nanostructured fibers with the smallest size are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optically-pumped circularly polarized lasing in a (110) VCSEL with GaAs/AlGaAs QWs at room temperature
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have successfully fabricated a (110)-VCSEL with GaAs/AlGaAs QWs and achieved circularly-polarized lasing with a high degree of circular polarization of 0.96 at room temperature, reflecting a long spin relaxation time in (110) GaAs/AlGaAs QWs.

articleTitle: Loss of phase in the interaction of two collapsing beams
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: When two self-focusing beams with the fixed-initial-phase interact, we observe fluctuations in output mode profiles as predicted by simulations. We attribute these fluctuations to the loss of relative phase as the beams collapse.

articleTitle: Use of spectroscopic imager for the assessment of optical properties and 3-D reconstruction of biological media
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce an imaging system consisting of a modulated source and a spectroscopic imager. A Carre's algorithm was used for the reconstruction of the material's optical properties and 3-D shape.

articleTitle: Encrypting messages in 3D photonic crystals with patterned surface chemistry
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a 3D porous photonic crystal whose inner surfaces are chemically functionalized in arbitrary spatial patterns with micro-scale resolution. We use this platform to demonstrate a method for solvent-specific multi-layer message encryption.

articleTitle: Gain to absorption ratio of self-induced transparency modelocked quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A model to calculate the gain to absorption ratio of self-induced transparency modelocked quantum cascade lasers is presented and then used to find the gain to absorbing periods ratio that is required for stable operation.

articleTitle: Can quadratic solitons self-accelerate?
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present accelerating self-trapped first- and second-harmonic beams in a phased-matched quadratic process. The acceleration results from the inner structure of the beams, which exhibit unique properties such as asynchronous interference and irregular power distribution.

articleTitle: Tm-doped KY(WO4)2 planar waveguide laser operating in the continuous-wave and Q-switched regimes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Waveguide lasing of a Tm:KY(WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> epitaxial layer in a monolithic cavity is reported. The laser was operated at 2 μm in the Q-switched mode using Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnSe as saturable absorber and in the continuous-wave regime.

articleTitle: Broadband, rapidly tunable, BiB3O6 femtosecond optical parametric oscillator directly pumped by a Ti:Sapphire
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator based on BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> pumped directly by a Kerr-lens-mode-locked Ti:sapphire laser, providing broad, continuous, and rapid tuning in the near-infrared using cavity delay detuning with self -compressed signal pulses.

articleTitle: Suppressed mode recovery in nonlinear fibers of a Fabry-Perot-filtered frequency comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A Yb-fiber based frequency comb spanning more than 150 nm with a multi-GHz mode spacing was set up. Dynamic reamplification of suppressed modes in a nonlinear fiber after the filter cavities was observed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Broadband phase-matched backward difference-frequency generation: A novel scheme for spectral optical phase conjugation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have observed broadband quasi-phase-matched backward difference-frequency generation in short-period periodically-poled KTP, which can be used as a novel scheme for spectral phase conjugation.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact, slow light enhanced, 160Gbaud demultiplexing in a silicon photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate error-free de-multiplexing of 160Gbit/s optical data to a 10Gbit/s data stream, exploiting slow light enhancement of four-wave mixing in an ultra-compact 96μm long, dispersion engineered silicon photonic crystal waveguide.

articleTitle: Single-pixel coherent diffraction imaging with THz waves
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose and demonstrate single-pixel coherent diffraction imaging with ultrafast THz waves, whereby all the spatial frequency components processed by a spatial phase retarder are simultaneously measured by a fixed-location single-pixel detector.

articleTitle: Spin-wave generation and storage in a solid state system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report correlations between multi-photon pulses generated via spontaneous Raman scattering in a rare-earth ion-doped crystal. This is a first step toward implementing a quantum repeater scheme in such a material.

articleTitle: TM and TE1 operation of cylindrical Terahertz waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Guided wave techniques have proven to be an outstanding technique for THz sensing and spectroscopy applications. Here, we report on a cylindrical-based guided wave structure that omits the need for high index silicon lenses, showing good performance in both TM and TE propagational modes.

articleTitle: Femtosecond x-ray powder diffraction on KDP
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Ultrafast photoinduced changes of crystal structure and charge distributions in potassium dihydrogen phosphate (KDP), KH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>PO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>, are mapped by femtosecond x-ray powder diffraction. The formation of HPO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>PO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup> defects is revealed.

articleTitle: Resonant plasmon-exciton coupling in zinc oxide quantum well-aluminum nanodisc heterostructure arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The emergence of Fano resonances in the extinction spectra of arrays of aluminum nanodiscs 30 - 200 nm in diameter deposited on [Zn,Mg]O quantum wells provide the first evidence of strong coupling in zinc oxide heterostructures.

articleTitle: Carbon nanotube saturable absorbers for bulk solid-state laser mode-locking
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Single-walled carbon nanotube-based saturable absorbers have been successfully applied for passive mode-locking bulk solid-state lasers operating in the spectral range between 800 nm and 2 μm. In this talk, the recent progress will be presented.

articleTitle: Towards 3D plasmon rulers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a prototype 3D plasmon ruler based on coupled plasmonic oligomers in combination with high-resolution plasmon spectroscopy, rendering the retrieval of the complete spatial configuration of complex macromolecular and their dynamic evolution possible.

articleTitle: Double-helix 3D photo-activation localization microscopy with a phase mask for efficient photon collection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate 3D photo-activation localization microscopy of 4μm thick samples with efficient photon collection using a phase mask fabricated by gray-level lithography. The performance limits of the system in the presence of noise are analyzed.

articleTitle: Spin self-rephasing and very long coherence times in trapped atomic ensembles
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We perform Ramsey spectroscopy on the ground state of ultra-cold <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb atoms magnetically trapped on a chip in the Knudsen regime. Field inhomogeneities over the sample should limit the 1/e contrast decay time to about 3 s, while decay times of 58 ± 12 s are actually observed. We explain this surprising result by a spin self-rephasing mechanism induced by the identical spin rotation effect originating from the exchange interaction. We propose a theory of this synchronization mechanism and obtain good agreement with the experimental observations. The effect is general and may appear in other physical systems.

articleTitle: Concurrent multi-scale imaging combining optical coherence tomography with MRI
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We developed a novel platform based on teleoperated robot to perform high resolution optical coherence tomography imaging under continuous MRI guidance. The feasibility of real-time multi-scale imaging is demonstrated on a tissue phantom of breast tumor.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic filters with > 65 dB sidelobe suppression using directly generated broadband, quasi — Gaussian shaped optical frequency combs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present microwave photonic filters with record >;65 dB sidelobe suppression using directly generated, broadband, quasi-Gaussian combs using cascaded-FWM based spectral broadening of combs generated from tailored E-O modulation of CW lasers.

articleTitle: Interfacing single photons from dissimilar sources
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We interface single photons generated by a quantum dot with those generated via parametric down-conversion. The photon indistinguishability is assessed by measuring their coalescence probability; it is 16% and limited by quantum dot decoherence.

articleTitle: Directional control of lateral leakage in thin-ridge Silicon-on-Insulator waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a method to control the direction of lateral leakage of Silicon-On-Insulator waveguide which is verified by full vector super-mode analysis. The results suggest new opportunities for device topologies inspired by antennas.

articleTitle: Generation of narrowband hyperentangled biphotons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We generate narrowband hyperentangled nondegenerate paired photons using spontaneous four-wave mixing in cold atoms. The entanglement in both time-frequency and polarization is confirmed by correlation measurements and quantum state tomography.

articleTitle: An experimental investigation of RoF-enabled MIMO DAS in a non-light-of-sight environment
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The performance of a 3×3 MIMO system using RoF-enabled DAS technology is experimentally investigated in a Non-Line-Of-Sight environment. Reduced spatial correlation and improved SNR are achieved due to the larger antenna separation.

articleTitle: Fabrication of microstructures containing Au nanoparticles for optical and photonic applications
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Methods for doping microstructures have been recently developed due to the necessity of fabricating devices with specific features. In this work, we developed a method for fabricating microstructures, by two-photon absorption polymerization, containing gold nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Gratings in plasmonic V-groove waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We introduce visible light optical gratings to surface plasmon V-groove waveguides. Gradient e-beam dosage onto silicon stamp enables structuring V-grooves of varying depth. Nanoimprint lithography maintains a Λ=265 nm corrugation for gold surface devices.

articleTitle: CEP-preserving, octave-spanning IR OPA using BIBO and 800-nm pump pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on octave-spanning OPA of IR pulses from 1100 to 2200 nm using BIBO and 800-nm pump. We confirmed that 10-μJ OPA output pulses were CEP-stabilized using an f to-2/interferometer without spectral broadening.

articleTitle: 3D Imaging of the scattering pattern of plasmonic nanoantennas by heterodyne numerical holography
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a technique based on full-field heterodyne holography for the mapping of the scattered field of plasmonic gold nanoantennas in all three dimensions. A spectroscopic study allowed us to determine resonant and non-resonant wavelengths at which we conducted a full characterization of the scattered field for different polarizations and for a wide range of antennas. These results are compared to numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Metal-clad semiconductor nanoring lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Lasing in a metal-clad semiconductor ring laser of 0.9λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub>-diameter and 0.8λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub> height is demonstrated. It is experimentally shown that the metal coverage is critical in achieving the lasing threshold.

articleTitle: 7Gbit/s data transmission over 500m multimode fiber with monolithically integrated bidirectional VCSEL-based transceiver chips
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present design, fabrication and operation characteristics of AlGaAs-based transceiver chips with monolithically integrated VCSELs and PIN photodetectors. Up to 7 Gbit/s data transmission over a 500 m long standard multimode fiber is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Giant wavelength-temperature dependence of VCSEL with thermally actuated cantilever structure
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the modeling and the experimental result of a micro-machined VCSEL with a thermally actuated semiconductor/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> cantilever structure. The modeling result shows a giant wavelength-temperature dependence of over 3.5 nm/K. The fabricated device exhibits a temperature dependence of 0.79 nm/K, which is 10 times larger than that of conventional VCSELs.

articleTitle: Simultaneous passive coherent combining and mode locking in fiber laser arrays
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a detailed model of a multi-fiber interferometric resonator with a saturable absorber in the output arm. The results demonstrate coherent combining and the generation of mode locked pulses whose repetition rate depends on fiber length difference.

articleTitle: Two-section InAs/InP quantum-dash passively mode locked lasers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: First observations of 2-section InAs/InP quantum-dash passive mode locking at 48 GHz are presented. Mode locking trends are compared to those of a 1 -section device and to the ones reported for InAs/GaAs quantum-dot lasers.

articleTitle: Terahertz radiation from spin coherence optically induced in diluted magnetic semiconductors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The transient terahertz radiation emitted by a spin coherence optically generated in CdMnTe two-dimensional electron gases is directly measured in the time domain using electro-optic sampling. The spin radiation decays in a few ps at high magnetic fields.

articleTitle: 3-Dimensional laser pulse intensity diagnostics for the energy recovery linac photoinjector
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate measurement of spatiotemporal intensity profiles with spatial resolution of 20 μm and temporal resolution of 130 fs. Measurements of stacked soliton pulses and the output of a dissipative soliton laser illustrate the capability.

articleTitle: Tailoring polarization state of spoof surface plasmons with chiral metal surfaces
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Spoof surface modes with engineered polarization state are predicted to exist at structured conducting surfaces with planar chirality. We confirm experimentally that excitation of these modes by incident light results in polarization rotation.

articleTitle: Precision calculation of blackbody radiation shifts for metrology at the 18th decimal place
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present a new approach for accurate calculation of atomic polarizabilities, apply it to evaluate BBR shifts in optical clock transitions in Al<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and In<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, and find uncertainties below 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-18</sup> in some cases.

articleTitle: 182 nJ all thulium fiber CPA system
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 150 fs pulses spectrally centered at 2020 nm were generated in a Raman amplifier. Pulses were temporal stretched and amplified to 182 nJ with a spectral width of 60 nm.

articleTitle: Isotropic lasing from self-assembled cholesteric microdroplets
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Here we demonstrate single mode lasing from microdroplets of cholesteric liquid crystal. The droplets are formed by self assembly when mixing the liquid crystal with glycerol. This is one of first lasers that emits light isotropically in all directions and thus acts as a point source of light. Furthermore, the lasing wavelength is highly tunable by changing the temperature.

articleTitle: Phase-matched second harmonic generation by enhanced nonlinearities in ferroelectric domain walls
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: By employing angle modulation, phase-matched efficient Cherenkov second harmonics can be generated by different domain walls, which is a novel mechanism totally distinguished from Quasi-phase-matching.

articleTitle: Coherent combining of two quantum-cascade lasers in a Michelson cavity
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Michelson type cavity has been developed to achieve coherent combining of two quantum-cascade lasers emitting at 4.5 μm. We report a cw combining efficiency of 85% with a good beam quality (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> <; 1.4).

articleTitle: Using local fields to tailor hybrid quantum dot-metal nanoparticle systems: Connecting the dots
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We study systems of metal nanoparticles (MNP) coupled with semiconducting quantum dots (SQD). Hybrid behavior can be tailored by the MNP shape and the exciton resonance of SQDs which determine the local fields.

articleTitle: Direct imprinted gratings on nanoporous gold as effective SERS substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate large area arrays of patterned nanoporous gold as effective surface enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) templates by using a direct imprinting process. The resulting substrates exhibit a 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> SERS enhancement factor for adsorbed benzenethiol.

articleTitle: Reflection-type slow light optical switches using current injection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A slow-light reflection-type switch with crossing angle of 30-degree is demonstrated. Switching operation is realized using current injection. We obtained an extinction ration of over 15dB due to enhanced equivalent index change by slowing light.

articleTitle: Diffraction-coupled plasmon-enhanced light emission from InGaN/GaN quantum wells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Plasmon-enhanced near-green light emission from InGaN/GaN quantum wells is demonstrated using periodic arrays of silver nanoparticles. Particularly large (nearly fivefold) enhancements are obtained when the array dimensions are near the onset of the diffractive regime.

articleTitle: Ultra-low Threshold electrically pumped quantum dot photonic crystal nanocavity laser
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a quantum dot photonic crystal nanocavity laser electrically pumped by a lateral p-i-n junction. Thresholds of 181nA at 50K and 287nA at 150K are observed, lower than any other laser.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact TOSA/ROSA with 40-Gbps transmission rate using silicon optical benches technology
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Miniaturized TOSA/ROSA by using silicon optical bench (SiOB) technology is experimentally demonstrated with parallel transmission of 4-channel×10-Gbps. Whole module assembly is passive alignment achievable, and no coupling lens needed.

articleTitle: Coupled defect-waveguides in amorphous photonic lattices: Enhanced coupling through randomness
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present, experimentally and theoretically, coupled defect-waveguides in an amorphous photonic lattice, exhibiting enhanced coupling by virtue of disorder.

articleTitle: A new approach for fluorescence subtraction in Raman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report a new approach to extract weak Raman signal from a strong fluorescence background. The method utilizes a double-excitation technique with a laser and an LED as the excitation light sources.

articleTitle: Photonic band gap in 3D network structures with short-range order
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show numerically a significant depletion of the density of optical states in disordered three-dimensional network structures. The pseudo photonic band gap is likely produced by short-range order and uniformity of local topology.

articleTitle: Near field phase mapping exploiting intrinsic oscillations of NSOM probe
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An innovative, simple compact and low cost approach for phase mapping based on the intrinsic modulation of a Near Field Scanning Optical Microscope probe is analyzed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Direct-bandgap germanium active layers pumped above transparency based on tensilely strained nanomembranes
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that mechanically stressed nanomembranes can be used to introduce sufficient tensile strain in Ge to transform it into a direct-bandgap, efficient light-emitting material that can support population inversion and thus provide optical gain.

articleTitle: A compact orbital angular momentum spectrometer using quantum Zeno interrogation
