abstract: Fiber based optical frequency comb was developed using polarization maintaining Er doped ultrashort pulse fiber laser using polyimide film dispersed with single wall carbon nanotube. f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ceo</sub> was stable and locked with EO modulator and LD driver.

articleTitle: GaSb-based high-power single-spatial-mode lasers at 2.0 μm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report single spatial mode diode lasers operating near 2.05 μm with room-temperature continuous-wave output power exceeding 100 mW. At 20°C, threshold currents were near 25 mA (320 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>).

articleTitle: Large two-photon absorption enhancement with extremely nondegenerate photons
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using extremely nondegenerate photons in frequency (energy ratios >;10/1), we measure 2-4 orders of magnitude enhancement of two-photon absorption in semiconductors compared to the degenerate case. We demonstrate sub-femtosecond gated detection directly on semiconductor diodes.

articleTitle: All-optical logic gate for 160 Gbit/s DPSK signals in a highly nonlinear glass chip
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a broadband/flexible wavelength operation photonic chip based all optical XOR operation for 160 Gbit/s DPSK optical signals. This demonstrates the potential of broadband all-optical signal-processing on a chalcogenide (As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) chip.

articleTitle: Enhanced frequency response in monolithically integrated coupled cavity lasers and electro-absorption modulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the bandwidth enhancement of an EAM monolithically integrated with two mutually injection-locked lasers. An improvement in the modulation efficiency and bandwidth are shown with mutual injection locking.

articleTitle: Drive-current tuning of self-oscillation frequency of external cavity VCSEL
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the tuning of the self-oscillation frequency of an external cavity VCSEL using drive current. This frequency tuning occurs for all cavity lengths constructed; however, the degree of frequency tuning correlates with cavity length.

articleTitle: Hybrid plasmonic-photonic resonators for sensing and spectroscopy
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Design and experimental characterization of a hybrid resonator consisting of nanolithographically fabricated gold nanoparticles integrated with a Silicon Nitride photonic microresonator is discussed. Application of the proposed structure for sensing and spectroscopy will be discussed.

articleTitle: Edge emitting sensors for accurate quantification of hydrogen composition above 0.5%
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: An edge-emitting waveguide laser with an integrated palladium thin film for hydrogen sensing is presented. This device exhibits a 15% increase in the laser output power and 50pm peak wavelength redshift per percent hydrogen.

articleTitle: High-output-power 10.3-Gb/s operation of 1.27-μm quantum-dot DFB lasers for 10G-EPON
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: 1.27-μm high-density quantum-dot DFB lasers for 10G-EPON were developed. Fabricated lasers exhibited temperature-stable light-current characteristics and clearly-opened 10.3-Gb/s eye-diagrams with a high averaged output power of +4.5dBm from -10°C to 85°C.

articleTitle: Experimental optical multiplexing of two 20-Gbit/s QPSK data channels from different wavelengths onto a single 40-Gbit/s star 16-QAM using fiber nonlinearities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical multiplexing of two 20-Gbit/s QPSK channels at different wavelengths onto a single 40-Gbit/s star 16-QAM channel with tunable ring ratio using cascaded fiber-based nonlinear stages. The impact of QPSK channel spacing is also investigated. BER measurements confirm the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of ultra-large core size (>100 μm) Kagome fiber for laser power handling
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Kagome fibers were fabricated with core size larger than 100 μm. The fibers combined low loss over broad transmission and with small bend loss, making it a potential solution for high power and fast laser delivery.

articleTitle: First observation of Raman scattering emission from silicon high-g photonic crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report the first observation of spontaneous Raman scattering in silicon nanocavities with high quality factors. Stokes Raman scattering enhanced by the Q factor was spectrally measured under μW pumping.

articleTitle: Long-range synchronization of optomechanical structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We theoretically and numerically demonstrate that long-range radiation force mediated mechanical coupling and synchronization arise in optomechanical systems. We propose a planar micro-optomechanical device that exhibits non-linear frequency and phase synchronization of two unlike mechanical resonators.

articleTitle: 40 W picosecond fiber laser at 976 nm
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on the generation of nearly transform-limited 1-ps pulses at 40 MHz based on amplification in the nonlinear regime at 976 nm. The fiber laser system emits pulses with a duration of 1.56 ps and an energy of 1 μJ.

articleTitle: Temperature compensated 50 Gb/s DPSK demodulator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A proposed design approach for SOI-based Mach-Zehnder delay interferometers enables efficient passive temperature compensation through waveguide engineering. Using the methodology, a 50-Gb/s DPSK demodulator exhibits very low spectral shift (1 pm/°C).

articleTitle: All-fiber optical parametric oscillator, pumped by an all-fiber Yb-based MOPA
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We report on an all-fiber PCF-based optical parametric oscillator, synchronously pumped by an all-fiber Yb-doped MOPA. A pump-to-anti-Stokes conversion efficiency of 8.6% is reached at a frequency-shift of 142 THz.

articleTitle: Coherence properties of a mid-infrared frequency comb produced by a degenerate optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We show that a broadband mid-infrared frequency comb produced by a degenerate optical parametric oscillator (OPO) is stable and phase locked to the pump. Moreover, the OPO can operate in two phase and two frequency states. In this experiment, two identical OPOs were synchronously pumped by a single 70-fs fiber laser at 1560 nm and produced broadband (>;1000 nm-wide) frequency combs centered at 3120 nm. We observed stable interference fringes between the outputs of the OPOs. Also, by fine-tuning the OPO cavity length, the whole frequency comb could be shifted by steps of half the repetition rate. These results prove that sub-harmonic OPOs are suitable candidates for generation of phase-locked frequency combs in mid-IR.

articleTitle: Terahertz spectral imaging for drug inspection
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The aim of this study was to apply terahertz technology for screening and identification of drugs-of-abuse in mail. We have introduced terahertz spectral imaging and diffuse reflectance spectroscopy using our tunable THz parametric sources.

articleTitle: Dispersion interferometry based on second-harmonic generation of a Carbon Dioxide laser in orientation-patterned GaAs
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Orientation-patterned GaAs has been fabricated for use in dispersion interferometry. Second-harmonic generation of a CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser yields a cw output power of 6.5 mW with a device efficiency of 0.005% W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Notch nonlinear frequency shift in AlGaAs Bragg grating waveguides
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present an investigation on the nonlinear dynamics of intense pulses in an AlGaAs Bragg waveguide and we report the experimental observation of an intensity dependent blue-shift of the Bragg notch spectral line.

articleTitle: Frequency-modulation-mode-locked optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using a continuous-wave doubly-resonant optical parametric oscillator, we demonstrate, for the first time, the successful deployment of a phase modulator in combination with an antiresonant ring interferometer for generation of mode-locked pulses.

articleTitle: Polarization vortex converter imprinted by femtosecond laser nanostructuring in glass
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A polarization converter by femtosecond laser imprinting of space variant birefringence is demonstrated. Switching from radial to azimuthally polarized beam both with orbital angular momentum is achieved by controlling handedness of incident circular polarization.

articleTitle: Stimulated Raman scattering in chirped-pulse amplification: The role of vibrational dephasing
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We numerically study the properties of Raman Stokes pulses generated in fiber chirped-pulse amplification. Pulses are compressible for Raman dephasing times as short as a hundredth of the pump pulse duration.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength plasmonic mode confinement in semiconductor-gap-dielectric waveguide in THz range
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We have investigated the dispersion relation of novel semiconductor-gap-dielectric waveguide in terahertz range. It is shown that InSb-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-Si structure supports strongly confined guided mode with area of 6.6 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> λ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 1 THz.

articleTitle: Crystal structure measured by nonlinear absorption using 3.1 μm femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Infrared multiphoton adsorption at 3.1 m in crystalline GaAs depends on the crystal alignment to the laser polarization. This reveals the roles electron mass and band structure play in multiphoton ionization inside solids.

articleTitle: Surface optomechanics: Observation of surface acoustic resonances in whispering gallery resonators
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the excitation of a mechanical Rayleigh surface mode through optical electrostriction in a silica microsphere resonator. These modes have applications in optomechanical photonic oscillators and surface acoustic wave based sensing.

articleTitle: Pulse characterization of a passively mode-locked quantum dot semiconductor laser using FROG and autocorrelation
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: A comparison between the operational map of a QD MLL done by autocorrelation and FROG is made. The results show that the complete mode-locking region is significantly smaller when FROG is used versus autocorrelation.

articleTitle: Broadband radiation-absorbing metamaterial
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Using the broadband “super-singularity” in the density of states of (meta) materials with hyperbolic dispersion, we demonstrate, both theoretically and experimentally, a new concept of radiation-absorbing systems.

articleTitle: Hybrid terahertz-wave source with ultrawideband tunability utilizing Organic DAST and BNA crystals
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Crystal quality of a new nonlinear organic material BNA was much enhanced successfully. A novel hybrid THz-wave source with extremely ultrawideband frequency tunability was proposed using new BNA and established DAST crystals.

articleTitle: The influence of cavity dispersion on amplitude and frequency noise in a Yb-fiber laser comb
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We measure amplitude and frequency noise of a Yb fiber laser frequency comb in different dispersion regimes. Low cavity dispersion yields the lowest noise frequency comb.

articleTitle: Optical gain and green/red vertical cavity surface emitting lasing from cdse-based colloidal nanocrystal quantum dot thin films
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate robust excitonic gain from colloidal close-packed, CdSe-based nanocrystal quantum dot thin films at record low threshold excitation energy of 90 μJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for amplified spontaneous emission. The optical gain is employed in pulsed optically pumped quantum dot vertical cavity surface emitting lasers in the green and the red, respectively.

articleTitle: Precise micro-fabrication of structures to enhance photon collection from diamond color centers
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Diamond color centers show promise in quantum photonics applications. However practical implementation is limited by low photon collection efficiency. We report precise fabrication of structures which substantially increase collection efficiency from color centers.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal intermediate reflector in micromorph tandem solar cells
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: Experimental and numerical evidences are presented which show that the efficiency of silicon based tandem solar-cells can be increased by incorporating a three-dimensional photonic crystal as an intermediate reflector.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength pumping technique for up-conversion single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We propose a multi-wavelength pumping technique to improve temporal resolution of up-conversion single-photon detectors. By using two-wavelength pumping we doubled the date rate of a quantum system beyond its original limitation.

articleTitle: Reduction of efficiency droop in Semipolar (1101) InGaN/GaN light emitting diodes grown on patterned silicon substrates
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The semi-polar InGaN-based LEDs exhibits low efficiency droop because the reduction of the polarization field not only made the band diagram smoother but also restricted electron overflow to the p-GaN layer as shown in simulations.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characterization of 3D deterministic aperiodic structures
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present the realization of photonic structures based on the 3D generalization of deterministic aperiodic sequences in a positive photo-resist by direct laser writing. Diffraction patterns are studied showing characteristic intensity distributions.

articleTitle: Photon-number-resolving detection at 1.04 μm by coincidence frequency upconversion
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrated the photon-number-resolving detection at 1.04 μm by coincidence frequency upconverison. The detection efficiency of 6.8% was obtained. The Poissionian distribution of the up-converted photons was observed directly.

articleTitle: Quantum theory of optical coherence in the space-frequency domain
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The quantum treatment of optical coherence theory is generally carried out in the space time domain. We present a quantum mechanical theory of first-order coherence for statistically non stationary light in the space-frequency domain.

articleTitle: Photonic intensity integrator with combined high processing speed and long operation time window
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate a new design for time integration of microwave and optical intensity signals with unprecedented processing time-bandwidth product (>;140), by cascading a discrete time integrator and high-speed analog time-limited intensity integrator.

articleTitle: BaGa4S7: Wide-bandgap phase-matchable nonlinear crystal for the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: The orthorhombic biaxial crystal BaGa<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> has been grown by the Bridgman Stockbarger technique in large sizes with good optical quality. Refractive indices have been measured and Sellmeier equations fitted to analyze the phase-matching configurations.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an elliptical plasmonic lens illuminated with radially-like polarized field
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We demonstrate an elliptical plasmonic lens illuminated by a "radially-like" polarized field. The surface plasmons interference generates a structured pattern that can be used in structured illumination microscopy, particles trapping and sensing.

articleTitle: Deployment of a Quantum Cascade laser open-path gas sensor for water vapor and wood smoke analysis
publicationTitle: CLEO: 2011 - Laser Science to Photonic Applications
abstract: We present results from a widely tunable (296 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) Quantum Cascade laser based sensor used in sensing water vapor and target gases found in wood smoke in the rural fishing village of Elmina, Ghana.
